assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) + 1\r\n                unit_types[idx] = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n                unit_prios[idx] = task.get(\"priority\", 0)\r\n                break\r\n\r\n    # ---- Fastest-route assignment (worker-first min-cost) ----\r\n    # Movement is unblocked on the board (LOCKED tiles only block actions, not\r\n    # walking), so the fastest route between two tiles is EXACTLY Manhattan\r\n    # distance and _step_towards is the optimal first step. Every worker scans\r\n    # every task and picks the one with the lowest route cost (distance plus\r\n    # role/zone/claim weights). Worker-first iteration is empirically better\r\n    # than task-first matching in this game: it preserves zone locality because\r\n    # each worker stays near its home quadrant while high-priority tasks still\r\n    # win via the priority term.\r\n    def _assign_cost(idx, upos, task):\r\n        tpos = task[\"pos\"]\r\n        q = _quadrant(tpos[0], tpos[1], tiles)\r\n        home = active_quadrants[idx % len(active_quadrants)]\r\n        second = active_quadrants[(idx + 1) % len(active_quadrants)] if len(active_quadrants) > 1 else home\r\n        task_type = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n        req = task.get(\"req\")\r\n\r\n        # Primary cost: exact fastest-route length (open grid), same scale as\r\n        # the old `dist * 50` term so role/zone weights keep their dominance.\r\n        # Priority is the dominant term (old `priority*1000`): urgent tasks win.\r\n        cost = _manhattan(upos, tpos) * 50.0 - task.get(\"priority\", 0) * 1000.0\r\n\r\n        # Role costs: farmer wants animal tasks, hands want crops. Matches the\r\n        # old biases (positive = expensive = avoid).\r\n        if idx == 0:\r\n            if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (\"COW\", \"SHEEP\", \"GOOSE\")):\r\n                cost -= FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            elif task_type in CROP_TASK_TYPES:\r\n                cost -= FARMER_CROP_PENALTY\r\n        elif idx == 1:\r\n            if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (\"COW\", \"SHEEP\", \"GOOSE\")):\r\n                cost -= FIRST_HAND_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            elif task_type in CROP_TASK_TYPES:\r\n                cost -= FIRST_HAND_CROP_PENALTY\r\n        else:\r\n            if need_extra_animal_help and idx == 2:\r\n                if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (\"COW\", \"SHEEP\", \"GOOSE\")):\r\n                    cost -= EXTRA_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            else:\r\n                if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (\"COW\", \"SHEEP\", \"GOOSE\")):\r\n                    cost -= NONFARMER_ANIMAL_PENALTY\r\n\r\n        # Corner priority (early game) — free route for the corner plant.\r\n        if (unlocked_cnt == 1 and day < CORNER_PRIORITY_DAY and\r\n                task_type == \"PLANT\" and tuple(tpos) == CORNER_TARGET):\r\n            cost -= CORNER_BONUS\r\n\r\n        # Claim stickiness: keep your previous task, avoid stealing.\r\n        k = _task_key(task)\r\n        if k is not None:\r\n            claimer = claims.get(k)\r\n            if claimer == idx: cost -= CLAIM_BONUS\r\n            elif claimer is not None: cost += CLAIM_STEAL_PENALTY\r\n\r\n        # Endgame DROP tasks are bound to the carrying unit. Bonus kept below\r\n        # FEED/CARE/HARVEST_ANIMAL scores so animal survival always wins.\r\n        hint = task.get(\"hint\")\r\n        if hint is not None:\r\n            if hint == idx: cost -= 15000\r\n            else: cost += 100000\r\n\r\n        # Zone locality: home quadrant is cheap (old +500), second cheap-ish.\r\n        if q == home: cost -= 500\r\n        elif q == second: cost -= 200\r\n        elif q in unlocked_set: pass\r\n        else: cost += 10000\r\n        if q == home:\r\n            tile_owner = (tpos[0] * 7 + tpos[1] * 13) % unit_cnt\r\n            if idx == tile_owner: cost -= 300\r\n            elif idx == (tile_owner + 1) % unit_cnt: cost -= 100\r\n\r\n        return cost\r\n\r\n    for idx, upos in enumerate(unit_positions):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is not None: continue\r\n\r\n        best, best_cost = None, None\r\n        for task in tasks_sorted:\r\n            tpos = task.get(\"pos\")\r\n            if not _is_sequence(tpos) or len(tpos) < 2: continue\r\n            if tpos in assigned_pos: continue\r\n\r\n            # Farmer locked to pasture/coop tiles (unless PASTURE_UNLOCK — then\r\n            # it may roam to crops, but keeps the big FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS above\r\n            # so animals are always preferred when any animal task exists).\r\n            reserved_tiles = set(PASTURE_ONLY_TILES)\r\n            if _geese_on():\r\n                reserved_tiles |= set(COOP_ONLY_TILES)\r\n            if idx == 0 and tuple(tpos) not in reserved_tiles and not PASTURE_UNLOCK:\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n            task_type = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n            if task_type == \"PLANT\":\r\n                crop = task.get(\"crop\")\r\n                if assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) >= plant_budget.get(crop, 0): continue\r\n\r\n            req = task.get(\"req\")\r\n            if req is not None:\r\n                inv = unit_inventories[idx] if idx < len(unit_inventories) else {}\r\n                if _int(inv.get(req, 0), 0) <= 0: continue\r\n\r\n            c = _assign_cost(idx, upos, task)\r\n            if best_cost is None or c < best_cost:\r\n                best_cost, best = c, task\r\n\r\n        if best is not None:\r\n            assigned_pos.add(best[\"pos\"])\r\n            if best.get(\"type\") == \"PLANT\":\r\n                crop = best.get(\"crop\")\r\n                assigned_plants[crop] = assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) + 1\r\n            k = _task_key(best)\r\n            if k is not None: new_claims[k] = idx\r\n            unit_types[idx] = best.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n            unit_prios[idx] = best.get(\"priority\", 0)\r\n            if upos == best[\"pos\"]:\r\n                unit_actions[idx] = best[\"tokens\"]\r\n            else:\r\n                unit_actions[idx] = _step_towards(upos[0], upos[1], best[\"pos\"][0], best[\"pos\"][1])\r\n\r\n    # ---- Farmer pasture patrol (if idle) ----\r\n    if unit_actions[0] is None:\r\n        fx, fy = unit_positions[0]\r\n        targets = [t[\"pos\"] for t in tasks if t.get(\"type\") == \"BUILD_PASTURE\" and t[\"pos\"] not in assigned_pos]\r\n        if targets:\r\n            tx, ty = min(targets, key=lambda p: _manhattan((fx, fy), p))\r\n            if (fx, fy) == (tx, ty):\r\n                unit_actions[0] = [\"BUILD_PASTURE\"]\r\n                assigned_pos.add((tx, ty))\r\n                unit_types[0] = \"BUILD_PASTURE\"\r\n                unit_prios[0] = BUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY\r\n            else:\r\n                unit_actions[0] = _step_towards(fx, fy, tx, ty)\r\n\r\n    # Final fallback\r\n    for idx in range(len(unit_positions)):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is None:\r\n            unit_actions[idx] = _default_action(unit_positions[idx], tiles)\r\n\r\n    _TASK_CLAIMS[\"claims\"] = new_claims\r\n    return unit_actions, unit_types, unit_prios\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# MARKET ORDERS (per-turn helpers extracted from agent() for readability)\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\ndef _day0_orders_for_strategy(strategy, money):\r\n    \"\"\"Compute the day-0 order list + money spent for a DAY0_STRATEGY.\r\n    Affordability-gated exactly like the verified opening: each order is\r\n    skipped (not fatal) if money runs out. Returns (orders, spent, leftover).\r\n    Prices mirror _game_src.ANIMALS / CROPS / fib-hire exactly.\"\"\"\r\n    hires, items = DAY0_CANDIDATES.get(strategy, DAY0_CANDIDATES[\"VERIFIED\"])\r\n    orders = []\r\n    start = money\r\n    for i in range(hires):\r\n        cost = _fib_cost(i)\r\n        if money >= cost:\r\n            orders.append([\"HIRE\"]); money -= cost\r\n        else:\r\n            break\r\n    animal_cost = {\"SHEEP\": 500, \"COW\": 400, \"GOOSE\": 300}\r\n    # TOMATO is not in main.py SEED_COST (the phase planner never buys it), but\r\n    # the day-0 scanner prices it at its true cost 50 so TOMATO_SCALING is\r\n    # reported honestly even though the planner can't use the seeds yet.\r\n    seed_cost_full = dict(SEED_COST)\r\n    seed_cost_full[\"TOMATO\"] = 50\r\n    for kind, item, qty in items:\r\n        if kind == \"ANIMAL\":\r\n            unit = animal_cost.get(item, 400)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_ANIMAL\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n        elif kind == \"SEED\":\r\n            unit = seed_cost_full.get(item, 10)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_SEED\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n        elif kind == \"PRODUCT\":\r\n            unit = BASE_PRICE.get(item, 25)   # ~price at I0 (inventory ~10000)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_PRODUCT\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n    return orders, start - money, money\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _day0_scanner(money=3000):\r\n    \"\"\"Global initial scanner (reporting-only). Prices every DAY0_STRATEGY\r\n    candidate and reports, per opening:\r\n      - budget: spend / leftover after the exact order sequence\r\n      - crew: hands hired day-0 (farmer + hands)\r\n      - first income: earliest day the first sale lands (crop OR animal)\r\n      - labor demand: estimated hands needed once the plan ramps\r\n        (active crops to water + animals to feed/collect), using\r\n        DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION actions per hand per day\r\n      - gross season production proxy: crop units (seeds bought day-0) +\r\n        animal units (max_held per interval over remaining days), unweighted\r\n        by price so it is a *capacity* number, not a profit forecast.\r\n    Prints a table (DEBUG_DAY_LOG / _DAY_LOG[\"day0\"]) but never changes the\r\n    opening itself — that is locked to DAY0_STRATEGY.\"\"\"\r\n    crop_first = {\"WHEAT\": 2, \"CARROT\": 2, \"TOMATO\": 8, \"STRAWBERRY\": 10, \"MELON\": 10}\r\n    crop_max_yield = {\"WHEAT\": 6, \"CARROT\": 4, \"TOMATO\": 4, \"STRAWBERRY\": 4, \"MELON\": 6}\r\n    animal_cost = {\"SHEEP\": 500, \"COW\": 400, \"GOOSE\": 300}\r\n    animal_first = {\"SHEEP\": 6, \"COW\": 8, \"GOOSE\": 4}\r\n    animal_interval = {\"SHEEP\": 3, \"COW\": 2, \"GOOSE\": 1}\r\n    animal_max_held = {\"SHEEP\": 6, \"COW\": 6, \"GOOSE\": 4}\r\n\r\n    out = {}\r\n    for strat, (hires, items) in DAY0_CANDIDATES.items():\r\n        orders, spent, leftover = _day0_orders_for_strategy(strat, money)\r\n        animals = {}\r\n        seeds = {}\r\n        products = {}\r\n        for kind, item, qty in items:\r\n            if kind == \"ANIMAL\": animals[item] = animals.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n            elif kind == \"SEED\": seeds[item] = seeds.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n            elif kind == \"PRODUCT\": products[item] = products.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n\r\n        # ---- structural blockers (can this opening actually run?) ----\r\n        blocked = []\r\n        if any(a == \"GOOSE\" for a in animals):\r\n            blocked.append(\"NO_COOP_BUILD: geese can never be placed (no BUILD_COOP task gen)\")\r\n        if any(c == \"TOMATO\" for c in seeds):\r\n            blocked.append(\"TOMATO_NOT_IN_PLANNER: seeds never planted (not in SEED_COST/phase plan)\")\r\n        if sum(animals.values()) > MAX_ANIMALS:\r\n            blocked.append(\"ANIMALS>%d\" % MAX_ANIMALS)\r\n        # ---- cash runway warning (LEARNED 2026-08-09) ----\r\n        # VERIFIED leaves 668 coins; WOOL_BARON/DAIRY_KING leave 68/88 and\r\n        # BOTH crashed to 53k/63k vs 101k baseline. Days 1-11 the agent lives\r\n        # on leftover + tiny wheat sales: with <~300 leftover it can only\r\n        # re-hire hands and buy feed wheat — wave-2 melons, land, strawberries\r\n        # and mid-game animals never happen. Capacity (gross_units) does NOT\r\n        # predict reward; leftover working capital does.\r\n        if leftover < 300 and animals:\r\n            blocked.append(\"LOW_CASH_RUNWAY: %d leftover funds days 1-11 ops (VERIFIED keeps 668)\" % leftover)\r\n\r\n        # ---- first income day ----\r\n        first_income = 99\r\n        for item, qty in animals.items():\r\n            first_income = min(first_income, animal_first[item])\r\n        for item, qty in seeds.items():\r\n            if item in crop_first:\r\n                first_income = min(first_income, crop_first[item])\r\n\r\n        # ---- labor demand proxy ----\r\n        # Crops: each active crop needs ~1 WATER/day (watering capacity is the\r\n        # binding constraint, ~40 actions/day max). Animals: feed/collect per\r\n        # interval — each animal needs FEED every ~2 days + pickup on yield.\r\n        crop_water_actions = sum(seeds.values())\r\n        animal_actions = sum(qty for qty in animals.values())  # feed+care daily proxy\r\n        labor_actions = crop_water_actions + animal_actions\r\n        hands_needed = max(hires, 1 + int((labor_actions + DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION - 1)\r\n                                          // DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION))\r\n\r\n        # ---- gross season production proxy (capacity, unweighted) ----\r\n        crop_units = sum(qty * crop_max_yield.get(item, 4)\r\n                         for item, qty in seeds.items() if item in crop_max_yield)\r\n        animal_units = 0\r\n        for item, qty in animals.items():\r\n            prod_days = max(0, 30 - animal_first[item]) // animal_interval[item]\r\n            animal_units += qty * animal_max_held[item] * max(1, prod_days)\r\n\r\n        out[strat] = {\r\n            \"orders\": len(orders), \"spend\": spent, \"leftover\": leftover,\r\n            \"hires\": len([o for o in orders if o[0] == \"HIRE\"]),\r\n            \"animals\": dict(animals), \"seeds\": dict(seeds),\r\n            \"first_income_day\": first_income,\r\n            \"hands_needed\": hands_needed,\r\n            \"crop_units\": crop_units, \"animal_units\": animal_units,\r\n            \"gross_units\": crop_units + animal_units,\r\n            \"blocked\": blocked,\r\n        }\r\n    return out\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _day0_animal_strategy(market_inv, market_prices, day=0, hour=0,\r\n                          unlocked_shops=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Forecast-driven day-0 animal decision. Projects MILK and WOOL prices at\r\n    the sheep first-yield day (earliest animal income) using the deterministic\r\n    town-drain projection. When BOTH are projected below\r\n    DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO (i.e. the herd won't pay back), returns a LIGHTER\r\n    opening that shrinks animals (cash stays in melons/wheat). Otherwise\r\n    returns the verified full opening. Reporting-only when the knob is OFF.\r\n    The decision uses the SAME numbers the sell side sees (projected price\r\n    ratios), so the agent decides the \"max animals\" constraint from the\r\n    forecast instead of hard-coding it.\"\"\"\r\n    if not DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS:\r\n        return DAY0_STRATEGY, {}\r\n    try:\r\n        steps = DAY0_ANIMAL_FIRST_YIELD * 24\r\n        proj = _project_prices(market_inv, day, hour, steps,\r\n                               unlocked_shops or [])\r\n        milk_r = _price_ratio(\"MILK\", proj)\r\n        wool_r = _price_ratio(\"WOOL\", proj)\r\n        weak = (milk_r < DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO\r\n                and wool_r < DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO)\r\n        if weak:\r\n            # Lighter herd: keep melons/wheat, drop animals to a minimum.\r\n            # Only shrink — never grow past the verified composition.\r\n            return \"CROP_FIRST\", {\r\n                \"milk_proj\": round(milk_r, 2), \"wool_proj\": round(wool_r, 2),\r\n                \"weak\": True, \"why\": \"milk/wool premium projected weak at d%d\" % (\r\n                    DAY0_ANIMAL_FIRST_YIELD),\r\n            }\r\n        return DAY0_STRATEGY, {\r\n            \"milk_proj\": round(milk_r, 2), \"wool_proj\": round(wool_r, 2),\r\n            \"weak\": False, \"why\": \"premium projected alive\",\r\n        }\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        return DAY0_STRATEGY, {}\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _day0_opening(money, strategy=None, market_inv=None, market_prices=None,\r\n                  unlocked_shops=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Verified Day-0 opening script (budget 3000). Executes the strategy\r\n    selected by DAY0_STRATEGY (default VERIFIED = the proven 116k baseline),\r\n    or the forecast-driven animal decision when DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS is ON.\r\n    Each order is affordability-gated so a cheaper start never overspends.\r\n    Run _day0_scanner(money) first to see the full candidate table.\"\"\"\r\n    strat = strategy or DAY0_STRATEGY\r\n    decision = {}\r\n    if DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS:\r\n        strat, decision = _day0_animal_strategy(\r\n            market_inv, market_prices, 0, 0, unlocked_shops)\r\n    orders, spent, leftover = _day0_orders_for_strategy(strat, money)\r\n    return orders, leftover, strat, decision\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _record_day_log(day, money, forecast_free, market_prices, market_inv,\r\n                    buy_orders, trend=None, expenses=None, opponent=None,\r\n                    animal_phase=None, next_actions=None, outcome=None,\r\n                    demand=None, recovery=None, opp_buys=None,\r\n                    tile_map=None, late_game=None, goose=None):\r\n    \"\"\"One-line-per-day tracker: money, price ratios, tomorrow's price trend,\r\n    projected expenses, buys, last buy days, and a compact REASON string that\r\n    shows the agent's decision chain (why this route, why these buys/sells) so\r\n    the QA harness / stdout exposes the thought patterns. Stored in _DAY_LOG;\r\n    printed / appended when DEBUG_DAY_LOG is on. `animal_phase` is the\r\n    price-gated animal-phase snapshot (see _animal_phase_report);\r\n    `next_actions` is the next-day workload forecast (_forecast_next_day_actions)\r\n    and `outcome` is the season-end projection (_project_outcome).\r\n    `demand`/`recovery`/`opp_buys` are the market-awareness features\r\n    (_market_demand_rate / _price_recovery_time / _infer_opponent_activity).\"\"\"\r\n    global _DAY_LOG\r\n    if _DAY_LOG is not None and _DAY_LOG.get(\"day\") == day:\r\n        return\r\n\r\n    # ---- Compact reasoning summary (thought patterns for QA) ----\r\n    reason_parts = []\r\n    if isinstance(opponent, dict):\r\n        ctr = opponent.get(\"counter\")\r\n        if isinstance(ctr, dict) and ctr.get(\"route\"):\r\n            reason_parts.append(\"route=%s@%.2fx\" % (ctr[\"route\"], ctr.get(\"route_ratio\", 0)))\r\n            if ctr.get(\"dump_before\"):\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"dump_before=%s\" % \",\".join(ctr[\"dump_before\"]))\r\n            if ctr.get(\"avoid\"):\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"avoid=%s\" % \",\".join(ctr[\"avoid\"]))\r\n        dt = opponent.get(\"dump_timing\")\r\n        if isinstance(dt, dict) and dt:\r\n            crash = [p for p, r in dt.items()\r\n                     if _float(r.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        < _float(r.get(\"best_before_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)]\r\n            if crash:\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"crash_soon=%s\" % \",\".join(crash))\r\n    buys = [\"%s:%s\" % (o[0], o[1] if len(o) > 1 else \"\") for o in buy_orders]\r\n    if buys:\r\n        reason_parts.append(\"buy=%s\" % \",\".join(buys))\r\n    reason = \" | \".join(reason_parts) if reason_parts else \"\"\r\n\r\n    _DAY_LOG = {\r\n        \"day\": day,\r\n        \"money\": money,\r\n        \"forecast\": dict(forecast_free) if forecast_free else {},\r\n        \"prices\": _price_info(market_prices, market_inv),\r\n        \"trend\": trend or {},\r\n        \"expenses\": expenses or {},\r\n        \"buys\": buys,\r\n        \"reason\": reason,\r\n        \"last_buy_day\": {\r\n            \"COW\": _last_profitable_buy_day(\"COW\", market_prices),\r\n            \"SHEEP\": _last_profitable_buy_day(\"SHEEP\", market_prices),\r\n            \"LAND\": (30 - 12) if day < 30 else 0,   # _plan_land window\r\n        },\r\n        \"day0\": _day0_scanner(3000) if day == 0 else _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0\"),\r\n        \"day0_strategy\": DAY0_STRATEGY if day == 0 else _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0_strategy\"),\r\n        \"opponent\": opponent or {},\r\n        \"animal_phase\": animal_phase or {},\r\n        \"next_actions\": next_actions or {},\r\n        \"outcome\": outcome or {},\r\n        \"demand\": demand or {},\r\n        \"recovery\": recovery or {},\r\n        \"opp_buys\": opp_buys or {},\r\n        \"tile_map\": tile_map or {},\r\n        \"late_game\": late_game or {},\r\n        \"goose\": goose or {},\r\n    }\r\n    if DEBUG_DAY_LOG:\r\n        opp_line = _DAY_LOG[\"opponent\"]\r\n        pr_line = _DAY_LOG[\"prices\"]\r\n        ap_line = _DAY_LOG[\"animal_phase\"]\r\n        na_line = _DAY_LOG[\"next_actions\"]\r\n        oc_line = _DAY_LOG[\"outcome\"]\r\n        dm_line = _DAY_LOG[\"demand\"]\r\n        rc_line = _DAY_LOG[\"recovery\"]\r\n        ob_line = _DAY_LOG[\"opp_buys\"]\r\n        tm_line = _DAY_LOG[\"tile_map\"]\r\n        lg_line = _DAY_LOG[\"late_game\"]\r\n        line = (\"[DAY %02d] money=%6d prices=%s reason=%s opp=%s\" % (\r\n            day, money, pr_line, reason if reason else \"-\",\r\n            opp_line if opp_line else \"-\"))\r\n        if tm_line:\r\n            line += (\" | tiles={unlocked:%d empty:%d avg_dist:%s max_dist:%d far:%d}\" % (\r\n                tm_line.get(\"unlocked\", 0), tm_line.get(\"empty\", 0),\r\n                tm_line.get(\"avg_dist\", 0), tm_line.get(\"max_dist\", 0),\r\n                len(tm_line.get(\"far_tiles\", []))))\r\n        if lg_line:\r\n            line += (\" | late={empty:%d util:%.2f free:%d plantable:%s}\" % (\r\n                lg_line.get(\"empty_now\", 0), lg_line.get(\"utilization\", 0),\r\n                lg_line.get(\"will_free\", 0), lg_line.get(\"plantable_late\", {})))\r\n        if dm_line:\r\n            line += (\" | demand=%s\" % (dm_line,))\r\n        if rc_line:\r\n            line += (\" | recovery=%s\" % (rc_line,))\r\n        if ob_line:\r\n            line += (\" | opp_buys=%s\" % (ob_line,))\r\n        if ap_line:\r\n            line += (\" | animal_phase=active:%s placed:%d milk:%.2f->%.2f \"\r\n                     \"wool:%.2f->%.2f own:%s\" % (\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"active\"), ap_line.get(\"placed\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"milk_now\", 0), ap_line.get(\"milk_self\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"wool_now\", 0), ap_line.get(\"wool_self\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"own_units\", {})))\r\n        if na_line:\r\n            line += (\" | next_actions={%s} total=%d\" % (\r\n                \",\".join(\"%s:%d\" % (k, v) for k, v in na_line.items()\r\n                         if k != \"total\"),\r\n                na_line.get(\"total\", 0)))\r\n        if oc_line:\r\n            line += (\" | outcome=proj:%d today:%d rate:%d days:%d note:%s\" % (\r\n                oc_line.get(\"projected_final\", 0), oc_line.get(\"today\", 0),\r\n                oc_line.get(\"daily_rate\", 0), oc_line.get(\"days_left\", 0),\r\n                oc_line.get(\"note\", \"\")))\r\n        print(line)\r\n        if day == 0 and _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0\"):\r\n            try:\r\n                with open(\"day_log.txt\", \"a\") as _f:\r\n                    _f.write(\"[DAY 00] day0_strategy=%s day0=%s\\n\" % (\r\n                        _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0_strategy\"),\r\n                        {k: {kk: vv for kk, vv in v.items() if kk != \"orders\"}\r\n                         for k, v in _DAY_LOG[\"day0\"].items()}))\r\n            except Exception:\r\n                pass\r\n        try:\r\n            with open(\"day_log.txt\", \"a\") as _f:\r\n                _f.write(line + \"\\n\")\r\n        except Exception:\r\n            pass\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _build_sell_orders(day, hour, shed, global_inv, placed_animals,\r\n                       market_inv, market_prices, sell_slots, endgame,\r\n                       daily_sold, shed_pressure, counter_timing=None,\r\n                       counter_log=None, recovery=None, demand=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Timing-aware sell order builder. Price-aware: premium items are sold\r\n    one unit at a time while the MARGINAL price stays >= SELL_MIN_RATIO*base,\r\n    and the daily budget doubles when the market pays >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO*base.\r\n    `daily_sold` is mutated in place (per-day sold counters).\r\n\r\n    Opponent counter (OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER, OFF default): `counter_timing` is\r\n    the `_opponent_dump_timing` report. When the opponent's next wave will\r\n    LOWER a premium item's price below the best window we can catch today\r\n    (price_after_dump < best_before_dump), we ACCELERATE selling that item\r\n    NOW — before their supply hits the shared market. The marginal floor still\r\n    guards every unit, so we never oversell into our own crash. `counter_log`\r\n    (optional mutable dict) records which items the counter actually boosted,\r\n    for the day tracker / reasoning trace.\r\n\r\n    Recovery/demand awareness (RECOVERY_AWARE_SELL, ON): `recovery` =\r\n    {item: steps-to-recover} and `demand` = {item: units/turn} from the market\r\n    scanners. Short recovery / high demand -> HOLD (the climb continues);\r\n    long recovery / low demand -> ACCELERATE (the premium is fleeting). This\r\n    is the shops-demand-driven milk/wool sell timing from the briefing.\"\"\"\r\n    turn_index = day * 24 + hour\r\n    near_tick = (turn_index % 12) in (10, 11)\r\n\r\n    sell_candidates = []\r\n    for item in SELLABLE_ITEMS:\r\n        qty = _sellable_inventory(item, shed, global_inv, day, placed_animals)\r\n        if qty <= 0: continue\r\n        mkt_inv = _int(_safe_get(market_inv, item, 10000), 10000)\r\n        safe = SELL_SAFE_INVENTORY.get(item, 10100)\r\n        sell_qty = 0\r\n\r\n        # ---- EARLY-DUMP TIMING (user strategy, early cash trough) ----\r\n        # Days 1..EARLY_DUMP_END_DAY are the cash trough (money ~44-305). If\r\n        # the opponent's first harvest/dump of THIS item is imminent AND will\r\n        # crash the price (price_after_dump < price_now), sell our stock NOW\r\n        # into the pre-dump price — the early cash arrives before the market\r\n        # collapses. Marginal floor still guards every unit.\r\n        if (EARLY_DUMP_TIMING and 1 <= day <= EARLY_DUMP_END_DAY\r\n                and counter_timing and item in counter_timing):\r\n            dt = counter_timing[item]\r\n            after = _float(dt.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n            now = _float(dt.get(\"price_now\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n            next_dump = _int(dt.get(\"next_dump_day\", 99), 99)\r\n            units = _int(dt.get(\"units\", 0), 0)\r\n            if (next_dump - day) <= EARLY_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS \\\r\n                    and units >= EARLY_DUMP_MIN_UNITS \\\r\n                    and after < now:\r\n                # Sell as much as the marginal floor allows (never below floor).\r\n                early_max_q = 0\r\n                for _ in range(min(qty, 12)):\r\n                    if _market_price(item, mkt_inv + early_max_q) < \\\r\n                            SELL_MIN_RATIO * BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1):\r\n                        break\r\n                    early_max_q += 1\r\n                if early_max_q > sell_qty:\r\n                    sell_qty = early_max_q\r\n                    if counter_log is not None:\r\n                        counter_log[item] = \"early dump d%d (now %.2f, after %.2f)\" % (\r\n                            next_dump, now, after)\r\n\r\n        if item in PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET:\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif (EARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL and item in (\"MILK\", \"WOOL\")\r\n                    and 1 <= day <= EARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL_DAYS):\r\n                # Strategy #3 early-aggression window: sell ALL fetched milk/\r\n                # wool as soon as it reaches the shed to fund faster scaling.\r\n                # Only the marginal floor caps it (never sell below floor).\r\n                sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif PRICE_AWARE_SELL:\r\n                # True price control: market orders execute one unit at a\r\n                # time and re-quote the price after each unit, so we only\r\n                # sell units whose MARGINAL price stays at/above the\r\n                # reservation floor (SELL_MIN_RATIO * base). In a glut we\r\n                # hold and let the town drain the market back up; at a\r\n                # scarcity premium we sell up to the (scaled) budget.\r\n                base = BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1)\r\n                min_price = SELL_MIN_RATIO * base\r\n                budget = PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET[item]\r\n                if _price_ratio(item, market_prices) >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO:\r\n                    budget = budget * SELL_HIGH_BUDGET_MULT\r\n                # RECOVERY/DEMAND AWARE (briefing Pillar 1/3/4): the town\r\n                # drain either rescues a premium (fast recovery -> hold) or\r\n                # abandons it (slow recovery -> our own supply crashes it,\r\n                # sell more now). Demand rate tells us whether the climb is\r\n                # shop-driven (real, hold) or center-only (fleeting, sell).\r\n                if RECOVERY_AWARE_SELL:\r\n                    # Only MILK/WOOL/STRAWBERRY are steady streams where\r\n                    # \"sell before the fleeting premium dies\" makes sense.\r\n                    # MELON is a BULK one-time wave: dumping it all at once\r\n                    # (budget x2 + shed-pressure) crashes the price and\r\n                    # forfeits the slow recovery (measured: day-19 MELON 57\r\n                    # dump -> 0.85x; spread sales recover). Never accelerate\r\n                    # melon dumps.\r\n                    if item != \"MELON\":\r\n                        rt = _int(_safe_get(recovery, item, -1), -1)\r\n                        dr = _float(_safe_get(demand, item, 0.0), 0.0)\r\n                        if rt >= 0:\r\n                            if rt <= RECOVERY_HOLD_STEPS:\r\n                                # Fast drain: the price recovers soon, the climb\r\n                                # continues -> keep the normal budget (hold).\r\n                                pass\r\n                            elif rt >= RECOVERY_DUMP_STEPS and dr < RECOVERY_DEMAND_HOLD:\r\n                                # Slow recovery + weak demand: this premium is\r\n                                # fleeting. Accelerate before our own supply (and\r\n                                # any opponent dump) pushes it to the floor.\r\n                                budget = budget * RECOVERY_DUMP_MULT\r\n                        elif dr < RECOVERY_DEMAND_HOLD:\r\n                            # Already scarce but shop demand is weak: the scarcity\r\n                            # is center-only and will fade; don't overshoot.\r\n                            budget = budget  # normal\r\n                rem = budget - daily_sold[item]\r\n                if rem > 0:\r\n                    inv = mkt_inv\r\n                    max_q = 0\r\n                    cap = min(rem, qty)\r\n                    for _ in range(cap):\r\n                        if _market_price(item, inv + max_q) < min_price:\r\n                            break\r\n                        max_q += 1\r\n                    if shed_pressure >= 0.9:\r\n                        max_q = max(max_q, min(qty, max(1, budget // 2)))\r\n                    sell_qty = max_q\r\n                    # OPPONENT COUNTER (Phase 2): their next wave will crash\r\n                    # this item -> sell everything profitable BEFORE it lands.\r\n                    # Only fire when the dump is IMMINENT (within the lead\r\n                    # window): if it is still days out, the best_before_dump\r\n                    # window (projected) is HIGHER than today, so dumping now\r\n                    # forfeits the climb (measured: day-11 dump-before at 1.07\r\n                    # lost the day-14 window at 1.11). `best_day` is where the\r\n                    # price peaks before their wave — we wait until we are\r\n                    # inside the lead window so we sell at/near that peak.\r\n                    if (OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER and counter_timing\r\n                            and item in counter_timing):\r\n                        dt = counter_timing[item]\r\n                        after = _float(dt.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        best = _float(dt.get(\"best_before_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        now = _float(dt.get(\"price_now\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        next_dump = _int(dt.get(\"next_dump_day\", 99), 99)\r\n                        imminent = (next_dump - day) <= CROP_COUNTER_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS\r\n                        if imminent and after < best and after < now:\r\n                            counter_max_q = 0\r\n                            counter_cap = qty\r\n                            for _ in range(counter_cap):\r\n                                if _market_price(item, inv + counter_max_q) < min_price:\r\n                                    break\r\n                                counter_max_q += 1\r\n                            if counter_max_q > sell_qty:\r\n                                sell_qty = counter_max_q\r\n                                if counter_log is not None:\r\n                                    counter_log[item] = \"boost near dump d%d (now %.2f, after %.2f)\" % (next_dump, now, after)\r\n            else:\r\n                rem = PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET[item] - daily_sold[item]\r\n                if rem > 0 and mkt_inv < safe: sell_qty = min(qty, rem)\r\n            daily_sold[item] += sell_qty\r\n        elif item == \"EGG\" and _geese_on():\r\n            # Goose Pillar 5: town center drains eggs x1/x2/x4 at days 0/10/20.\r\n            # Before day 20 demand is weak (and eggs are glut-resilient, so\r\n            # they hold value) -> HOLD eggs in the shed. After day 20 the town\r\n            # center quadruples consumption, draining the market and raising\r\n            # price -> liquidate stored eggs then. Bakery/Brunch add shop\r\n            # drain on top (scanner reports the demand rate).\r\n            if endgame:\r\n                sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif day >= 20:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 12)   # peak demand window, sell stored stock\r\n            else:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 2)    # hold early; only trim shed pressure\r\n        elif item == \"FERTILIZER\":\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 6) if mkt_inv < safe else min(2, qty)\r\n            else:\r\n                if mkt_inv < safe: sell_qty = min(3, qty)\r\n        elif item == \"WHEAT\":\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 10) if mkt_inv < 10000 else min(4, qty)\r\n            else:\r\n                if mkt_inv < 10000: sell_qty = min(6, qty)\r\n        elif endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n        else:\r\n            if mkt_inv < safe:\r\n                room = safe - mkt_inv\r\n                max_tr = 2 if item in PREMIUM_ITEMS else 6\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, max(1, room), max_tr)\r\n            else:\r\n                sell_qty = min(2, qty) if item in PREMIUM_ITEMS else min(3, qty)\r\n            if near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = max(sell_qty, min(qty, 4))\r\n            if shed_pressure >= 0.85:\r\n                sell_qty = max(sell_qty, min(qty, 2))\r\n\r\n        sell_qty = min(sell_qty, qty)\r\n        if sell_qty > 0:\r\n            sell_candidates.append((item, sell_qty, OCR fallback\n    print(\"No text layer, performing OCR on PDF...\")\n    try:\n        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=\".pdf\", delete=False) as tmp:\n            tmp.write(pdf_bytes)\n            tmp_path = tmp.name\n        images = convert_from_path(tmp_path)\n        os.unlink(tmp_path)\n        ocr_text = \"\"\n        for img in images:\n            ocr_text += pytesseract.image_to_string(img) + \"\\n\"\n        return ocr_text\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"OCR failed: {e}\")\n        return \"\"\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_docx(docx_bytes: bytes) -> str:\n    doc = Document(io.BytesIO(docx_bytes))\n    text = \"\\n\".join([para.text for para in doc.paragraphs])\n    for table in doc.tables:\n        for row in table.rows:\n            for cell in row.cells:\n                text += \"\\n\" + cell.text\n    return text\n\n\ndef extract_text_from_image(image_bytes: bytes) -> str:\n    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(image_bytes))\n    return pytesseract.image_to_string(img)\n\n\ndef extract_text(file_bytes: bytes, filename: str) -> str:\n    ext = Path(filename).suffix.lower()\n    if ext == \".pdf\":\n        return extract_text_from_pdf(file_bytes)\n    elif ext == \".docx\":\n        return extract_text_from_docx(file_bytes)\n    elif ext in [\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\", \".tiff\", \".bmp\"]:\n        return extract_text_from_image(file_bytes)\n    elif ext == \".txt\":\n        return file_bytes.decode(\"utf-8\", errors=\"ignore\")\n    else:\n        raise ValueError(f\"Unsupported file type: {ext}\")\n\n\n# ========== LLM CALL ==========\ndef call_llm(text: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:\n    \"\"\"Try to use local LLM. <label class=\"label\">\n                        Timeout (seconds)\n                        <span class=\"tooltip\">ℹ️\n                            <span class=\"tooltip-text\">Maximum time to wait <script src=\"/static/theme.js\"></script>\n    <script src=\"/static/notifications.js\"></script>\n    <script src=\"/static/settings.js\"></script>\n    <script>\n        let currentData = null;\n        let currentFile = null;\n        let previewMode = false;\n\n        // Initialize on page load\n        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n            // Check LLM connectivity on page load\n            checkLLMConnectivity();\n            \n            // Check LLM availability for footer\n            updateFooterLLMStatus();\n        });\n\n        // Drag and Drop functionality\n        const dropArea = document.getElementById('dropArea');\n        const fileInput = document.getElementById('fileInput');\n        const fileInfo = document.getElementById('fileInfo');\n\n        ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {\n            dropArea.addEventListener(eventName, preventDefaults, false);\n            document.body.addEventListener(eventName, preventDefaults, false);\n        });\n\n        function preventDefaults(e) {\n            e.preventDefault();\n            e.stopPropagation();\n        }\n\n        ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(eventName => {\n            dropArea.addEventListener(eventName, () => {\n                dropArea.classList.add('dragover');\n            }, false);\n        });\n\n        ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(eventName => {\n            dropArea.addEventListener(eventName, () => {\n                dropArea.classList.remove('dragover');\n            }, false);\n        });\n\n        dropArea.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop, false);\n        dropArea.addEventListener('click', () => fileInput.click(), false);\n\n        function handleDrop(e) {\n            const dt = e.dataTransfer;\n            const files = dt.files;\n            if (files.length) {\n                fileInput.files = files;\n                handleFileSelect(files[0]);\n            }\n        }\n\n        fileInput.addEventListener('change', (e) => {\n            if (e.target.files.length > 0) {\n                handleFileSelect(e.target.files[0]);\n            }\n        });\n\n        function handleFileSelect(file) {\n            currentFile = file;\n            \n            // Validate file type\n            const allowedTypes = ['.pdf', '.docx', '.txt', '.png', '.jpg', '.jpeg', '.tiff', '.bmp'];\n            const ext = '.' + file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();\n            if (!allowedTypes.includes(ext)) {\n                showError('Unsupported file type: ' + ext);\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Validate file size (max 50MB)\n            if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {\n                showError('File too large. Maximum size is 50MB.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Update file info display\n            document.getElementById('fileName').textContent = file.name;\n            document.getElementById('fileSize').textContent = formatFileSize(file.size);\n            fileInfo.innerHTML = '';\n\n            // Show file preview section\n            document.getElementById('filePreviewSection').style.display = 'block';\n\n            // Load preview\n            loadFilePreview(file);\n        }\n\n        async function loadFilePreview(file) {\n            const formData = new FormData();\n            formData.append('file', file);\n\n            // Show thumbnail based on file type\n            const thumbnailIcon = document.querySelector('#fileThumbnail i');\n            const ext = file.name.split('.').pop().toLowerCase();\n            if (['pdf'].includes(ext)) {\n                thumbnailIcon.className = 'fas fa-file-pdf';\n            } else if (['docx'].includes(ext)) {\n                thumbnailIcon.className = 'fas fa-file-word';\n            } else if (['txt'].includes(ext)) {\n                thumbnailIcon.className = 'fas fa-file-alt';\n            } else if (['png', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'tiff', 'bmp'].includes(ext)) {\n                thumbnailIcon.className = 'fas fa-file-image';\n            }\n\n            try {\n                const response = await fetch('/preview', { method: 'POST', body: formData });\n                if (response.ok) {\n                    const result = await response.json();\n                    \n                    // Update preview content\n                    document.getElementById('filePreviewContent').textContent = result.text_preview || 'No text could be extracted from this file.';\n                    \n                    // Show extraction method\n                    const extractionBadge = document.querySelector('#filePreviewSection .status-badge');\n                    if (!extractionBadge) {\n                        const badge = document.createElement('span');\n                        badge.className = 'status-badge';\n                        badge.id = 'extractionBadge';\n                        document.getElementById('filePreviewContent').parentNode.insertBefore(badge, document.getElementById('filePreviewContent'));\n                    }\n                    \n                    const extractionBadgeEl = document.getElementById('extractionBadge');\n                    if (extractionBadgeEl) {\n                        if (result.extraction_method === 'ocr') {\n                            extractionBadgeEl.className = 'status-badge status-warning';\n                            extractionBadgeEl.textContent = 'OCR Extraction';\n                        } else {\n                            extractionBadgeEl.className = 'status-badge status-connected';\n                            extractionBadgeEl.textContent = 'Digital Text Extraction';\n                        }\n                    }\n                } else {\n                    const err = await response.json();\n                    showError('Preview failed: ' + (err.detail || 'Unknown error'));\n                }\n            } catch (error) {\n                showError('Preview failed: ' + error.message);\n            }\n        }\n\n        function removeFile() {\n            currentFile = null;\n            document.getElementById('fileInput').value = '';\n            document.getElementById('filePreviewSection').style.display = 'none';\n            document.getElementById('fileInfo').innerHTML = '';\n        }\n\n        function formatFileSize(bytes) {\n            if (bytes === 0) return '0 Bytes';\n            const k = 1024;\n            const sizes = ['Bytes', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB'];\n            const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k));\n            return parseFloat((bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(2)) + ' ' + sizes[i];\n        }\n\n        async function checkLLMConnectivity() {\n            try {\n                const response = await fetch('/health');\n                if (response.ok) {\n                    const health = await response.json();\n                    updateLLMStatus(health.llm_available);\n                }\n            } catch (error) {\n                console.warn('Health check failed:', error);\n                updateLLMStatus(false);\n            }\n        }\n\n        async function updateLLMStatus(connected) {\n            // Update status badge\n            let statusEl = document.getElementById('llmStatus');\n            if (!statusEl) {\n                const header = document.querySelector('header');\n                if (header) {\n                    statusEl = document.createElement('div');\n                    statusEl.id = 'llmStatus';\n                    header.querySelector('div:last-child').appendChild(statusEl);\n                }\n            }\n            \n            if (statusEl) {\n                statusEl.innerHTML = connected \n                    ? '<span class=\"status-badge status-connected\">✓ LLM Connected</span>'\n                    : '<span class=\"status-badge status-disconnected\">⚠ LLM Offline</span>';\n            }\n            \n            // Show/hide LLM warning banner\n            const warningBanner = document.getElementById('llmWarningBanner');\n            const warningText = document.getElementById('llmWarningText');\n            \n            if (!connected) {\n                warningText.textContent = 'LLM is not connected. The application will use the built-in fallback parser, which has lower accuracy.';\n                warningBanner.style.display = 'block';\n            } else {\n                warningBanner.style.display = 'none';\n            }\n            \n            // Update footer LLM status\n            const footerLLM = document.getElementById('llmAvailability');\n            if (footerLLM) {\n                footerLLM.textContent = connected \n                    ? 'LLM: Connected (AI Parsing Active)' \n                    : 'LLM: Disconnected (Fallback Parser Active)';\n            }\n        }\n\n        function openSettings() {\n            if (settingsManager) {\n                settingsManager.showModal();\n            }\n        }\n\n        document.getElementById('parseBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {\n            if (!currentFile) {\n                showError('Please select a file first.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            const formData = new FormData();\n            formData.append('file', currentFile);\n\n            document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'block';\n            document.getElementById('parseBtn').disabled = true;\n\n            // Animate progress bar\n            let progress = 0;\n            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');\n            const loadingText = document.getElementById('loadingText');\n            const loadingDetail = document.getElementById('loadingDetail');\n            \n            const progressInterval = setInterval(() => {\n                progress += Math.random() * 10;\n                if (progress > 90) progress = 90;\n                progressBar.style.width = Math.min(progress, 100) + '%';\n            }, 300);\n\n            try {\n                const response = await fetch('/parse', { method: 'POST', body: formData });\n                if (!response.ok) {\n                    const err = await response.json();\n                    throw new Error(err.detail || 'Parse failed');\n                }\n                \n                clearInterval(progressInterval);\n                progressBar.style.width = '100%';\n                loadingText.textContent = '✓ Processing complete!';\n                \n                const result = await response.json();\n                currentData = result.data;\n                populateForm(result.data);\n                document.getElementById('result').style.display = 'block';\n                document.getElementById('upload-section').style.marginBottom = '0';\n\n                // Update extraction method indicator\n                const methodBadge = document.getElementById('extractionMethod');\n                if (methodBadge) {\n                    if (result.llm_used) {\n                        methodBadge.className = 'status-badge status-connected';\n                        methodBadge.innerHTML = '<i class=\"fas fa-brain\"></i> AI-Powered Parsing';\n                    } else {\n                        methodBadge.className = 'status-badge status-warning';\n                        methodBadge.innerHTML = '<i class=\"fas fa-magnifying-glass-chart\"></i> Fallback Parser';\n                    }\n                }\n\n                if (result.warning) {\n                    const warn = document.getElementById('warning');\n                    warn.textContent = '⚠️ ' + result.warning;\n                    warn.classList.add('show');\n                    showWarning(result.warning);\n                } else {\n                    document.getElementById('warning').classList.remove('show');\n                    showSuccess('CV parsed successfully using AI-powered extraction!');\n                }\n\n                // Update LLM status\n                updateLLMStatus(result.llm_used);\n\n            } catch (error) {\n                clearInterval(progressInterval);\n                showError('Parse failed: ' + error.message);\n            } finally {\n                setTimeout(() => {\n                    document.getElementById('loading').style.display = 'none';\n                }, 800);\n                document.getElementById('parseBtn').disabled = false;\n            }\n        });\n\n        function populateForm(data) {\n            document.getElementById('full_name').value = data.full_name || document.getElementById('location').value = data.location || '';\n            document.getElementById('linkedin').value = data.linkedin || '';\n            document.getElementById('website').value =     const container = document.getElementById('work_experience_container');\n            container.innerHTML = '';\n            experiences.forEach((exp, idx) => {\n                container.appendChild(createExperienceItem(exp, idx));\n            });\n        }\n\n        function createExperienceItem(exp = {}, idx = 0) {\n            const div =     }\n\n        function toggleSection(sectionName) {\n            const content = document.getElementById(sectionName + '-content');\n            const icon =       function escapeHtml(text) {\n            const div = document.createElement('div');\n            div.textContent = text;\n            return div.innerHTML;\n        }\n\n        document.getElementById('generateBtn').addEventListener('click', async () => {\n            if (!currentData && !document.getElementById('full_name').value) {\n                showError('Please parse items\n            document.querySelectorAll('#work_experience_container .dynamic-item').forEach(item => {\n                data.work_experience.push({\n                    job_title: item.querySelector('.exp-title')?.value || '',\n                    company: item.querySelector('.exp-company')?.value || '',\n                    start_date: item.querySelector('.exp-start')?.value || '',\n                    end_date: item.querySelector('.exp-end')?.value || '',\n                    description: item.querySelector('.exp-desc')?.value || '',\n                });\n            });\n\n            // Collect education items\n            document.querySelectorAll('#education_container .dynamic-item').forEach(item => {\n                data.education.push({\n                    degree: item.querySelector('.edu-degree')?.value || '',\n                    institution: item.querySelector('.edu-institution')?.value || '',\n                    start_date: item.querySelector('.edu-start')?.value || '',\n                    end_date: item.querySelector('.edu-end')?.value || '',\n                });\n            });\n\n            // Validate required fields\n            if (!data.full_name) {\n                showError('Please enter a full name.');\n                return;\n            }\n            if (!data.email) {\n                showError('Please enter an email address.');\n                return;\n            }\n\n            // Send to backend to generate DOCX\n            const generateBtn = document.getElementById('generateBtn');\n            const originalText = generateBtn.innerHTML;\n            generateBtn.disabled = true;\n            generateBtn.innerHTML = '<span class=\"spinner\"></span> Generating...';\n\n            try {\n                const response = await fetch('/generate', {\n                    method: 'POST',\n                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n                    body: JSON.stringify({ data })\n                });\n                if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Generation failed');\n                const blob = await response.blob();\n                const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n                const a = document.createElement('a');\n                a.href = url;\n                a.download = 'clean_cv.docx';\n                document.body.appendChild(a);\n                a.click();\n                a.remove();\n                window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n\n                showSuccess('Your clean CV has been downloaded!', 5000);\n\n            } catch (error) {\n                showError('Error generating DOCX: ' + error.message);\n            } finally {\n                generateBtn.disabled = false;\n                generateBtn.innerHTML = originalText;\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Keyboard shortcuts\n        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {\n            // Ctrl+Enter to parse\n            if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'Enter' && !document.getElementById('parseBtn').disabled) {\n                document.getElementById('parseBtn').click();\n            }\n            // Ctrl+Shift+G to generate\n            if (e.ctrlKey && e.shiftKey && e.key === 'G') {\n                document.getElementById('generateBtn').click();\n            }\n            // Ctrl+, to open settings\n            if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === ',') {\n                if (settingsManager) {\n                    settingsManager.showModal();\n                }\n                e.preventDefault();\n            }\n        });\n\n        // Periodic LLM connectivity check\n        setInterval(checkLLMConnectivity, 30000);\n    </script>\n</body>\n</html>\n"

        "content": "// Toast Notification System\n\nfunction showToast(message, type = 'info', duration = 5000) {\n    // Create toast container if it doesn't exist\n    let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');\n    if (!container) {\n        container = document.createElement('div');\n        container.className = 'toast-container';\n        document.body.appendChild(container);\n    }\n\n    const toast = document.createElement('div');\n    toast.className = `toast toast-${type}`;\n    \n    const icons = {\n        success: '✅',\n        error: '❌',\n        info: 'ℹ️',\n        warning: '⚠️'\n    };\n    \n    toast.innerHTML = `\n        <span class=\"toast-icon\">${icons[type] || 'ℹ️'}</span>\n        <div class=\"toast-content\">${message}</div>\n        <button class=\"toast-close\" onclick=\"this.parentElement.remove()\">&times;</button>\n    `;\n\n    container.appendChild(toast);\n\n    // Auto-remove after duration\n    if (duration > 0) {\n        setTimeout(() => {\n            if (toast.parentElement) {\n                toast.style.opacity = '0';\n                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 300);\n            }\n        }, duration);\n    }\n}\n\n// Convenience functions\nfunction showSuccess(message, duration = 5000) {\n    showToast(message, 'success', duration);\n}\n\nfunction showError(message, duration = 7000) {\n    showToast(message, 'error', duration);\n}\n\nfunction showInfo(message, duration = 5000) {\n    showToast(message, 'info', duration);\n}\n\nfunction showWarning(message, duration = 7000) {\n    showToast(message, 'warning', duration);\n}"
      },
      {
        "role": "tool",
        "tool_call_id": "call_1786852264095_2_rwzg39",
        "content": "// Settings Management for LLM Configuration\n\nclass SettingsManager {\n    constructor() {\n        this.defaultSettings = {\n            llmUrl: \"http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions\",\n            llmModel: \"local-model\",\n            apiKey: \"not-needed\",\n            timeout: 30\n        };\n        \n        this.settings = this.loadSettings();\n        this.createSettingsButton();\n        this.checkLLMConnectivity();\n    }\n\n    loadSettings() {\n        const saved = localStorage.getItem('cvBuilderSettings');\n        if (saved) {\n            try {\n                return { ...this.defaultSettings, ...JSON.parse(saved) };\n            } catch (e) {\n                console.warn('Failed to parse saved settings, using defaults');\n                return { ...this.defaultSettings };\n            }\n        }\n        return { ...this.defaultSettings };\n    }\n\n    saveSettings(settings = this.settings) {\n        localStorage.setItem('cvBuilderSettings', JSON.stringify(settings));\n    }\n\n    createSettingsButton() {\n        let btn = document.getElementById('settingsBtn');\n        if (btn) return;\n        \n        btn = document.createElement('button');\n        btn.id = 'settingsBtn';\n        btn.className = 'settings-btn';\n        btn.innerHTML = '⚙️ <span>Settings</span>';\n        btn.onclick = () => this.showModal();\n        document.body.appendChild(btn);\n        \n        // Position before theme toggle\n        const themeToggle = document.getElementById('themeToggle');\n        if (themeToggle && themeToggle.parentNode) {\n            themeToggle.parentNode.insertBefore(btn, themeToggle);\n        }\n    }\n\n    showModal() {\n        // Create modal if it doesn't exist\n        if (!document.getElementById('settingsModal')) {\n            this.createSettingsModal();\n        }\n        \n        const modal = document.getElementById('settingsModal');\n        if (modal) {\n            modal.style.display = 'block';\n            // Populate fields with current settings\n            document.getElementById('llmUrl').value = this.settings.llmUrl;\n            document.getElementById('llmModel').value = this.settings.llmModel;\n            document.getElementById('apiKey').value = this.settings.apiKey;\n            document.getElementById('timeoutSlider').value = this.settings.timeout;\n            document.getElementById('timeoutValue').textContent = this.settings.timeout + 's';\n        }\n    }\n\n    hideModal() {\n        const modal = document.getElementById('settingsModal');\n        if (modal) {\n            modal.style.display = 'none';\n        }\n    }\n\n    createSettingsModal() {\n        const modal = document.createElement('div');\n        modal.id = 'settingsModal';\n        modal.className = 'modal';\n        \n        modal.innerHTML = `\n            <div class=\"modal-content\">\n                <div class=\"modal-header\">\n                    <h3 style=\"margin: 0;\">LLM Configuration</h3>\n                    <button class=\"btn btn-small\" style=\"background: transparent; color: var(--text-secondary);\" onclick=\"settingsManager.hideModal()\">✕</button>\n                </div>\n                <div class=\"modal-body\">\n                    <div class=\"input-group\">\n                        <label class=\"label\">\n                            LLM Endpoint URL\n                            <span class=\"tooltip\">ℹ️\n                                <span class=\"tooltip-text\">OpenAI-compatible endpoint URL for your local LLM</span>\n                            </span>\n                        </label>\n                        <input type=\"url\" id=\"llmUrl\" placeholder=\"http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions\" value=\"${this.settings.llmUrl}\">\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    <div class=\"input-group\">\n                        <label class=\"label\">\n                            Model Name\n                            <span class=\"tooltip\">ℹ️\n                                <span class=\"tooltip-text\">Name of the LLM model to use (e.g., llama-3, gemma-2)</span>\n                            </span>\n                        </label>\n                        <input type=\"text\" id=\"llmModel\" placeholder=\"e.g., llama-3, gemma-2\" value=\"${this.settings.llmModel}\">\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    <div class=\"input-group\">\n                        <label class=\"label\">\n                            API Key\n                            <span class=\"tooltip\">ℹ️\n                                <span class=\"tooltip-text\">API key for the LLM service (leave as 'not-needed' for local models)</span>\n                            </span>\n                        </label>\n                        <input type=\"password\" id=\"apiKey\" placeholder=\"Not needed for local models\" value=\"${this.settings.apiKey}\">\n                        <button class=\"btn btn-small\" style=\"margin-top: 0.5rem;\" onclick=\"toggleApiKeyVisibility()\">Show/Hide</button>\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    <div class=\"input-group\">\n                        <label class=\"label\">\n                            Timeout (seconds)\n                            <span class=\"tooltip\">ℹ️\n                                <span class=\"tooltip-text\">Maximum time to wait for LLM response</span>\n                            </span>\n                        </label>\n                        <input type=\"range\" id=\"timeoutSlider\" min=\"5\" max=\"120\" value=\"${this.settings.timeout}\" onchange=\"document.getElementById('timeoutValue').textContent = this.value\">\n                        <div style=\"display: flex; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 0.3rem;\">\n                            <span style=\"font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary);\">5s</span>\n                            <span style=\"font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--text-secondary);\">120s</span>\n                        </div>\n                        <div id=\"timeoutValue\" style=\"text-align: center; margin-top: 0.3rem; font-weight: 600;\">${this.settings.timeout}s</div>\n                    </div>\n                    \n                    <div class=\"input-group\">\n                        <button class=\"btn\" id=\"testConnectionBtn\" onclick=\"settingsManager.testConnection()\">\n                            <span id=\"testConnectionText\">Test Connection</span>\n                        </button>\n                        <span id=\"connectionStatus\"></span>\n                    </div>\n                </div>\n                <div class=\"modal-footer\">\n                    <button class=\"btn btn-secondary\" onclick=\"settingsManager.hideModal()\">Cancel</button>\n                    <button class=\"btn\" onclick=\"settingsManager.saveAndClose()\">Save Settings</button>\n                </div>\n            </div>\n        `;\n        \n        document.body.appendChild(modal);\n    }\n\n    saveAndClose() {\n        this.settings.llmUrl = document.getElementById('llmUrl').value.trim();\n        this.settings.llmModel = document.getElementById('llmModel').value.trim();\n        this.settings.apiKey = document.getElementById('apiKey').value.trim();\n        this.settings.timeout = parseInt(document.getElementById('timeoutSlider').value);\n        \n        this.saveSettings();\n        this.hideModal();\n        showSuccess('Settings saved successfully');\n        \n        // Re-check LLM connectivity with new settings\n        setTimeout(() => this.checkLLMConnectivity(), 500);\n    }\n\n    getSettings() {\n        return this.settings;\n    }\n\n    async testConnection() {\n        const btn = document.getElementById('testConnectionBtn');\n        const textSpan = document.getElementById('testConnectionText');\n        const statusSpan = document.getElementById('connectionStatus');\n        \n        btn.disabled = true;\n        textSpan.innerHTML = '<span class=\"spinner\"></span> Testing...';\n        statusSpan.innerHTML = '';\n        \n        try {\n            const response = await fetch('/test-llm', {\n                method: 'POST',\n                headers: {\n                    'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n                },\n                body: JSON.stringify({\n                    data: {\n                        llm_url: this.settings.llmUrl,\n                        llm_model: this.settings.llmModel,\n                        api_key: this.settings.apiKey,\n                        timeout: this.settings.timeout\n                    }\n                })\n            });\n            \n            const result = await response.json();\n            \n            if (result.available) {\n                statusSpan.innerHTML = '<span class=\"status-badge status-connected\">✓ Connected</span>';\n                showSuccess('LLM connection successful', 3000);\n            } else {\n                statusSpan.innerHTML = '<span class=\"status-badge status-disconnected\">✗ Disconnected</span>';\n                showError('Could not connect to LLM endpoint');\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            statusSpan.innerHTML = '<span class=\"status-badge status-disconnected\">✗ Error</span>';\n            showError('Connection test failed: ' + error.message);\n        } finally {\n            btn.disabled = false;\n            textSpan.textContent = 'Test Connection';\n        }\n    }\n    \n    async checkLLMConnectivity() {\n        try {\n            const response = await fetch('/health');\n            if (response.ok) {\n                const health = await response.json();\n                this.updateLLMStatus(health.llm_available);\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            console.warn('Health check failed:', error);\n            this.updateLLMStatus(false);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    updateLLMStatus(available) {\n        let statusEl = document.getElementById('llmStatus');\n        if (!statusEl) {\n            const header = document.querySelector('h1');\n            if (header) {\n                statusEl = document.createElement('div');\n                statusEl.id = 'llmStatus';\n                statusEl.style.marginTop = '0.5rem';\n                header.parentNode.insertBefore(statusEl, header.nextSibling);\n            }\n        }\n        \n        if (statusEl) {\n            statusEl.innerHTML = available \n                ? '<span class=\"status-badge status-connected\">✓ LLM Connected - AI-Powered Parsing</span>'\n                : '<span class=\"status-badge status-disconnected\">⚠ LLM Disconnected - Using Fallback Parser</span>';\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize settings manager when DOM is loaded\nlet settingsManager;\n\nfunction toggleApiKeyVisibility() {\n    const keyInput = document.getElementById('apiKey');\n    if (keyInput.type === 'password') {\n        keyInput.type = 'text';\n    } else {\n        keyInput.type = 'password';\n    }\n}\n\ndocument.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {\n    settingsManager = new SettingsManager();\n    \n    // Also update LLM status from backend health check\n    settingsManager.checkLLMConnectivity();\n});\n\nfunction getFrontendSettings() {\n    if (settingsManager) {\n        return settingsManager.getSettings();\n    }\n    return {\n        llmUrl: \"http://localhost:8000/v1/chat/completions\",\n        llmModel: \"local-model\",\n        apiKey: \"not-needed\",\n        timeout: 30\n    };\n}"
