Optional\r\n        'exact_shop_count' restricts to exactly that many unlocked shops.\r\n        GOOSE directives are dropped when geese are disabled (_geese_on()\r\n        False) — a deterministic rule must never order a species the agent\r\n        cannot even place (A/B: geese regress -10k, so ENABLE_GEESE=False\r\n        means \"never buy geese\", even if a shop pair says otherwise).\"\"\"\r\n        directive = {}\r\n        shops = set(unlocked_shops or [])\r\n        for rule in OVERRIDES.get(\"SHOP_STRATEGY\", []) or []:\r\n            if not isinstance(rule, dict):\r\n                continue\r\n            need = set(rule.get(\"shops\") or [])\r\n            if not need or not need <= shops:\r\n                continue\r\n            exact = rule.get(\"exact_shop_count\")\r\n            if exact is not None and len(shops) != _int(exact, -1):\r\n                continue\r\n            directive = dict(rule.get(\"then\") or {})\r\n            break\r\n        # Hard goose gate at the SOURCE: geese-off rules never emit GOOSE.\r\n        # If stripping leaves an empty species_order the directive collapses\r\n        # to {} — no override fired, automation decides (cleanest fallback).\r\n        if not _geese_on() and isinstance(directive.get(\"species_order\"), list):\r\n            directive[\"species_order\"] = [\r\n                s for s in directive[\"species_order\"] if s != ANIMAL_GOOSE]\r\n            if not directive[\"species_order\"]:\r\n                directive.pop(\"species_order\")\r\n        return directive\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# PERSISTENT STATE\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n_DAILY_SOLD = None          # day -> {item: sold_today}\r\n_TASK_CLAIMS = None         # day -> {task_key: worker_idx}\r\n_DAY_LOG = None             # day -> {money, forecast, buys} day tracker\r\n_PREV_MARKET_INV = None     # previous turn's market inventory (opponent inference)\r\n_GEESE_ACTIVE = False       # runtime goose switch (set once from shop unlocks)\r\n_OVERRIDE_FIRED = None      # day -> {override_name, ...} already applied today\r\n\r\ndef _reset_state():\r\n    global _DAILY_SOLD, _TASK_CLAIMS, _DAY_LOG, _PREV_MARKET_INV, _GEESE_ACTIVE, _OVERRIDE_FIRED\r\n    _DAILY_SOLD = {\"day\": -1, \"MELON\": 0, \"STRAWBERRY\": 0, \"MILK\": 0, \"WOOL\": 0}\r\n    _TASK_CLAIMS = {\"day\": -1, \"claims\": {}}\r\n    _DAY_LOG = None\r\n    _PREV_MARKET_INV = None\r\n    _GEESE_ACTIVE = ENABLE_GEESE\r\n    _OVERRIDE_FIRED = {}\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _override_once(name, day):\r\n    \"\"\"True the FIRST time this (override name, day) pair is seen this game;\r\n    False on every later call for the same day. agent() runs once per HOUR,\r\n    not once per day, so any override that INJECTS an order (as opposed to\r\n    just filtering the existing list) must be gated by this or it fires\r\n    again on every hourly call — e.g. buying another cow every single hour\r\n    of the day instead of once. Filters (stop-buying, restriction, hire cap)\r\n    don't need this; only the injectors do.\"\"\"\r\n    global _OVERRIDE_FIRED\r\n    if _OVERRIDE_FIRED is None:\r\n        _OVERRIDE_FIRED = {}\r\n    seen_today = _OVERRIDE_FIRED.setdefault(day, set())\r\n    if name in seen_today:\r\n        return False\r\n    seen_today.add(name)\r\n    return True\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# FULL OVERRIDE REFERENCE — all tunable constants in one place\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\nAGENT_VERSION = \"v5.5-smart\"\r\n\r\n# Debug log file (single source of truth for the repeated \"day_log.txt\" literal)\r\nDAY_LOG_FILE = \"day_log.txt\"\r\n\r\n# ---- Budget & hiring ----\r\nSAFE_MONEY_BUFFER = 10\r\n# SEED_MONEY_BUFFER: the small cushion for SEED buys (the big SAFE_MONEY_BUFFER\r\n# was blocking all early seeds in the cash trough). Seeds are cheap; 30 coins\r\n# of cushion is enough to avoid overdraft without starving the plant engine.\r\nSEED_MONEY_BUFFER = 40        # WINNER sweep7 (verified 5/5 loops on top of NONFARMER_PENALTY_0)\r\nMAX_HANDS = 12\r\nOPENING_HIRE_COUNT = 5      # number of hands hired on Day 0 hour 0\r\nHANDS_CAP = 12\r\n# WORKLOAD_DRIVES_HANDS: when ON, the next-day action forecast sets the crew\r\n# floor (next_actions_total / 24 actions-per-hand). The user's ask: \"the\r\n# agent should be able to hijack the max number of workers if necessary.\"\r\n# A/B 2026-08-09 (FORECAST_DRIVES_HANDS) regressed, but that used a freed-\r\n# tile proxy; this uses the DIRECT action count. Knob OFF by default.\r\nWORKLOAD_DRIVES_HANDS = True\r\nMAX_ANIMALS = 10\r\n# EARLY_ANIMAL_RUSH: when ON, the animal planner buys up to 8 animals/call in\r\n# the first week (days 0-8) to reach MAX_ANIMALS faster. User ask 2026-08-09:\r\n# \"try to rush the maximum 8 animals as early game strategy and see if it\r\n# changes anything.\" A/B knob — OFF = verified baseline (profit-gated pacing).\r\nEARLY_ANIMAL_RUSH = False\r\n# Demand-driven herd ceiling: when the town shops demand milk/wool, the herd\r\n# can grow up to this (pasture tiles allow it; PASTURE_ONLY_TILES has ~20\r\n# tiles). The profit gate + last-buy-day rule are the REAL stops — the cap\r\n# only bounds runaway expansion. User directive 2026-08-09 wanted 11, but the\r\n# harness A/B showed the extra animals (9-11) eat strawberry-ramp cash\r\n# (-6k). Reverted to 8 for the verified baseline; the knob stays for the\r\n# real-competition setting.\r\nMAX_ANIMALS_DEMAND_CAP = 17\r\n\r\n# ---- Planting limits per turn ----\r\nMAX_NEW_PLANTS_PER_TURN = {\r\n    \"MELON\": 5,\r\n    \"CARROT\": 8,\r\n    \"WHEAT\": 8,\r\n    \"STRAWBERRY\": 8,\r\n}\r\n\r\n# ---- Timing ----\r\n# Workers keep watering/harvesting through day 29 hour 23; liquidation\r\n# (sell-everything + stop buying) starts only on the final day, day 29.\r\nLIQUIDATION_DAY = 29\r\nSHED_PRESSURE_LIMIT = 0.9\r\n\r\n# ---- Task priorities (higher = more urgent) ----\r\nPLANT_PRIORITY = 98\r\nBUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY = 99\r\nANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY = 98\r\nPRIORITY_AWARE_WEED_OVERRIDE = True\r\nWEED_OVERRIDE_CRITICAL_THRESHOLD = 90\r\n\r\n# ---- Toggles ----\r\nENABLE_FERTILIZER_CROP_USE = False   # WINNER sweep8 (5/5 verified; fertilizer spend wasted money)\r\nENABLE_ANIMALS = True\r\n\r\n# ---- Worker role biases (added to base score) ----\r\nFARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS = 20000\r\nFARMER_CROP_PENALTY = 0\r\nFIRST_HAND_ANIMAL_BIAS = 8000\r\nFIRST_HAND_CROP_PENALTY = -7000\r\nNONFARMER_ANIMAL_PENALTY = 0        # hands avoid walking to animal tasks (WINNER sweep7: 5/5 verified)\r\nEXTRA_ANIMAL_BIAS = 0               # neutral bias for temporary animal helper\r\nANIMAL_TASK_THRESHOLD_PER_WORKER = 3   # if >3 animal tasks per dedicated worker, get help\r\n\r\n# Task type groups\r\nANIMAL_TASK_TYPES = {\"BUILD_PASTURE\", \"BUILD_COOP\", \"FEED\", \"CARE\", \"PLACE\",\r\n                     \"HARVEST_ANIMAL\", \"COLLECT_FERTILIZER\"}\r\nCROP_TASK_TYPES = {\"PLANT\", \"WATER\", \"HARVEST\", \"FERTILIZE\", \"DIG\"}\r\n\r\n# ---- Corner priority (early game) ----\r\nCORNER_TARGET = (0,0)             # far NW corner\r\nCORNER_PRIORITY_DAY = 10          # only apply before day 10\r\nCORNER_BONUS = 50000              # massive bonus to ensure it gets planted\r\n\r\n# ---- Shed & base prices ----\r\nSHED_POS = (4, 4)\r\nBASE_PRICE = {\r\n    \"WHEAT\": 25, \"CARROT\": 35, \"TOMATO\": 60, \"STRAWBERRY\": 120,\r\n    \"MELON\": 250, \"EGG\": 50, \"MILK\": 160, \"WOOL\": 200, \"FERTILIZER\": 100,\r\n}\r\n\r\n# ---- Crop data ----\r\nCROP_MAX_DAY = {\"WHEAT\": 4, \"CARROT\": 3, \"MELON\": 10, \"STRAWBERRY\": 16}\r\nCROP_MAX_YIELD = {\"WHEAT\": 4, \"CARROT\": 3, \"MELON\": 6, \"STRAWBERRY\": 4}\r\nONGOING_CROPS = {\"TOMATO\", \"STRAWBERRY\"}\r\nPREMIUM_ITEMS = {\"STRAWBERRY\", \"MELON\", \"MILK\", \"WOOL\"}\r\n\r\n# True harvest schedules (mirror _game_src.CROPS exactly): the day the first\r\n# yield lands and the interval between later yields. main.py's CROP_MAX_DAY/\r\n# CROP_MAX_YIELD are the *agent's own* working values; these are the *game's*\r\n# timings used by the profit projection for market-driven buys.\r\nCROP_FIRST_YIELD = {\"WHEAT\": 2, \"CARROT\": 2, \"TOMATO\": 8, \"STRAWBERRY\": 10, \"MELON\": 10}\r\nCROP_INTERVAL = {\"WHEAT\": 0, \"CARROT\": 0, \"TOMATO\": 1, \"STRAWBERRY\": 2, \"MELON\": 0}\r\nCROP_MAX_GAME_YIELD = {\"WHEAT\": 6, \"CARROT\": 4, \"TOMATO\": 4, \"STRAWBERRY\": 4, \"MELON\": 6}\r\n\r\n# ---- Selling parameters ----\r\nSELL_SAFE_INVENTORY = {\r\n    \"WHEAT\": 10500, \"CARROT\": 10100, \"TOMATO\": 10050, \"STRAWBERRY\": 10030,  # WINNER sweep9 (5/5 verify on MARKET_BUDGET_6)\r\n    \"MELON\": 10080, \"EGG\": 10300, \"MILK\": 10020, \"WOOL\": 10020, \"FERTILIZER\": 10200,\r\n}\r\nSELLABLE_ITEMS = [\r\n    \"WHEAT\", \"CARROT\", \"TOMATO\", \"STRAWBERRY\", \"MELON\",\r\n    \"EGG\", \"MILK\", \"WOOL\", \"FERTILIZER\",\r\n]\r\n\r\n# ---- Seed economy ----\r\nSEED_COST = {\"WHEAT\": 10, \"CARROT\": 20, \"MELON\": 80, \"STRAWBERRY\": 100}\r\nMIN_PLANT_DAYS = {\"WHEAT\": 5, \"CARROT\": 4, \"MELON\": 11, \"STRAWBERRY\": 11}\r\n# Market orders execute AFTER unit actions in the turn order, so a seed bought\r\n# on turn T is only plantable from turn T+1. BUY-LEAD-DAYS forces the seed\r\n# planner to buy at least this many days BEFORE the planting deadline, so\r\n# seeds are in hand when the planting window opens (fixes the day-11 bug where\r\n# wave-2 melon seeds were bought after the day's PLANT orders were generated\r\n# and only started planting on day 12).\r\nSEED_BUY_LEAD_DAYS = 2\r\nSEED_TARGETS = {\"MELON\": 30, \"WHEAT\": 11, \"STRAWBERRY\": 40, \"CARROT\": 8}\r\nSEED_BATCHES = {\"MELON\": 14, \"WHEAT\": 8, \"STRAWBERRY\": 8, \"CARROT\": 8}\r\nPREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET = {\"MELON\": 30, \"STRAWBERRY\": 34, \"MILK\": 12, \"WOOL\": 9}\r\n\r\n# ---- Market price model (mirrors _game_src.py exactly) ----\r\n# Sell prices are a deterministic function of market inventory:\r\n#   price = base + amp*shape(I0 - inv)   when inventory <  I0 (scarcity -> premium)\r\n#   price = base - amp*shape(inv - I0)   when inventory >= I0 (glut -> crash)\r\n# The town center + shops consume products for free every turn, so inventory\r\n# drains all season and most prices drift UP toward big premiums by day 29\r\n# (measured live, seed 1: WHEAT 100%->192%, STRAWBERRY ->210%, MILK ->182%,\r\n# WOOL ->125%; MELON flat (self-crash when sold); FERTILIZER ->84% glut).\r\n# The agent OBSERVES the current price every turn (obs.market.prices) but\r\n# historically never read it for selling — only crude inventory thresholds.\r\nMARKET_I0 = 10000\r\nPRICE_FLOOR = 1\r\nMARKET_PARAMS = {\r\n    \"WHEAT\":      {\"base\":  25, \"T\": 400, \"below\": \"sqrt\", \"bt\": 0.80, \"above\": \"log\",    \"at\": 0.20},\r\n    \"CARROT\":     {\"base\":  35, \"T\": 450, \"below\": \"log\",  \"bt\": 0.20, \"above\": \"sqrt\",   \"at\": 0.70},\r\n    \"TOMATO\":     {\"base\":  60, \"T\": 200, \"below\": \"lin\",  \"bt\": 0.40, \"above\": \"sqrt\",   \"at\": 0.60},\r\n    \"STRAWBERRY\": {\"base\": 120, \"T\": 100, \"below\": \"sqrt\", \"bt\": 0.70, \"above\": \"lin\",    \"at\": 1.60},\r\n    \"MELON\":      {\"base\": 250, \"T\": 300, \"below\": \"log\",  \"bt\": 0.20, \"above\": \"sq\",     \"at\": 3.60},\r\n    \"EGG\":        {\"base\":  50, \"T\": 332, \"below\": \"lin\",  \"bt\": 0.40, \"above\": \"log\",    \"at\": 0.20},\r\n    \"MILK\":       {\"base\": 160, \"T\": 122, \"below\": \"sqrt\", \"bt\": 0.60, \"above\": \"lin\",    \"at\": 1.60},\r\n    \"WOOL\":       {\"base\": 200, \"T\": 105, \"below\": \"log\",  \"bt\": 0.20, \"above\": \"sq\",     \"at\": 3.20},\r\n    \"FERTILIZER\": {\"base\": 100, \"T\": 200, \"below\": \"lin\",  \"bt\": 0.40, \"above\": \"lin\",    \"at\": 0.40},\r\n}\r\n\r\n# ---- Price-aware selling (control knob, ON — verified +1.5k) ----\r\n# When ON, the sell logic reads the ACTUAL current price ratio (price/base)\r\n# instead of the market-inventory proxy: never sell a unit whose marginal price\r\n# is below SELL_MIN_RATIO*base (hold during gluts, let the town drain the\r\n# market back up), and sell up to 2x the daily budget only when the market\r\n# pays a true scarcity premium (price >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO*base). Prices rise\r\n# all season from town consumption (measured: WHEAT ->192%, STRAWBERRY ->210%,\r\n# MILK ->182% of base by day 29), so holding gluts and selling at peaks wins.\r\n# A/B at LIQUIDATION_DAY=29: OFF 114.9k avg; ON ratio 1.20 -> 113.6k (sold at\r\n# 120% and forfeited the climb); ON ratio 1.50 -> 116.5k/116.3k (2 QAs).\r\nPRICE_AWARE_SELL = False\r\nSELL_MIN_RATIO = 0.90          # below this, hold premium items (glut)\r\nSELL_HIGH_RATIO = 1.50         # at/above this, the market pays a scarcity premium\r\nSELL_HIGH_BUDGET_MULT = 2      # budget multiplier when price >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO\r\n\r\n# ---- Early livestock sell (strategy #3, OFF by default) ----\r\n# User strategy (2026-08-09): sell MILK/WOOL as soon as fetched during days\r\n# 1..EARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL_DAYS to raise capital faster, buy earlier, scale\r\n# earlier than the opponent, and drop the prices early on purpose; then revert\r\n# to price-aware selling for the climb. The HARNESS answer is NO (price-aware\r\n# ON 116.5k vs OFF 114.9k — holding into the 182%/125% late climb wins vs weak\r\n# bots), but the SHARED-MARKET answer is untested: vs a producing opponent the\r\n# late climb is smaller (measured MILK 0.14x in one top1-replay trial), so\r\n# early capital may beat late holding. MUST be gated by the 3-run top1 replay\r\n# (OFF ~95k), NOT the harness. The tail (abandon livestock after the drop) is\r\n# FORBIDDEN by the no-animal test (30.9k) — this knob only re-timings sells.\r\nEARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL = False\r\nEARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL_DAYS = 10  # days 1..N: sell all fetched milk/wool\r\n\r\n# ---- Day-0 strategy scanner (reporting-only by default) ----\r\n# The global initial scanner prices EVERY candidate opening from the TRUE game\r\n# constants (animal cost, seed cost, fib hire cost, first-yield timings) so we\r\n# can decide how to spend the 3000 before committing a single coin. The\r\n# opening the agent ACTUALLY executes is locked to DAY0_STRATEGY:\r\n#   \"VERIFIED\"     - the proven 116k baseline (5 hires, 2SHEEP+2COW, melon x4,\r\n#                    wheat seed x10, wheat product x4)\r\n#   \"4COW\"         - 4 cows + wheat feed + melons (early milk engine x2)\r\n#   \"4SHEEP\"       - 4 sheep + wheat feed (early wool, first income day 6)\r\n#   \"CROP_FIRST\"   - full crops on quadrant 1, no animals (pure melon/wheat)\r\n#   \"MIX_ANIMAL_CROP\" - 2SHEEP+2COW + more melon seeds than VERIFIED\r\n# Each is affordability-gated by the same _day0_opening machinery, so any\r\n# strategy that cannot be afforded degrades gracefully (skips unaffordable\r\n# orders instead of failing). Run _day0_scanner(3000) to see the table.\r\nDAY0_STRATEGY = \"VERIFIED\"      # which opening the day-0 script executes\r\nDAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION = 4       # productive actions per hand per day (movement eats the rest)\r\nDAY0_CANDIDATES = {\r\n    \"VERIFIED\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 2), (\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 2),\r\n                     (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 10),\r\n                     (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    \"4COW\":     (3, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 4),\r\n                     (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 12), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 6)]),\r\n    \"4SHEEP\":   (3, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 12),\r\n                     (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 6)]),\r\n    \"CROP_FIRST\": (5, [(\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 8), (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 14),\r\n                       (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    \"MIX_ANIMAL_CROP\": (4, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 2), (\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 2),\r\n                            (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 6), (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 12),\r\n                            (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n\r\n    # ---- User-supplied day-0 combinations (2026-08-09) ----\r\n    # WOOL_BARON = 4 Sheep, 5 Hands, 9 Melons, 10 Wheat\r\n    \"WOOL_BARON\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 9),\r\n                       (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 10), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # DAIRY_KING = 4 Cows, 5 Hands, 15 Melons, 10 Wheat\r\n    \"DAIRY_KING\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 15),\r\n                       (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 10), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # BALANCED_ALPHA = 2 Cows, 2 Sheep, 5 Hands, 12 Melons, 8 Wheat\r\n    \"BALANCED_ALPHA\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 2), (\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 2),\r\n                           (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 12), (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 8),\r\n                           (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # PREMIUM_DIVERSIFIED = 2 Sheep, 10 Melons, 10 Strawberries, 5 Hands\r\n    \"PREMIUM_DIVERSIFIED\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 2), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 10),\r\n                                (\"SEED\", \"STRAWBERRY\", 10), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # MELON_BLITZ = 35 Melon Seeds, 5 Hands\r\n    \"MELON_BLITZ\": (5, [(\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 35)]),\r\n    # LIVESTOCK_LADDER = 1 Cow, 1 Sheep, 1 Goose, 20 Melons, 5 Hands\r\n    #   BLOCKED: agent has no BUILD_COOP generation (GOOSE needs a COOP tile).\r\n    \"LIVESTOCK_LADDER\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 1), (\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 1),\r\n                             (\"ANIMAL\", \"GOOSE\", 1), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 20),\r\n                             (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # BERRY_MELON_MIX = 15 Melons, 15 Strawberries, 5 Hands\r\n    \"BERRY_MELON_MIX\": (5, [(\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 15), (\"SEED\", \"STRAWBERRY\", 15)]),\r\n    # COW_STRAWBERRY_PIVOT = 4 Cows, 10 Strawberries, 5 Hands, 10 Wheat\r\n    \"COW_STRAWBERRY_PIVOT\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 4), (\"SEED\", \"STRAWBERRY\", 10),\r\n                                 (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 10), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # TOMATO_SCALING = 2 Sheep, 25 Tomato Seeds, 5 Hands\r\n    #   BLOCKED: TOMATO not in SEED_COST / phase planner (never planted).\r\n    \"TOMATO_SCALING\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"SHEEP\", 2), (\"SEED\", \"TOMATO\", 25)]),\r\n    # GOOSE_SWARM = 5 Geese, 5 Hands, 15 Melons, 10 Wheat\r\n    #   BLOCKED: no BUILD_COOP generation (GOOSE needs a COOP tile).\r\n    \"GOOSE_SWARM\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"GOOSE\", 5), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 15),\r\n                        (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 10), (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n    # TOP1_EARLY = top1 replay's day-0 composition (user 2026-08-09):\r\n    #   2 Geese, 2 Cows, 14 Wheat seeds, 3 Melons, (8 pastured tiles built).\r\n    #   The geese half is BLOCKED (no BUILD_COOP), so this candidate is\r\n    #   reported by the scanner but the executable half is 2 cows + wheat +\r\n    #   melons. Aggressive early animal+crop overlap the user wants to A/B.\r\n    \"TOP1_EARLY\": (5, [(\"ANIMAL\", \"GOOSE\", 2), (\"ANIMAL\", \"COW\", 2),\r\n                       (\"SEED\", \"WHEAT\", 14), (\"SEED\", \"MELON\", 3),\r\n                       (\"PRODUCT\", \"WHEAT\", 4)]),\r\n}\r\n# Register the user-editable CONFIG[\"DAY_ZERO_BUYS\"] as the \"CUSTOM\" opening\r\n# so CONFIG[\"DAY0_STRATEGY\"] = \"CUSTOM\" (the default) runs it directly.\r\nDAY0_CANDIDATES[\"CUSTOM\"] = (\r\n    CONFIG[\"DAY_ZERO_BUYS\"][\"hires\"],\r\n    list(CONFIG[\"DAY_ZERO_BUYS\"][\"orders\"]),\r\n)\r\n\r\n# ---- Pasture land unlock (OFF default = verified baseline) ----\r\n# PASTURE_ONLY_TILES are STRICTLY reserved for pastures (farmer's home turf).\r\n# When unlocked, those tiles may also host crops, and the worker-0 guard stays\r\n# active: the farmer (idx 0) KEEPS the big FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS so it still\r\n# prioritizes animals first — it only falls back to crops when no animal task\r\n# is available. Hands keep their NONFARMER_ANIMAL_PENALTY so they don't steal\r\n# the animal lane. This knob is the FIRST step toward land-efficiency tuning\r\n# (user, 2026-08-09): every pasture-only tile freed = one more plantable tile.\r\nPASTURE_UNLOCK = False\r\n\r\n# ---- Animal-phase control (price-gated scaling, OFF default) ----\r\n# User strategy (2026-08-09): melons fund FAST animal scaling while milk/wool\r\n# prices climb — be early, max ~8 animals, capture the premium before the\r\n# shared market floods. When the climb ends (projected milk/wool price from\r\n# OUR OWN future supply drops below ANIMAL_PHASE_MIN_RATIO, or we hit\r\n# MAX_ANIMALS), STOP buying animals and go full-throttle strawberries.\r\n# The scanner (`_animal_phase_active`) detects the peak by projecting market\r\n# inventory INCLUDING our own livestock production over the horizon — the town\r\n# drain alone always trends UP, so the self-supply term is what reveals the\r\n# crash. When ON, `_plan_hires` also reserves market slots for animal buys\r\n# (the documented root cause of \"BUY_ANIMAL appears once per game\" is that\r\n# hires eat all 7 MARKET_ORDER_BUDGET slots every morning). Gated by 3-run\r\n# replay A/B: harness ~115k baseline must not regress, replay ~95k must gain.\r\nANIMAL_PHASE_CONTROL = True\r\nANIMAL_PHASE_MIN_RATIO = 1.15    # keep buying while projected milk/wool >= this\r\nANIMAL_PHASE_HORIZON_DAYS = 4    # self-crash look-ahead\r\nANIMAL_PHASE_HIRE_SLOTS = 4      # when phase active, hires get at most N slots\r\nSTRAWBERRY_PIVOT = True          # when animal phase ends, strawberries come first\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n# ---- Harvest forecast / day tracker ----\r\n# The agent forecasts which tiles will free up for replanting within\r\n# FORECAST_HORIZON_DAYS (one-time crops mature; ongoing crops banked full\r\n# yield decay to weeds). When enabled, _plan_seeds front-loads seeds for\r\n# those tiles so replanting is instant. Disabled = exact baseline behavior.\r\n# A/B result: enabling it regressed (102.2k -> 94.1k h=3 tight buffer,\r\n# 96.6k h=3, 99.0k h=1; and at LIQUIDATION_DAY=29: 113.3k h=1 vs 114.9k).\r\n# The phase planner already times seed buys well; the forecast is kept as an\r\n# opt-in tool + the per-day tracker (see _DAY_LOG).\r\nENABLE_HARVEST_FORECAST = False\r\nFORECAST_HORIZON_DAYS = 1        # look-ahead window for \"tile frees soon\"\r\nFORECAST_SEED_BUFFER = 30        # money buffer when buying for forecasted tiles\r\nDEBUG_DAY_LOG = True            # print a one-line-per-day tracker to stdout\r\n\r\n# ---- Forecast-driven hiring (separate knob from seed front-loading) ----\r\n# When ON, _desired_hands adds extra hands for tiles that will free within the\r\n# horizon: each freed tile becomes a replant (PLANT + several WATER actions),\r\n# and the base crew heuristic (active_crops only) under-counts that upcoming\r\n# load. FORECAST_HANDS_DIVISOR = freed tiles per extra hand (higher = fewer\r\n# hands). Purely experimental: the A/B test (see AGENTS.md) decides whether\r\n# this knob stays ON.\r\nFORECAST_DRIVES_HANDS = False\r\nFORECAST_HANDS_DIVISOR = 8\r\n\r\n# ---- User overrides (optional, agent falls back to its own plan) ----\r\n# Force a seed priority with a dict:\r\n#   \"CROP\": {\"start_day\": 11, \"end_day\": 99, \"priority\": 10, \"max_batch\": 8}\r\n#   start_day/end_day -> only buy this crop's seeds inside that day window\r\n#   priority          -> higher = earlier in the buy order (default 0)\r\n#   max_batch         -> cap one order's seed count (default SEED_BATCHES)\r\n# An override NEVER bypasses the planner's own gates (money, tile headroom,\r\n# plantability window). If the override is impossible or inefficient, the\r\n# agent falls back to its own calculation. {} = no overrides (pure planner).\r\nSEED_OVERRIDES = {}\r\n\r\n# ---- Land expansion ----\r\n# MAX_QUADRANTS: how many quadrants we will ever unlock. NW is always free\r\n# (unlocked_cnt starts at 1); LAND_ORDER after that is NE(1000), SW(2000),\r\n# SE(4000). The 4th quadrant (SE, cost 4000) was long rejected as too\r\n# expensive for the payoff window, but with the mid-game gate below it is a\r\n# tunable knob: buy it only \"in the middle of full throttle\" (day >=\r\n# QUADRANT_4_START_DAY) when the strawberry ramp is generating cash and the\r\n# new tiles will actually be planted/watered. Q4 adds 25 tiles of plantable\r\n# land; once unlocked, _generate_tasks plants them automatically.\r\nMAX_QUADRANTS = 3   # cap on unlocked_cnt (1 + bought quadrants)\r\n# NOTE: QUADRANT_4_UNLOCK=True overrides this to 4 at plan time — see\r\n# _plan_land: \"max_quads = 4 if (QUADRANT_4_UNLOCK and MAX_QUADRANTS < 4)\".\r\nQUADRANT_4_UNLOCK = True          # allow the SE (4000) buy when gate passes\r\nQUADRANT_4_START_DAY = 8 # earliest day to spend the 4000 (mid-game)\r\nQUADRANT_4_HANDS_CAP = 14         # hands cap once 4 quadrants are open\r\n# Minimum payoff window for any land buy; last buy day = 30 - this.\r\nLAND_PAYOFF_WINDOW_DAYS = 12\r\n\r\n# ---- Market forecast / expense projection ----\r\n# The town drain is DETERMINISTIC (shops every 4 steps, town center every 12\r\n# steps with a day-scaled multiplier), so the agent can project tomorrow's\r\n# market inventory and prices exactly from obs.market.inventory. The mirror\r\n# tables below replicate _game_src.SHOPS / TOWN_CENTER_*; the projection is\r\n# used for awareness (day tracker) and, behind knobs, for spend decisions.\r\nSHOPS_DRAIN = {\r\n    \"BAKERY\":         [\"EGG\", \"WHEAT\"],\r\n    \"PIZZA_SHOP\":     [\"MILK\", \"TOMATO\", \"WHEAT\"],\r\n    \"BRUNCH_SPOT\":    [\"EGG\", \"WHEAT\", \"STRAWBERRY\"],\r\n    \"YARN_STORE\":     [\"WOOL\"],\r\n    \"ICE_CREAM_SHOP\": [\"STRAWBERRY\", \"MILK\", \"WHEAT\"],\r\n    \"PET_CAFE\":       [\"CARROT\"],\r\n    \"SMOOTHIE_SHOP\":  [\"STRAWBERRY\", \"MILK\"],\r\n    \"FARMERS_MARKET\": [\"WHEAT\", \"CARROT\", \"TOMATO\", \"STRAWBERRY\"],\r\n}\r\nTOWN_CENTER_PRODUCTS = [p for p in BASE_PRICE if p != \"FERTILIZER\"]\r\nTOWN_CENTER_DEMAND = [(20, 4), (10, 2), (0, 1)]\r\n\r\n# When ON, _plan_market reserves tomorrow's required crew + feed wheat before\r\n# any animal/seed buys, so today's spending never eats tomorrow's payroll.\r\nRESERVE_NEXT_DAY_EXPENSES = False\r\n\r\n# ---- Market-driven buy priority (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON, the per-turn budget ranks SEED vs ANIMAL buys by projected marginal\r\n# profit over the remaining season (product price trajectory from\r\n# _project_prices x expected yields) instead of the fixed animals-first order.\r\n# This is the first \"freeform\" unlock: the agent computes WHAT to buy from the\r\n# forecast. Day-0 opening stays hard-locked. A/B gate: 3 runs vs ~115.5k OFF.\r\nMARKET_DRIVEN_BUYS = False\r\n# Max market orders the engine accepts per turn (buys + sells share the slot).\r\nMARKET_ORDER_BUDGET = 8        # more market orders fewer, better-timed orders)\r\nMARKET_DRIVEN_MIN_PROFIT = 0       # only buy if projected profit >= this\r\n\r\n# ---- Opponent crop counter (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# The counter is a TIMING RACE, not an avoidance: when the opponent mass-\r\n# produces a crop, the highest-profit route is often to grow the SAME crop and\r\n# MASS-SELL BEFORE their wave hits the shared market (their first harvest\r\n# lands later than ours -> we sell into scarcity, they dump into our glut).\r\n# Detection is early (their visible planted_day + true first_yield_day gives\r\n# their first harvest day by day 1-3), the decision FREEZES once at\r\n# CROP_COUNTER_FREEZE_DAY and is never re-litigated (the opponent's true\r\n# strategy is unknown; our solid plan is early detection + early prediction).\r\n# Reporting-only under ENABLE_OPPONENT_ANALYSIS; actions gate behind\r\n# OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER.\r\nOPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER = True\r\nCROP_COUNTER_FREEZE_DAY = 11     # decision freezes at the day-11 phase cutover\r\nCROP_COUNTER_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS = 3  # we dump an item only if our harvest lands >=\r\n                                 # this many days before the opponent's\r\nCROP_COUNTER_MIN_UNITS = 20      # opponent must project >= this many units to\r\n                                 # count as a real market wave (else ignore)\r\n\r\n# ---- Opponent analysis layer (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON, the agent reads the PUBLIC opponent farm (obs[\"farms\"][opponent_id]:\r\n# money, tiles/crops/animals, unlocked quadrants, hires) and computes a lane\r\n# map: what the opponent is producing, when their harvests/sell waves land, and\r\n# per-item projected market impact. This is the foundation for counter-picking\r\n# (go WOOL when they go MILK, avoid STRAWBERRY they own, spam-and-dump a crop\r\n# we can harvest first). REPORTING-ONLY for now — it logs to _DAY_LOG but does\r\n# NOT change any action. Strategy wiring comes after this layer is validated.\r\nENABLE_OPPONENT_ANALYSIS = True\r\n\r\n# ---- Early-game prediction scanners (reporting-only, ON) ----\r\n# The early-game advantage is SITUATIONAL AWARENESS: these scanners read the\r\n# current board/market/opponent and project what tomorrow and the season end\r\n# look like, so the bot has control over market prices, opponent dump waves,\r\n# next-day job counts, and outcome. All reporting-only — they land in _DAY_LOG\r\n# and do not change actions (the action wiring is gated behind the specific\r\n# strategy knobs above/below). Turn OFF to restore the silent baseline.\r\nENABLE_EARLY_SCANNERS = True\r\n\r\n# ---- Opponent counter-pick strategy (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON, the agent reacts to the opponent's projected lane (from the\r\n# analysis layer above): if the opponent is mass-producing MILK at meaningful\r\n# scale, we buy SHEEP (WOOL) before COW so we sell into the scarce premium\r\n# while they flood MILK. A/B gate: 3-run top1-replay must not regress below\r\n# OFF (~95.2k) AND harness >= ~115.5k mean. Only active when\r\n# ENABLE_OPPONENT_ANALYSIS is also ON (we need the lane map to react to).\r\nOPPONENT_COUNTER_PICK = False\r\nOPPONENT_COUNTER_MIN_UNITS = 8   # opponent MILK units before we switch to WOOL\r\n\r\n# ---- Price-gated task priorities (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON, tasks whose product is selling at a scarcity premium get a small\r\n# priority boost: normal WATER on a premium crop (strawberry at 2.1x base) and\r\n# CARE on a high-milk/wool animal are nudged above their same-tier peers.\r\n# Hard caps keep the boost from ever crossing a survival tier:\r\n#   - normal WATER 97 -> max 98 (still below critical WATER 98? no: ties it;\r\n#     capped so it NEVER exceeds critical survival water)\r\n#   - CARE 94 -> max 95 (below normal FEED 96, so feeding still wins)\r\n# Rationale: price-aware selling already captures the price, but WORKERS still\r\n# spend the same time on premium vs cheap crops; this steers labor toward the\r\n# premium products. A/B: OFF is the verified 116k baseline.\r\nPRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES = False\r\nPRICE_BOOST_THRESHOLD = 1.5     # price/base ratio that earns a priority boost\r\nPRICE_BOOST_AMOUNT = 1          # priority points added per qualifying item\r\n\r\n# ---- Recovery/demand-aware selling (control knob, ON after user wiring) ----\r\n# When ON, _build_sell_orders ALSO uses the shop-demand + price-recovery\r\n# forecasts (Pillar 1/4 from the competition briefing) on top of the\r\n# marginal-price floor:\r\n#   - SHORT recovery time (fast town drain -> price keeps climbing): HOLD,\r\n#     sell the normal budget — the climb continues, don't forfeit it.\r\n#   - LONG recovery time (slow drain -> our own supply will crash the price):\r\n#     sell MORE now (up to the budget multiplier), because the premium is\r\n#     fleeting — the market won't pay this much again for days.\r\n#   - HIGH demand rate on MILK/WOOL (their shops unlocked): the drain is real,\r\n#     holding milk/wool is right. LOW demand rate (no milk/wool shops): the\r\n#     price climb is town-center-only, so sell earlier.\r\n# This gives the agent CONTROL over milk/wool sell timing from the shops'\r\n# demand, exactly the briefing's Pillar-3 \"demand-driven sales\".\r\nRECOVERY_AWARE_SELL = True\r\nRECOVERY_HOLD_STEPS = 24         # recovery < this -> HOLD (normal budget)\r\nRECOVERY_DUMP_STEPS = 60         # recovery > this -> accelerate (budget x mult)\r\nRECOVERY_DUMP_MULT = 2           # budget multiplier when recovery is long\r\nRECOVERY_DEMAND_HOLD = 0.25      # demand rate >= this on an item -> HOLD\r\n\r\n# ---- Early-sell timing vs opponent dump (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# The early game (days 1-6) is a CASH TROUGH: money runs 238->110->77->44\r\n# until melon wave-1 lands. The opponent's visible farm tells us when THEIR\r\n# first harvest/dump hits the shared market (_opponent_dump_timing). When a\r\n# product we hold would CRASH after their dump (price_after_dump < price_now)\r\n# and their dump is imminent (within EARLY_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS), sell ours FIRST\r\n# — into the pre-dump price — so the early cash arrives before the market\r\n# collapses. This is the \"dump-before-them\" timing race the user wants,\r\n# scoped to the early trough (unlike OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER which fires any\r\n# season for premium items). Includes WHEAT/CARROT (the early waves).\r\n# A/B: TESTED 2026-08-09, REJECTED (-2,489 replay). The top-1 dumps WHEAT day 2\r\n# (84 units); selling OUR wheat into that window forfeits the wheat climb\r\n# (100%->192%). Knob stays OFF for re-tuning.\r\nEARLY_DUMP_TIMING = True\r\nEARLY_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS = 1         # dump within this many days -> accelerate now\r\nEARLY_DUMP_END_DAY = 6           # only apply in the early trough window\r\nEARLY_DUMP_MIN_UNITS = 20         # opponent dump must be >= this to matter\r\n\r\n# ---- Skip watering at max yield (control knob, ON by default) ----\r\n# A plant whose yield_units has already reached CROP_MAX_YIELID is a wasted\r\n# WATER action: watering does nothing further for it, only HARVEST matters\r\n# from here on. This is a pure action-economy fix with no strategic\r\n# trade-off (the forum action-economy analysis: actions are the real\r\n# constraint), so it defaults ON unlike the other gap knobs below.\r\nSKIP_WATER_AT_MAX_YIELD = True\r\n\r\n# ---- Profit-per-action task priority (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON, same-tier WATER tasks (age > 0, non-survival) and same-tier CARE\r\n# tasks get a small priority nudge toward the crop/animal with the higher\r\n# projected $/worker-action (see _profit_per_action_map), instead of every\r\n# crop/animal getting the same flat tier priority. Hard-capped identically to\r\n# PRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES (WATER -> max 98, CARE -> max 95) so it can never\r\n# cross a survival tier. The two knobs stack via max(), not addition.\r\nPROFIT_PER_ACTION_PRIORITY = True\r\n\r\n# ---- Opponent-aware buy-side price projection (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# When ON and MARKET_DRIVEN_BUYS is also ON, the animal-vs-seed marginal\r\n# profit ranking projects prices with the opponent's forecast sell waves\r\n# included (_opponent_sell_waves), not just our town-drain-only projection.\r\n# Their future supply pushes prices down, so a crop/animal that looks\r\n# profitable against town-drain-only can be re-ranked once their dump is\r\n# priced in. Needs ENABLE_OPPONENT_ANALYSIS ON to have any effect.\r\nOPPONENT_AWARE_BUY_PROJECTION = False\r\n\r\n# ---- Dynamic (economic) game-phase detection (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# _game_phase's EARLY/MID/LATE_GAME cutover is a fixed day. When ON, a strong\r\n# cash/strawberry position can PULL the phase earlier (never later — the\r\n# fixed-day cutover stays the floor, so a slow start never regresses below\r\n# the tuned baseline). Feeds _phase_buy_crops' PRIORITY_SEEDS lookup.\r\nDYNAMIC_GAME_PHASE = False\r\nDYNAMIC_PHASE_MONEY = {\"MID_GAME\": 1500, \"LATE_GAME\": 4000}\r\nDYNAMIC_PHASE_STRAWBERRY = 4     # active strawberries that also pull LATE_GAME\r\n\r\n# ---- Forced animal buys when the buy window is closing (control knob, OFF) ----\r\n# _last_profitable_buy_day already gates individual buys; this layer makes\r\n# room for them. If COW/SHEEP's profitable window closes within URGENCY_DAYS,\r\n# today's hires are capped so the market-slot budget isn't fully consumed by\r\n# hires before the animal buy can claim a slot.\r\nURGENT_ANIMAL_WINDOW = False\r\nURGENCY_DAYS = 3\r\nURGENT_HIRE_CAP = 1\r\n\r\n# ---- Day-0 dynamic animal count (control knob, OFF by default) ----\r\n# The user wants the forecast to decide fixed constraints like \"max animals\".\r\n# A pure MAX_ANIMALS knob is a NO-OP (the planner never buys animals mid-game —\r\n# hires eat all 7 market slots, and _should_buy_animal's profit gate rejects\r\n# late buys). The real day-0 lever is the ANIMAL COUNT in the opening. This\r\n# knob projects milk/wool prices at first-yield (day 6-8) and, when the\r\n# premium is projected WEAK, picks a lighter opening (fewer animals, same\r\n# melon/wheat budget) so the cash isn't locked into a herd that won't pay\r\n# back. Only SHRINKS from VERIFIED — never grows — so the cash runway lesson\r\n# (LOW_CASH_RUNWAY) is never violated. When the signal is neutral/strong the\r\n# verified 2S+2C opening is kept exactly.\r\nDYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS = False\r\nDAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO = 1.05    # milk OR wool projected ratio < this at first\r\n                                 # yield -> herd won't pay -> shrink animals\r\nDAY0_ANIMAL_FIRST_YIELD = 6      # SHEEP first yield (earliest animal income)\r\n\r\n# ---- Demand-aware seed BUYING (control knob, ON after user wiring) ----\r\n# The mirror image of RECOVERY_AWARE_SELL on the BUY side: a crop whose\r\n# product has HIGH shop demand (many active shops consume it -> the town\r\n# drains it fast -> price climbs) is worth buying/planting MORE, because the\r\n# demand is real and the harvest will sell into a climbing market. A crop\r\n# with only town-center demand (weak drain) is less attractive — buy the\r\n# verified default volume instead.\r\n# Implementation (reorders the same budget, never changes total spend):\r\n#   - _seed_buy_order sorts the phase plan's priority by the crop's demand\r\n#     rate (high-demand crops bought FIRST), then falls back to the phase\r\n#     order for ties / no-demand items.\r\n#   - _plan_seeds allows a DEMAND_BATCH_MULT larger batch for high-demand\r\n#     crops (more seeds when the market rewards the crop), still capped by\r\n#     money / headroom / timing gates.\r\nDEMAND_AWARE_BUYS = False\r\nDEMAND_BUY_THRESHOLD = 0.25      # demand rate >= this -> \"high demand\" crop\r\nDEMAND_BATCH_MULT = 1.5          # batch multiplier for high-demand crops\r\n# DEMAND_SPECIES_PICK: when ON (and the demand signal is available), the\r\n# animal planner buys the species whose product the shops demand most first\r\n# (cows when milk is in demand, sheep when wool is, geese when eggs are).\r\n# This is the user's \"day 9: focus on cows if milk in demand, sheep if wool\r\n# in demand\" — a species ORDER change, NOT a herd-size change (unlike the\r\n# rejected demand-driven animal CAP). Kept ON (low risk, reorders only).\r\nDEMAND_SPECIES_PICK = True\r\n# Max EXTRA animals bought mid-game by the demand-driven expansion (beyond the\r\n# day-0 herd). A/B 2026-08-09: +4 chased the milk/wool demand and cost ~7k;\r\n# +2 is the tuned middle ground — captures the demand premium without\r\n# starving the strawberry ramp.\r\nDEMAND_ANIMAL_EXPANSION = 0\r\n# Size of the verified day-0 herd (2 SHEEP + 2 COW). The demand-driven\r\n# expansion lets the total herd grow to DAY0_HERD + DEMAND_ANIMAL_EXPANSION.\r\nDAY0_HERD = 4\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# PASTURE TILES (EDIT HERE)\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# Tiles STRICTLY reserved for pastures – no crops can ever be planted here.\r\nPASTURE_ONLY_TILES = {\r\n    (3,3), (3,4), (4,3), (4,4), (2,4), (4,2),            # NW\r\n    (5, 3), (6,3), (5, 4), (6, 4), (5, 2)                                    # SW\r\n    # SE left empty (never bought)\r\n}\r\n\r\n# ---- Geese / coop integration (user strategy 2026-08-09) ----\r\n# The Goose is the cheapest (300) animal with the FASTEST payout (4-day TTFY,\r\n# daily production) and its Egg is GLUT-RESILIENT (log-shaped price curve —\r\n# absorbs oversupply gently vs milk/wool crashing to $1). The 5-Pillar case:\r\n#   - daily CARE+FEED cycle doubles yield to 2 eggs/day (1 base + 1 bonus)\r\n#   - every goose also produces 1 fertilizer/day ($100 base) regardless of\r\n#     care -> ~$200 gross/day vs $25 feed\r\n#   - Bakery + Brunch Spot drain eggs; town center scales x1/x2/x4 at\r\n#     days 0/10/20 -> store eggs early, liquidate after day 20\r\n# Coops are built on these reserved tiles (near the shed, not pasture). Each\r\n# goose needs one coop tile, mirroring the pasture system.\r\nCOOP_ONLY_TILES = {\r\n    (2,2), (2,3), (3,2),            # NW, near shed, not pasture\r\n}\r\nENABLE_GEESE = False               # OFF = verified baseline (A/B -10k harness / -7k replay)\r\n# When ON + ENABLE_GEESE: geese activate only if an egg-demanding shop\r\n# (Bakery/Brunch) unlocked by day 8. TESTED 2026-08-09: still regresses ~10k\r\n# even when egg demand fires (coop tiles + worker time > egg+fert income).\r\n# Kept OFF; the conditional is wired for future re-tuning.\r\nGEESE_DEMAND_ENABLE = False\r\n# Geese are a LATE-GAME play: buy them only from this day so the early\r\n# milk/crop ramp is never starved (A/B 2026-08-09: buying geese days 5-8\r\n# cost -10k). Day 18 leaves ~11 days of egg production into the day-20+\r\n# town-center demand spike.\r\nGOOSE_START_DAY = 18\r\n# From GOOSE_START_DAY, hires are capped at this many market slots so the\r\n# late-game goose buys get budget (the documented \"hires eat all 7 slots\"\r\n# wall otherwise makes geese dead code). 4 keeps the core crew; the extra\r\n# slots go to BUY_ANIMAL GOOSE.\r\nLATE_GAME_HIRE_CAP = 4\r\n# Geese get their OWN herd cap (they live on separate COOP tiles, so they\r\n# don't compete with the cow/sheep pasture cap MAX_ANIMALS=8). 3 coops are\r\n# reserved; buying more geese than coops just waits in the shed.\r\nGOOSE_MAX = 3\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# STRATEGY DEFINITIONS\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# What each named strategy in CONFIG[\"STRATEGY_STACK\"] actually controls.\r\n# Add new strategies here (or edit these) — CONFIG[\"STRATEGY_STACK\"] is the\r\n# only thing that needs to change to use them.\r\nSTRATEGY_DEFINITIONS = {\r\n    \"balanced\": {\r\n        # Keeps the verified defaults untouched. Always safe as a base.\r\n        \"max_animals\": MAX_ANIMALS,\r\n        \"early_animal_rush\": EARLY_ANIMAL_RUSH,\r\n        \"enable_animals\": ENABLE_ANIMALS,\r\n        \"seed_priority_boost\": [],\r\n        \"hand_bias\": 0,\r\n    },\r\n    \"full_animal\": {\r\n        # Go all-in on livestock: raise the herd ceiling, rush early animal\r\n        # buys, and lean on the demand-driven herd cap.\r\n        \"max_animals\": MAX_ANIMALS_DEMAND_CAP,\r\n        \"early_animal_rush\": True,\r\n        \"enable_animals\": True,\r\n        \"seed_priority_boost\": [],\r\n        \"hand_bias\": 0,\r\n    },\r\n    \"crop_focus\": {\r\n        # Skip animals entirely; every coin and every hand goes to crops.\r\n        \"max_animals\": 0,\r\n        \"early_animal_rush\": False,\r\n        \"enable_animals\": False,\r\n        \"seed_priority_boost\": [\"MELON\", \"STRAWBERRY\"],\r\n        \"hand_bias\": 1,\r\n    },\r\n}\r\n\r\nclass StrategyManager:\r\n    \"\"\"Wraps STRATEGY_DEFINITIONS + CONFIG['STRATEGY_STACK'] so strategies can\r\n    be toggled on/off or reordered without touching any other part of the\r\n    file. enable()/disable()/set_stack() mutate CONFIG['STRATEGY_STACK'] in\r\n    place, so every existing call site (which reads CONFIG live via\r\n    _strategy_effects()) picks up the change on the very next call.\"\"\"\r\n\r\n    def __init__(self, definitions, config):\r\n        self.definitions = definitions\r\n        self.config = config\r\n\r\n    def available(self):\r\n        \"\"\"Names of every strategy that could be added to the stack.\"\"\"\r\n        return list(self.definitions.keys())\r\n\r\n    def active_stack(self):\r\n        \"\"\"Currently-enabled strategy names, in apply order.\"\"\"\r\n        return list(self.config.get(\"STRATEGY_STACK\") or [])\r\n\r\n    def enable(self, name):\r\n        \"\"\"Turn a strategy ON (append to the stack) if it isn't already.\"\"\"\r\n        if name in self.definitions and name not in self.active_stack():\r\n            self.config.setdefault(\"STRATEGY_STACK\", []).append(name)\r\n\r\n    def disable(self, name):\r\n        \"\"\"Turn a strategy OFF (remove from the stack) if present.\"\"\"\r\n        stack = self.config.get(\"STRATEGY_STACK\")\r\n        if stack and name in stack:\r\n            stack.remove(name)\r\n\r\n    def set_stack(self, names):\r\n        \"\"\"Replace the whole stack at once, in the given order.\"\"\"\r\n        self.config[\"STRATEGY_STACK\"] = [n for n in names if n in self.definitions]\r\n\r\n    def effects(self):\r\n        \"\"\"Fold the active stack into one effective-settings dict.\r\n        Strategies are applied in list order: for any plain (scalar) setting\r\n        the LAST strategy in the stack wins; 'seed_priority_boost' lists are\r\n        combined across the whole stack instead of overwritten, so stacking\r\n        strategies layers their crop preferences rather than discarding\r\n        earlier ones.\"\"\"\r\n        effects = dict(self.definitions.get(\"balanced\", {}))\r\n        effects[\"seed_priority_boost\"] = []\r\n        for name in self.active_stack():\r\n            cfg = self.definitions.get(name)\r\n            if not cfg:\r\n                continue\r\n            for key, value in cfg.items():\r\n                if key == \"seed_priority_boost\":\r\n                    for crop in value:\r\n                        if crop not in effects[\"seed_priority_boost\"]:\r\n                            effects[\"seed_priority_boost\"].append(crop)\r\n                else:\r\n                    effects[key] = value\r\n        return effects\r\n\r\n\r\nSTRATEGIES = StrategyManager(STRATEGY_DEFINITIONS, CONFIG)\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _strategy_effects():\r\n    \"\"\"Back-compat shim — every existing call site uses this name.\"\"\"\r\n    return STRATEGIES.effects()\r\n\r\ndef _daily_overrides(day):\r\n    \"\"\"DAILY_OVERRIDES entry for this day (int day OR (start,end) range keys),\r\n    merged LIFO across matching ranges, or {} if none is configured.\"\"\"\r\n    table = CONFIG.get(\"DAILY_OVERRIDES\", {}) or {}\r\n    out = {}\r\n    for key, value in table.items():\r\n        if _override_day_match(key, day) and isinstance(value, dict):\r\n            out.update(value)\r\n    return out\r\n\r\ndef _game_phase(day):\r\n    \"\"\"Which PRIORITY_SEEDS bucket `day` falls into, per GAME_PHASE_DAYS.\"\"\"\r\n    bounds = CONFIG.get(\"GAME_PHASE_DAYS\", {})\r\n    if day < bounds.get(\"EARLY_GAME_END\", 6):\r\n        return \"EARLY_GAME\"\r\n    if day < bounds.get(\"MID_GAME_END\", 12):\r\n        return \"MID_GAME\"\r\n    return \"LATE_GAME\"\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _detect_game_phase: Economic-state game-phase detector (Gap 4).\r\ndef _detect_game_phase(day, money=0.0, active_crops=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Dynamic PRIORITY_SEEDS phase: _game_phase's cutover is a fixed day,\r\n    but a strong cash/strawberry position can justify pivoting earlier (e.g.\r\n    a big day-10 melon harvest funding the strawberry ramp before day 12).\r\n    Gated by DYNAMIC_GAME_PHASE; when OFF this returns exactly _game_phase's\r\n    verdict. When ON, the dynamic verdict can only PULL the phase EARLIER,\r\n    never later — the fixed-day rule stays the floor, so a slow start never\r\n    regresses below the tuned fixed-day baseline.\"\"\"\r\n    fixed = _game_phase(day)\r\n    if not DYNAMIC_GAME_PHASE:\r\n        return fixed\r\n    active_crops = active_crops or {}\r\n    order = [\"EARLY_GAME\", \"MID_GAME\", \"LATE_GAME\"]\r\n    if money >= DYNAMIC_PHASE_MONEY.get(\"LATE_GAME\", 4000) or \\\r\n       active_crops.get(\"STRAWBERRY\", 0) >= DYNAMIC_PHASE_STRAWBERRY:\r\n        dynamic = \"LATE_GAME\"\r\n    elif money >= DYNAMIC_PHASE_MONEY.get(\"MID_GAME\", 1500):\r\n        dynamic = \"MID_GAME\"\r\n    else:\r\n        dynamic = \"EARLY_GAME\"\r\n    return dynamic if order.index(dynamic) > order.index(fixed) else fixed\r\n\r\ndef _max_hands_per_day():\r\n    return max(1, _int(CONFIG.get(\"MAX_HANDS_PER_DAY\", HANDS_CAP), HANDS_CAP))\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# HELPER FUNCTIONS\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\ndef _pass():\r\n    return {\"farmer\": [\"PASS\"], \"hands\": [], \"market\": []}\r\n\r\ndef _geese_on():\r\n    \"\"\"Runtime goose switch. When GEESE_DEMAND_ENABLE is ON, geese activate\r\n    only if an egg-demanding shop (Bakery/Brunch Spot) unlocked early; else\r\n    they stay OFF (the verified -10k regression). A/B 2026-08-09: geese\r\n    regress even when Bakery+Brunch are unlocked (egg income ~$5-6k can't\r\n    offset the coop tiles + worker time), so this knob defaults OFF.\"\"\"\r\n    return _GEESE_ACTIVE\r\n\r\ndef _safe_get(d, key, default):\r\n    if isinstance(d, dict):\r\n        return d.get(key, default)\r\n    return default\r\n\r\ndef _int(value, default=0):\r\n    try:\r\n        if value is None:\r\n            return default\r\n        return int(value)\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        return default\r\n\r\ndef _float(value, default=0.0):\r\n    try:\r\n        if value is None:\r\n            return default\r\n        return float(value)\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        return default\r\n\r\ndef _is_sequence(obj):\r\n    return isinstance(obj, (list, tuple))\r\n\r\ndef _in_bounds(tiles, x, y):\r\n    try:\r\n        return 0 <= y < len(tiles) and 0 <= x < len(tiles[y])\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        return False\r\n\r\ndef _step_towards(fx, fy, tx, ty):\r\n    if tx < fx: return [\"WEST\"]\r\n    if tx > fx: return [\"EAST\"]\r\n    if ty < fy: return [\"NORTH\"]\r\n    if ty > fy: return [\"SOUTH\"]\r\n    return [\"PASS\"]\r\n\r\ndef _safe_step_towards(fx, fy, tx, ty, tiles):\r\n    \"\"\"Return the first walkable step toward (tx,ty), else PASS.\"\"\"\r\n    preferred = _step_towards(fx, fy, tx, ty)\r\n    if preferred == [\"PASS\"]:\r\n        return [\"PASS\"]\r\n    # Check preferred direction\r\n    dx, dy = 0, 0\r\n    if preferred[0] == \"WEST\":  dx = -1\r\n    elif preferred[0] == \"EAST\": dx = 1\r\n    elif preferred[0] == \"NORTH\": dy = -1\r\n    elif preferred[0] == \"SOUTH\": dy = 1\r\n    if _in_bounds(tiles, fx+dx, fy+dy) and tiles[fy+dy][fx+dx] != \"LOCKED\":\r\n        return preferred\r\n    # If blocked, try all other directions in any order\r\n    for dir in ([\"WEST\"], [\"EAST\"], [\"NORTH\"], [\"SOUTH\"]):\r\n        if dir == preferred:\r\n            continue\r\n        dx, dy = 0, 0\r\n        if dir[0] == \"WEST\":  dx = -1\r\n        elif dir[0] == \"EAST\": dx = 1\r\n        elif dir[0] == \"NORTH\": dy = -1\r\n        elif dir[0] == \"SOUTH\": dy = 1\r\n        if _in_bounds(tiles, fx+dx, fy+dy) and tiles[fy+dy][fx+dx] != \"LOCKED\":\r\n            return dir\r\n    return [\"PASS\"]\r\n\r\ndef _manhattan(a, b):\r\n    return abs(a[0] - b[0]) + abs(a[1] - b[1])\r\n\r\ndef _fib_cost(n):\r\n    a, b = 1, 1\r\n    for _ in range(max(0, n)):\r\n        a, b = b, a + b\r\n    return a\r\n\r\ndef _quadrant(x, y, tiles):\r\n    half = max(1, len(tiles) // 2)\r\n    if x < half and y < half: return QUAD_NW\r\n    if x >= half and y < half: return QUAD_NE\r\n    if x < half and y >= half: return QUAD_SW\r\n    return QUAD_SE\r\n\r\ndef _is_plant(tile):\r\n    return isinstance(tile, dict) and _safe_get(tile, \"kind\", \"\") == \"PLANT\"\r\n\r\ndef _is_weed(tile):\r\n    return isinstance(tile, dict) and _safe_get(tile, \"kind\", \"\") == \"WEED\"\r\n\r\ndef _plant_ready(tile, day):\r\n    crop = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n    yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n    pd = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", 0), 0)\r\n    age = max(0, day - pd)\r\n    if crop in ONGOING_CROPS:\r\n        return yu > 0\r\n    md = CROP_MAX_DAY.get(crop, 4)\r\n    my = CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(crop, 4)\r\n    # The GAME's HARVEST no-ops if age < first_yield_day (melons accumulate\r\n    # yield 6 by day 8 but only mature day 10 — see _game_src line 397).\r\n    # Requiring maturity here stops workers from walking to immature melons\r\n    # every hour (wasted ~20 actions/day, the empty-tile gap days 8-9).\r\n    first_yield = CROP_FIRST_YIELD.get(crop, md)\r\n    return yu > 0 and age >= first_yield and (age >= md or yu >= my)\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# AGENT SCANNERS & FORECASTERS MODULE\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# Every function tagged \"# [SCANNER] name: description\" below (they stay\r\n# next to the code that consumes their outputs, rather than being physically\r\n# relocated, so nothing downstream has to change) is a read-only state\r\n# evaluator: it looks at obs/tiles/market/opponent state and returns a\r\n# forecast or summary, and NEVER mutates state or emits orders itself. The\r\n# agent() loop calls these first each turn, then hands the results to the\r\n# strategy/override layer to act on. Full index (also see each function's\r\n# own tag + docstring for detail):\r\n#\r\n#   FARM STATE            _scan_active_crops, _forecast_free_tiles,\r\n#                          _forecast_next_day_actions, _tile_distance_map,\r\n#                          _late_game_utilization\r\n#   OUTCOME PROJECTION     _project_outcome, _project_expenses,\r\n#                          _projected_price_at, _projected_marginal_profit\r\n#   MARKET / PRICE         _market_demand_rate, _price_recovery_time,\r\n#                          _price_trend, _infer_opponent_activity\r\n#   ANIMAL / GOOSE         _animal_phase_active, _animal_phase_report,\r\n#                          _goose_profitability\r\n#   OPPONENT INTEL         _scan_opponent_farm, _opponent_product_schedule,\r\n#                          _opponent_lane_analysis, _opponent_sell_waves,\r\n#                          _opponent_dump_timing, _our_first_harvest,\r\n#                          _counter_decision, _get_counter_decision\r\n#   DAY-0 PLANNING         _day0_scanner, _day0_animal_strategy\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _scan_active_crops: Counts active (planted, non-weed) crops per type across all tiles.\r\ndef _scan_active_crops(tiles):\r\n    active = {}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles): return active\r\n    for row in tiles:\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row): continue\r\n        for tile in row:\r\n            if _is_plant(tile):\r\n                c = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                active[c] = active.get(c, 0) + 1\r\n    return active\r\n\r\ndef _count_placed_animals(tiles):\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict)\r\n               and t.get(\"kind\") in (\"PASTURE\", \"COOP\") and t.get(\"animal\"))\r\n\r\ndef _count_owned_animals(tiles, shed=None, inventories=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Total herd = placed animals + animals still sitting in the shed\r\n    (bought but not yet placed) + animals currently CARRIED by workers\r\n    (picked up from the shed, not yet placed on a pasture). All three\r\n    groups need pasture space, feed and care, so hiring/feeding should\r\n    look at the whole herd, not just the tiles already stocked.\r\n    `inventories` is the private unit-inventory list; carried animals\r\n    appear there as COW/SHEEP/GOOSE (verified in-game: workers carry\r\n    animals for a few turns between shed pickup and pasture placement).\"\"\"\r\n    placed = _count_placed_animals(tiles)\r\n    total = placed\r\n    if isinstance(shed, dict):\r\n        total += (_int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_COW, 0), 0)\r\n                  + _int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_SHEEP, 0), 0)\r\n                  + (_int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_GOOSE, 0), 0) if _geese_on() else 0))\r\n    if _is_sequence(inventories):\r\n        for inv in inventories:\r\n            if not isinstance(inv, dict):\r\n                continue\r\n            total += (_int(_safe_get(inv, ANIMAL_COW, 0), 0)\r\n                      + _int(_safe_get(inv, ANIMAL_SHEEP, 0), 0)\r\n                      + (_int(_safe_get(inv, ANIMAL_GOOSE, 0), 0) if _geese_on() else 0))\r\n    return total\r\n\r\ndef _count_empty_pastures(tiles):\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get(\"kind\") == \"PASTURE\" and not t.get(\"animal\"))\r\n\r\ndef _count_pastures(tiles):\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get(\"kind\") == \"PASTURE\")\r\n\r\ndef _count_coops(tiles):\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get(\"kind\") == \"COOP\")\r\n\r\ndef _count_placed_geese(tiles):\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict)\r\n               and t.get(\"kind\") == \"COOP\" and t.get(\"animal\") == ANIMAL_GOOSE)\r\n\r\ndef _count_placed_species(tiles, animal):\r\n    \"\"\"Placed animals of one species (COW/SHEEP/GOOSE) on tiles.\"\"\"\r\n    return sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n               for t in row if isinstance(t, dict)\r\n               and t.get(\"kind\") in (\"PASTURE\", \"COOP\") and t.get(\"animal\") == animal)\r\n\r\ndef _desired_hands(day, money, active_crops, placed_animals, forecast_free=None,\r\n                   unlocked_cnt=3, owned_animals=None):\r\n    if day >= LIQUIDATION_DAY: return 2\r\n    total = sum(active_crops.values()) if isinstance(active_crops, dict) else 0\r\n    herd = owned_animals if owned_animals is not None else placed_animals\r\n    if day <= 1: base = 5\r\n    elif day <= 5: base = 3 + total // 6 + herd // 4\r\n    elif day <= 10: base = 5 + total // 5 + herd // 3\r\n    else: base = 7 + total // 5 + herd // 2\r\n    base += _strategy_effects()[\"hand_bias\"]\r\n    if FORECAST_DRIVES_HANDS and isinstance(forecast_free, dict):\r\n        # Tiles freeing within the horizon become replant work (PLANT + a few\r\n        # days of WATER). The base heuristic only counts *currently planted*\r\n        # tiles, so add hands for the upcoming load. Divisor = freed tiles per\r\n        # extra hand; larger = more conservative.\r\n        upcoming = sum(forecast_free.values())\r\n        if upcoming > 0:\r\n            base += max(1, (upcoming + FORECAST_HANDS_DIVISOR - 1) // FORECAST_HANDS_DIVISOR)\r\n    floor = 3 if day <= 5 else 2\r\n    # 4th quadrant opens 25 more plantable tiles -> allow a bigger crew so the\r\n    # new land is actually watered (user: \"open more hired hands if needed\").\r\n    cap = QUADRANT_4_HANDS_CAP if (QUADRANT_4_UNLOCK and unlocked_cnt >= 4) else HANDS_CAP\r\n    cap = min(cap, _max_hands_per_day())\r\n    want = max(floor, min(cap, base))\r\n    # HANDS_EXACT / HANDS_MIN / HANDS_MAX overrides (day or range keys).\r\n    exact = _override_lookup(\"HANDS_EXACT\", day)\r\n    if exact is not None:\r\n        want = _int(exact, want)\r\n    low = _override_lookup(\"HANDS_MIN\", day)\r\n    if low is not None:\r\n        want = max(want, _int(low, want))\r\n    high = _override_lookup(\"HANDS_MAX\", day)\r\n    if high is not None:\r\n        want = min(want, _int(high, want))\r\n    return want\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# TURN-AWARE BUDGET PLANNER\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# One place that decides ALL market spending for the current turn, so the\r\n# agent plans as a whole instead of buying pieces ad hoc. Every decision is\r\n# turn-aware: value decays with remaining time because\r\n#   - a hand hired at hour 20 only works ~4 hours but costs the same\r\n#     Fibonacci wage as one hired at hour 0;\r\n#   - an animal bought with < first_yield_days left never pays back its cost;\r\n#   - seeds bought after MIN_PLANT_DAYS can never be harvested;\r\n#   - land bought with too few days left never hosts a harvestable crop.\r\n\r\ndef _turns_info(day, hour):\r\n    \"\"\"(hours_left_today, days_left_total) — the planning horizon.\"\"\"\r\n    hours_today = max(0, 24 - hour)\r\n    days_left = max(0, 30 - day)\r\n    return hours_today, days_left\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _forecast_free_tiles: Projects which tiles free up (harvest-ready) within a horizon of days.\r\ndef _forecast_free_tiles(tiles, day, horizon=FORECAST_HORIZON_DAYS):\r\n    \"\"\"Day tracker: count, per crop, how many plants will be harvestable\r\n    (tile frees up for replanting) within `horizon` days from today.\r\n    One-time crops (wheat/carrot/melon) free when their age reaches\r\n    CROP_MAX_DAY; ongoing crops (strawberry) free only after they have\r\n    banked max yield and decay to a weed (then get dug).\"\"\"\r\n    free = {}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles): return free\r\n    for row in tiles:\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row): continue\r\n        for tile in row:\r\n            if not _is_plant(tile): continue\r\n            c = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n            pd = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", 0), 0)\r\n            age = max(0, day - pd)\r\n            if c in ONGOING_CROPS:\r\n                yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n                if yu >= CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(c, 4):\r\n                    free[c] = free.get(c, 0) + 1\r\n            else:\r\n                md = CROP_MAX_DAY.get(c, 4)\r\n                if age >= md - horizon:\r\n                    free[c] = free.get(c, 0) + 1\r\n    return free\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _forecast_next_day_actions: Forecasts total worker actions needed tomorrow (water/harvest/feed/etc).\r\ndef _forecast_next_day_actions(tiles, day, placed_animals, active_crops=None,\r\n                               seeds=None):\r\n    \"\"\"EARLY-GAME WORKLOAD SCANNER (reporting-only): count the unit actions\r\n    tomorrow will require, from the current tile state. This is the \"count of\r\n    turns for jobs needed next day\" forecast — the crew re-hires from scratch\r\n    every morning, so knowing tomorrow's WATER/PLANT/HARVEST/FEED/CARE load\r\n    tells us how many hands the morning payroll should buy.\r\n\r\n    Counts (approximate, assuming plants age one day tonight):\r\n      WATER    = every non-ready plant not watered today (crops need water\r\n                 every day; survival only matters at consecutive_unwatered 2,\r\n                 but a full water is the safe estimate for crew sizing)\r\n      HARVEST  = every plant that will be ready tomorrow (one-time at age >=\r\n                 CROP_MAX_DAY; ongoing when yield_units > 0 already) plus\r\n                 animals with yield_units > 0\r\n      FEED     = every placed animal (1 wheat/day)\r\n      CARE     = every placed animal (care gates the bonus)\r\n      PLANT    = empty plantable tiles we would target tomorrow (from\r\n                 _crop_cap vs active) — only when seeds exist\r\n      PICKUP   = 1 per new harvest batch assumed (rough)\r\n    Returns a dict with per-type counts + total. Reported in _DAY_LOG under\r\n    ENABLE_EARLY_SCANNERS; does not change any action.\"\"\"\r\n    out = {\"WATER\": 0, \"HARVEST\": 0, \"FEED\": 0, \"CARE\": 0, \"PLANT\": 0,\r\n           \"PICKUP\": 0, \"total\": 0}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles):\r\n        return out\r\n    active = dict(active_crops) if isinstance(active_crops, dict) else None\r\n    if active is None:\r\n        active = _scan_active_crops(tiles)\r\n    for row in tiles:\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row):\r\n            continue\r\n        for tile in row:\r\n            if tile is None:\r\n                continue\r\n            if _is_plant(tile):\r\n                crop = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                pd = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", day), day)\r\n                age = max(0, day - pd)\r\n                yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n                watered = bool(_safe_get(tile, \"watered_today\", False))\r\n                if crop in ONGOING_CROPS:\r\n                    if yu > 0:\r\n                        out[\"HARVEST\"] += 1\r\n                    elif not watered:\r\n                        out[\"WATER\"] += 1\r\n                else:\r\n                    md = CROP_MAX_DAY.get(crop, 4)\r\n                    if age >= md or yu >= CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(crop, 4):\r\n                        out[\"HARVEST\"] += 1\r\n                    elif not watered:\r\n                        out[\"WATER\"] += 1\r\n            elif isinstance(tile, dict) and tile.get(\"kind\") == \"PASTURE\":\r\n                if tile.get(\"animal\"):\r\n                    if not tile.get(\"fed_today\", False):\r\n                        out[\"FEED\"] += 1\r\n                    if not tile.get(\"cared_today\", False):\r\n                        out[\"CARE\"] += 1\r\n                    if _int(tile.get(\"yield_units\", 0), 0) > 0:\r\n                        out[\"HARVEST\"] += 1\r\n    # Tomorrow's plant work: tiles that free up today/tomorrow minus active.\r\n    seeds = seeds if isinstance(seeds, dict) else {}\r\n    if any(_int(v, 0) > 0 for v in seeds.values()):\r\n        have = sum(_int(v, 0) for v in seeds.values())\r\n        # Rough: we would plant up to the smallest of seeds / freed tiles.\r\n        freed = sum(_forecast_free_tiles(tiles, day, 1).values())\r\n        plant = max(0, min(have, freed))\r\n        out[\"PLANT\"] = plant\r\n    out[\"total\"] = (out[\"WATER\"] + out[\"HARVEST\"] + out[\"FEED\"] +\r\n                    out[\"CARE\"] + out[\"PLANT\"])\r\n    return out\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _project_outcome: Projects end-of-game money/inventory outcome from current trajectory.\r\ndef _project_outcome(day, money, active_crops, placed_animals, global_inv,\r\n                     market_prices, unlocked_cnt=3, seeds=None):\r\n    \"\"\"OUTCOME PREDICTION SCANNER (reporting-only): project the final bank\r\n    balance at season end from today's position. Uses the verified mid-game\r\n    earnings rates: the tuned farm makes ~1.1k-1.3k/day in the strawberry\r\n    ramp, plus animal premium revenue. This is a coarse sanity gauge (not a\r\n    planner input) — it answers \"are we on track for 100k?\" each morning.\r\n\r\n    Returns dict: {projected_final, today, days_left, daily_rate, backlog,\r\n    note}. Reported in _DAY_LOG under ENABLE_EARLY_SCANNERS.\"\"\"\r\n    days_left = max(0, 30 - day)\r\n    # Current cash + shed/inventory resale value (conservative: 60% of base).\r\n    backlog = 0\r\n    if isinstance(global_inv, dict):\r\n        for item, qty in global_inv.items():\r\n            backlog += _int(qty, 0) * int(BASE_PRICE.get(item, 25) * 0.6)\r\n    seeds_val = 0\r\n    if isinstance(seeds, dict):\r\n        for crop, qty in seeds.items():\r\n            seeds_val += _int(qty, 0) * SEED_COST.get(crop, 10)\r\n    # Daily rate: animals produce continuously; crops produce per schedule.\r\n    # Use a conservative blended estimate that scales with what's on the board.\r\n    base_daily = 500\r\n    crop_rate = sum(active_crops.values()) * 18   # ~18 coins/tile/day mid-game\r\n    animal_rate = placed_animals * 45             # milk/wool + fertilizer\r\n    daily_rate = base_daily + crop_rate + animal_rate\r\n    if day >= 25:\r\n        # Endgame: most crops mature/decay, animals keep producing.\r\n        daily_rate = daily_rate * 0.6\r\n    projected = money + backlog + seeds_val + daily_rate * max(0, days_left - 1)\r\n    note = \"on_track\" if projected >= 100000 else \"below_target\"\r\n    return {\r\n        \"projected_final\": int(projected),\r\n        \"today\": int(money),\r\n        \"days_left\": days_left,\r\n        \"daily_rate\": int(daily_rate),\r\n        \"backlog\": int(backlog),\r\n        \"seeds_val\": int(seeds_val),\r\n        \"note\": note,\r\n    }\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _tile_distance_map: Builds a distance-from-shed map for every tile (routing/priority aid).\r\ndef _tile_distance_map(tiles, unlocked_set=None):\r\n    \"\"\"TILE-DISTANCE SCANNER (reporting-only): precompute the Manhattan\r\n    distance from the shed to EVERY unlocked tile, and summarize per-quadrant\r\n    utilization. The user asked \"can the pathway of every hand be scanned?\" —\r\n    this is the visibility layer: which tiles are far (expensive to work),\r\n    which are empty-but-reachable, and how movement maps to each quadrant.\r\n    Returns {dist_to_shed: {quadrant: count}, far_tiles: [...], empty: n,\r\n    unlocked: n, avg_dist, max_dist}.\"\"\"\r\n    out = {\"dist_to_shed\": {}, \"far_tiles\": [], \"empty\": 0, \"unlocked\": 0,\r\n           \"avg_dist\": 0.0, \"max_dist\": 0}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles):\r\n        return out\r\n    quads = unlocked_set if isinstance(unlocked_set, (set, list, tuple)) and unlocked_set else None\r\n    total_d = 0\r\n    n = 0\r\n    for y, row in enumerate(tiles):\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row):\r\n            continue\r\n        for x, tile in enumerate(row):\r\n            if tile == \"LOCKED\":\r\n                continue\r\n            pos = (x, y)\r\n            if quads is not None and _quadrant(x, y, tiles) not in quads:\r\n                continue\r\n            out[\"unlocked\"] += 1\r\n            d = _manhattan(pos, SHED_POS)\r\n            q = _quadrant(x, y, tiles)\r\n            bucket = out[\"dist_to_shed\"].setdefault(q, {})\r\n            bucket[d] = bucket.get(d, 0) + 1\r\n            total_d += d\r\n            n += 1\r\n            if d >= 6:\r\n                out[\"far_tiles\"].append((pos, d))\r\n            if tile is None:\r\n                out[\"empty\"] += 1\r\n    if n:\r\n        out[\"avg_dist\"] = round(total_d / float(n), 2)\r\n        out[\"max_dist\"] = max((d for _, d in out[\"far_tiles\"]), default=0)\r\n    return out\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _late_game_utilization: Scans how much late-game tile capacity is going unused.\r\ndef _late_game_utilization(tiles, day, seeds, active_crops=None, unlocked_cnt=3):\r\n    \"\"\"LATE-GAME UTILIZATION SCANNER (reporting-only): count how many tiles\r\n    will be EMPTY in the final week (days 24-29) that could still host a\r\n    harvestable crop. The user observed tiles sitting unused days 24-29 and\r\n    asked whether a 1-day crop (wheat/carrot) could fill them. This scanner\r\n    reports:\r\n      - empty_now: unlocked empty tiles today\r\n      - will_free: tiles occupied by plants that will finish by day 29\r\n      - plantable_late: crops still plantable by the deadline (wheat needs 5\r\n        days left, carrot 4, melon/strawberry 11 -> only wheat/carrot in the\r\n        last week) AND their seeds available\r\n      - utilization: occupied / unlocked now\r\n    It is the \"what's going to be left on the late game\" calculation the user\r\n    wants thought out BEFORE the game begins.\"\"\"\r\n    out = {\"empty_now\": 0, \"occupied\": 0, \"unlocked\": 0, \"will_free\": 0,\r\n           \"plantable_late\": {}, \"utilization\": 0.0}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles):\r\n        return out\r\n    active = dict(active_crops) if isinstance(active_crops, dict) else _scan_active_crops(tiles)\r\n    seeds = seeds if isinstance(seeds, dict) else {}\r\n    for y, row in enumerate(tiles):\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row):\r\n            continue\r\n        for x, tile in enumerate(row):\r\n            if tile == \"LOCKED\":\r\n                continue\r\n            pos = (x, y)\r\n            out[\"unlocked\"] += 1\r\n            if tile is None:\r\n                out[\"empty_now\"] += 1\r\n                continue\r\n            out[\"occupied\"] += 1\r\n            if _is_plant(tile):\r\n                c = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                pd = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", day), day)\r\n                age = max(0, day - pd)\r\n                if c in ONGOING_CROPS:\r\n                    # strawberry/tomato keep producing until their yield cap\r\n                    yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n                    if yu < CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(c, 4):\r\n                        out[\"will_free\"] += 1   # still productive -> keeps tile busy\r\n                    else:\r\n                        out[\"will_free\"] += 1   # will decay to weed by end\r\n                else:\r\n                    md = CROP_MAX_DAY.get(c, 4)\r\n                    if age < md:\r\n                        out[\"will_free\"] += 1   # matures and frees before end\r\n    # What can still be planted in the final week?\r\n    for crop in (\"WHEAT\", \"CARROT\", \"MELON\", \"STRAWBERRY\"):\r\n        need = MIN_PLANT_DAYS.get(crop, 5)\r\n        days_left = max(0, 30 - day)\r\n        if days_left >= need:\r\n            have = _int(seeds.get(crop, 0), 0)\r\n            out[\"plantable_late\"][crop] = have\r\n    if out[\"unlocked\"]:\r\n        out[\"utilization\"] = round(out[\"occupied\"] / float(out[\"unlocked\"]), 2)\r\n    return out\r\n\r\ndef _available_plant_tiles(tiles, day, unlocked_set=None):\r\n    \"\"\"TILE-AVAILABILITY SCANNER (reporting + seed-planning input): count\r\n    tiles that can host a NEW plant:\r\n      - empty_now: unlocked empty tiles (no weed, no structure)\r\n      - freeing_soon: plants ready to harvest TODAY or TOMORROW (their tile\r\n        frees for replant) — the \"plants for harvest the next day\" term\r\n      - weeds: weeds that must be dug first (they OCCUPY a tile until dug)\r\n      - net_available: empty_now + freeing_soon (weeds not counted — they\r\n        block until dug)\r\n    The user's rule: \"buys should always depend on empty tiles + plants for\r\n    harvest the next day + weeds.\" This is the capacity that seed buys feed.\"\"\"\r\n    out = {\"empty_now\": 0, \"freeing_soon\": 0, \"weeds\": 0, \"net_available\": 0}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles):\r\n        return out\r\n    quads = unlocked_set if isinstance(unlocked_set, (set, list, tuple)) and unlocked_set else None\r\n    for y, row in enumerate(tiles):\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row):\r\n            continue\r\n        for x, tile in enumerate(row):\r\n            if tile == \"LOCKED\":\r\n                continue\r\n            if quads is not None and _quadrant(x, y, tiles) not in quads:\r\n                continue\r\n            if tile is None:\r\n                out[\"empty_now\"] += 1\r\n            elif _is_weed(tile):\r\n                out[\"weeds\"] += 1\r\n            elif _is_plant(tile):\r\n                crop = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                pd = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", day), day)\r\n                age = max(0, day - pd)\r\n                yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n                md = CROP_MAX_DAY.get(crop, 4)\r\n                if crop in ONGOING_CROPS:\r\n                    # Ongoing crops (strawberry/tomato) do NOT free their tile\r\n                    # after a normal harvest — they keep producing until they\r\n                    # bank max yield and decay. Counting every yu>0 plant as\r\n                    # freeing_soon overestimated planting capacity (FIX:\r\n                    # mirrors _forecast_free_tiles, same max-yield gate).\r\n                    if yu >= CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(crop, 4):\r\n                        out[\"freeing_soon\"] += 1\r\n                elif age >= md - 1 or yu >= CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(crop, 4):\r\n                    out[\"freeing_soon\"] += 1       # frees today/tomorrow\r\n    out[\"net_available\"] = out[\"empty_now\"] + out[\"freeing_soon\"]\r\n    return out\r\n\r\ndef _plan_land(day, unlocked_cnt, money):\r\n    \"\"\"Buy land only when it still has time to pay back (each quadrant needs\r\n    several days of planting before first harvest). The 4th quadrant (SE,\r\n    4000) is gated by QUADRANT_4_UNLOCK + QUADRANT_4_START_DAY so it is bought\r\n    mid-game (\"middle of full throttle\") instead of starving the early cash\r\n    engine — the strawberry ramp pays for it, and the new tiles get planted\r\n    automatically once unlocked.\"\"\"\r\n    if day >= LIQUIDATION_DAY:\r\n        return None, money\r\n    max_quads = 4 if (QUADRANT_4_UNLOCK and MAX_QUADRANTS < 4) else MAX_QUADRANTS\r\n    if unlocked_cnt >= max_quads:\r\n        return None, money\r\n    # Q4 gate: only mid-game, once the strawberry ramp is flowing.\r\n    if unlocked_cnt >= 3 and day < QUADRANT_4_START_DAY:\r\n        return None, money\r\n    cost = {1: 1000, 2: 2000, 3: 4000}.get(unlocked_cnt)\r\n    if cost is None: return None, money\r\n    _, days_left = _turns_info(day, 0)\r\n    if days_left < LAND_PAYOFF_WINDOW_DAYS: return None, money   # not enough payoff window\r\n    if money >= cost + 50:\r\n        return [\"BUY_LAND\"], money - cost\r\n    return None, money\r\n\r\ndef _plan_hires(day, money, active_crops, placed_animals, hires_today,\r\n                forecast_free=None, unlocked_cnt=3, tiles=None, seeds=None,\r\n                day_hour=0, current_hands=0, hire_cap_override=None,\r\n                owned_animals=None):\r\n    \"\"\"How many hands to hire RIGHT NOW, given money and the full-day crew\r\n    target. Hands are re-hired each morning and topped up as money arrives\r\n    after selling; the tuned crew size was verified optimal season-long.\r\n    Hires get first claim on the market budget (they were the first orders in\r\n    the original loop and could consume all 7 slots on quiet days).\r\n    forecast_free (when FORECAST_DRIVES_HANDS) adds hands for tiles that will\r\n    free up within the horizon — upcoming replant + watering work.\r\n    WORKLOAD_DRIVES_HANDS: when ON, the next-day action forecast\r\n    (_forecast_next_day_actions) sets a CREW FLOOR — each hand does ~24\r\n    actions/day, so next_actions_total/24 is the minimum crew that can finish\r\n    tomorrow's work.
