fd) // a_interval\r\n            cur = prod.setdefault(product, {\"first_day\": fd, \"units\": 0,\r\n                                            \"ongoing\": True})\r\n            cur[\"units\"] += n\r\n            cur[\"first_day\"] = min(cur[\"first_day\"], fd)\r\n    return prod\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _opponent_lane_analysis: Summarizes which product lane(s) the opponent is leaning into.\r\ndef _opponent_lane_analysis(scan, day):\r\n    \"\"\"Highest-level lane summary for the day tracker:\r\n      {\"top\": product, \"top_units\": n, \"schedule\": {product: ...}}\r\n    Also marks our own counterpick target when the opponent is massing an item\r\n    we don't need to match (computed downstream, not here).\"\"\"\r\n    sched = _opponent_product_schedule(scan, day)\r\n    if not sched:\r\n        return {\"top\": None, \"top_units\": 0, \"schedule\": {}}\r\n    top = max(sched.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1][\"units\"])\r\n    return {\"top\": top[0], \"top_units\": top[1][\"units\"], \"schedule\": sched}\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _opponent_sell_waves: Forecasts when the opponent is likely to dump inventory.\r\ndef _opponent_sell_waves(scan, day):\r\n    \"\"\"Per-product future SELL waves from the opponent's visible farm:\r\n      {product: [(day, units), ...]}\r\n    Convert the production schedule into the daily market supply they will\r\n    dump. One-time crops land as a lump on first_day (they sell the whole\r\n    harvest); ongoing crops/animals tick a unit every interval. Days < today\r\n    are dropped (already sold / consumed by the town). This is the `opp_waves`\r\n    argument consumed by _project_market_inventory / _project_prices.\"\"\"\r\n    sched = _opponent_product_schedule(scan, day)\r\n    waves = {}\r\n    for product, rec in sched.items():\r\n        fd = rec[\"first_day\"]\r\n        total = rec[\"units\"]\r\n        if fd < day or total <= 0:\r\n            continue\r\n        if rec[\"ongoing\"]:\r\n            # ongoing: distribute units across harvest days from first_day.\r\n            # We only know the total, so spread it evenly per interval using\r\n            # the schedule's own interval math (1 unit per tick per plant is\r\n            # the game's rule; the total already sums that up).\r\n            interval = {\"STRAWBERRY\": 2, \"TOMATO\": 1,\r\n                        PRODUCT_MILK: 2, PRODUCT_WOOL: 3, PRODUCT_EGG: 1}.get(product, 2)\r\n            days = list(range(fd, 30, interval))\r\n            if not days:\r\n                continue\r\n            # distribute total across the harvest days, remainder on the first\r\n            per = total // len(days)\r\n            rem = total % len(days)\r\n            for i, d in enumerate(days):\r\n                u = per + (1 if i < rem else 0)\r\n                if u > 0:\r\n                    waves.setdefault(product, []).append((d, u))\r\n        else:\r\n            waves.setdefault(product, []).append((fd, total))\r\n    return waves\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _opponent_dump_timing: Times our own sells against the opponent's projected dump.\r\ndef _opponent_dump_timing(scan, market_inv, day, hour, unlocked_shops):\r\n    \"\"\"SELL-side counter timing (user insight 2026-08-09): instead of trying\r\n    to dump BEFORE the opponent (usually impossible — they plant earlier), we\r\n    compute the price trajectory AFTER their next dump, then re-project for\r\n    the BEST sell window BEFORE the dump that follows it.\r\n\r\n    Returns {product: {\"next_dump_day\": d, \"units\": u,\r\n                       \"price_now\": ratio, \"best_before_dump\": ratio,\r\n                       \"best_day\": d, \"price_after_dump\": ratio}}\r\n    `price_after_dump` includes the opponent's projected supply; `best_*` is\r\n    the highest price we can still catch before the wave lands. Reporting-only\r\n    Phase 1 tool — no sell order depends on it yet.\"\"\"\r\n    waves = _opponent_sell_waves(scan, day)\r\n    if not waves:\r\n        return {}\r\n    plan = {}\r\n    for product, entries in waves.items():\r\n        if not entries:\r\n            continue\r\n        # next dump day for this product\r\n        next_day = entries[0][0]\r\n        next_units = entries[0][1]\r\n        if product not in BASE_PRICE:\r\n            continue\r\n        base = BASE_PRICE[product]\r\n        price_now = _market_price(product, market_inv.get(product, MARKET_I0))\r\n        steps_to_dump = max(1, (next_day - day) * 24 - hour)\r\n        # Price AFTER their dump: town drain + their supply to dump day.\r\n        proj_after = _project_prices(market_inv, day, hour, steps_to_dump,\r\n                                     unlocked_shops, {product: [(next_day, next_units)]})\r\n        price_after_dump = proj_after.get(product, base)\r\n        # Best window BEFORE the dump: scan the trajectory up to the dump day\r\n        # (opponent supply excluded — that is the window we would sell into).\r\n        best_price = price_now\r\n        best_day = day\r\n        for ahead in range(12, steps_to_dump, 12):\r\n            proj = _project_prices(market_inv, day, hour, ahead, unlocked_shops)\r\n            p = proj.get(product, base)\r\n            if p > best_price:\r\n                best_price = p\r\n                best_day = day + ahead // 24\r\n        plan[product] = {\r\n            \"next_dump_day\": next_day,\r\n            \"units\": next_units,\r\n            \"price_now\": round(price_now / base, 2),\r\n            \"best_before_dump\": round(best_price / base, 2),\r\n            \"best_day\": best_day,\r\n            \"price_after_dump\": round(price_after_dump / base, 2),\r\n        }\r\n    return plan\r\n\r\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n# Crop counter-pick: TIMING RACE vs the opponent's production lanes\r\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\r\n# Core idea (user directive 2026-08-09): the counter is NOT avoidance. If the\r\n# opponent mass-produces a crop, the highest-profit route is often to grow the\r\n# SAME crop and MASS-SELL BEFORE their wave hits the shared market. We sell\r\n# into scarcity, they dump into the glut we left behind. Detection is early\r\n# (their visible planted_day + true first_yield_day => their first harvest\r\n# day by day 1-3); the decision FREEZES once at CROP_COUNTER_FREEZE_DAY and is\r\n# never re-litigated (we cannot know their true strategy; our solid plan is\r\n# early detection + early prediction, per the user).\r\n_COUNTER_DECISION = {}   # frozen once at the freeze day; never re-litigated\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _our_first_harvest: Finds the day of our own first harvest, per crop.\r\ndef _our_first_harvest(tiles, day):\r\n    \"\"\"Earliest day each product can first be harvested on OUR farm, from\r\n    what is already planted/placed today plus what we could still plant today.\r\n    Returns {product: day} using true _game_src timings (planted_day +\r\n    first_yield; animal placed_day + first yield day).\"\"\"\r\n    res = {}\r\n    if _is_sequence(tiles):\r\n        for row in tiles:\r\n            if not _is_sequence(row):\r\n                continue\r\n            for tile in row:\r\n                if not isinstance(tile, dict):\r\n                    continue\r\n                if tile.get(\"kind\") == \"PLANT\":\r\n                    c = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                    if c in CROP_FIRST_YIELD:\r\n                        fd = _int(tile.get(\"planted_day\", day), day) + CROP_FIRST_YIELD[c]\r\n                        if c not in res or fd < res[c]:\r\n                            res[c] = fd\r\n                elif tile.get(\"animal\"):\r\n                    a = tile.get(\"animal\")\r\n                    a_first = {ANIMAL_COW: 8, ANIMAL_SHEEP: 6, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 4}.get(a)\r\n                    product = {ANIMAL_COW: PRODUCT_MILK, ANIMAL_SHEEP: PRODUCT_WOOL, ANIMAL_GOOSE: PRODUCT_EGG}.get(a)\r\n                    if a_first and product:\r\n                        fd = _int(tile.get(\"placed_day\", day), day) + a_first\r\n                        if product not in res or fd < res[product]:\r\n                            res[product] = fd\r\n    # crops we could still plant today (soonest possible first harvest)\r\n    for c in CROP_FIRST_YIELD:\r\n        if day + CROP_FIRST_YIELD[c] < 30:\r\n            res.setdefault(c, day + CROP_FIRST_YIELD[c])\r\n    return res\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _counter_decision: Decides a counter-play against the opponent's detected lane.\r\ndef _counter_decision(scan, tiles, day, market_inv, unlocked_shops, hour=8):\r\n    \"\"\"TIMING-RACE decision vs the opponent's production lanes.\r\n\r\n    Returns:\r\n      {\"route\": crop, \"route_ratio\": float,   # highest-profit lane GIVEN both\r\n       \"dump_before\": [products we harvest >= lead days earlier than them],\r\n       \"avoid\": [products they harvest first AND mass at scale],\r\n       \"frozen_day\": int}\r\n    Route = the crop with the best projected price/base at our harvest window\r\n    (the town-drain projection already IS the trajectory; per the user, if\r\n    strawberry is still the highest profit given the opponent's trajectory we\r\n    PURSUE it — their supply does not crash a high-demand market, measured\r\n    STRAWBERRY 1.0 -> 2.12x even while the top-1 opponent massed 168 units).\r\n    dump_before/avoid are TIMING signals only: they say whether a mass-sell\r\n    BEFORE their wave is possible (we harvest first) or whether their glut\r\n    lands before our next harvest (hold/sell early, don't stack more).\"\"\"\r\n    sched = _opponent_product_schedule(scan, day)\r\n    our_h = _our_first_harvest(tiles, day)\r\n    dump_before, avoid = [], []\r\n    for product, rec in sched.items():\r\n        if rec[\"units\"] < CROP_COUNTER_MIN_UNITS:\r\n            continue\r\n        opp_first = rec[\"first_day\"]\r\n        our_first = our_h.get(product)\r\n        if our_first is None:\r\n            continue\r\n        lead = our_first - opp_first          # negative => we harvest earlier\r\n        if lead <= -CROP_COUNTER_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS:\r\n            dump_before.append(product)\r\n        elif lead >= CROP_COUNTER_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS:\r\n            avoid.append(product)\r\n\r\n    proj = {}\r\n    if market_inv:\r\n        try:\r\n            proj = _project_prices(market_inv, day, hour,\r\n                                   max(1, int(12 * 24)), unlocked_shops)\r\n        except Exception:\r\n            proj = {}\r\n    best_route, best_score = None, -1.0\r\n    for crop in (\"STRAWBERRY\", \"MELON\", \"WHEAT\", \"CARROT\", \"TOMATO\"):\r\n        base = BASE_PRICE.get(crop, 50)\r\n        p = proj.get(crop, base)\r\n        ratio = p / base if base else 1.0\r\n        if ratio > best_score:\r\n            best_score, best_route = ratio, crop\r\n    return {\"route\": best_route, \"route_ratio\": best_score,\r\n            \"dump_before\": dump_before, \"avoid\": avoid,\r\n            \"frozen_day\": day}\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _get_counter_decision: Cached/frozen wrapper around _counter_decision (decide-once).\r\ndef _get_counter_decision(scan, tiles, day, market_inv, unlocked_shops, hour=8):\r\n    \"\"\"Frozen accessor: computes the decision once at CROP_COUNTER_FREEZE_DAY\r\n    (or the first later call), then returns the cached decision forever.\r\n    Early detection, early prediction, no mid-game re-litigation.\"\"\"\r\n    global _COUNTER_DECISION\r\n    if _COUNTER_DECISION:\r\n        return _COUNTER_DECISION\r\n    if day < CROP_COUNTER_FREEZE_DAY:\r\n        return {}\r\n    try:\r\n        _COUNTER_DECISION = _counter_decision(scan, tiles, day,\r\n                                              market_inv, unlocked_shops,\r\n                                              hour)\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        _COUNTER_DECISION = {}\r\n    return _COUNTER_DECISION\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# TASK GENERATION\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\ndef _generate_tasks(tiles, day, target_crops, plant_budget, new_plant_limits,\r\n                    shed, unit_inventories, unlocked_set, expected_workers,\r\n                    market_prices=None, profit_map=None):\r\n    empty_pastures = []\r\n    empty_coops = []\r\n    tasks = []\r\n    planted_this_turn = {}\r\n    if not _is_sequence(tiles): return tasks\r\n    # Animal stock\r\n    shed_cows = _int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_COW, 0), 0)\r\n    shed_sheep = _int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_SHEEP, 0), 0)\r\n    shed_geese = _int(_safe_get(shed, ANIMAL_GOOSE, 0), 0) if _geese_on() else 0\r\n    shed_wheat = _int(_safe_get(shed, \"WHEAT\", 0), 0)\r\n    shed_fert = _int(_safe_get(shed, \"FERTILIZER\", 0), 0)\r\n\r\n    c_cow = c_sheep = c_goose = c_wheat = c_fert = 0\r\n\r\n    for inv in unit_inventories:\r\n        if isinstance(inv, dict):\r\n            c_cow += _int(inv.get(ANIMAL_COW, 0), 0)\r\n            c_sheep += _int(inv.get(ANIMAL_SHEEP, 0), 0)\r\n            if _geese_on():\r\n                c_goose += _int(inv.get(ANIMAL_GOOSE, 0), 0)\r\n            c_wheat += _int(inv.get(\"WHEAT\", 0), 0)\r\n            c_fert += _int(inv.get(\"FERTILIZER\", 0), 0)\r\n\r\n    total_cows = shed_cows + c_cow\r\n    total_sheep = shed_sheep + c_sheep\r\n    total_geese = (shed_geese + c_goose) if _geese_on() else 0\r\n    empty_past = _count_empty_pastures(tiles)\r\n\r\n    # Count unwatered plants\r\n    unwatered = sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n                    for t in row if _is_plant(t) and not _safe_get(t, \"watered_today\", False))\r\n    plant_capacity = max(8, expected_workers * 4)\r\n\r\n    cows2place = total_cows\r\n    sheep2place = total_sheep\r\n    geese2place = total_geese\r\n    plantable = []\r\n\r\n    for y, row in enumerate(tiles):\r\n        if not _is_sequence(row): continue\r\n        for x, tile in enumerate(row):\r\n            if tile == \"LOCKED\": continue\r\n            pos = (x, y)\r\n\r\n            if tile is None:\r\n                if pos in PASTURE_ONLY_TILES and not PASTURE_UNLOCK:\r\n                    # Always create a BUILD_PASTURE task\r\n                    tasks.append({\r\n                        \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"BUILD_PASTURE\",\r\n                        \"priority\": BUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY,\r\n                        \"tokens\": [\"BUILD_PASTURE\"],\r\n                    })\r\n                    continue   # NEVER plant here (unless PASTURE_UNLOCK)\r\n                if _geese_on() and pos in COOP_ONLY_TILES:\r\n                    # Build a coop for a goose (mirrors the pasture system).\r\n                    if total_geese > 0:\r\n                        tasks.append({\r\n                            \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"BUILD_COOP\",\r\n                            \"priority\": BUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY,\r\n                            \"tokens\": [\"BUILD_COOP\"],\r\n                        })\r\n                        continue\r\n                if target_crops:\r\n                    plantable.append(pos)\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n            if _is_weed(tile):\r\n                tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"DIG\", \"priority\": 20, \"tokens\": [\"DIG\"]})\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n            if isinstance(tile, dict) and tile.get(\"kind\") in (\"PASTURE\", \"COOP\"):\r\n                animal = tile.get(\"animal\")\r\n                if animal:\r\n                    if not tile.get(\"fed_today\", False):\r\n                        consec_feed = _int(tile.get(\"consecutive_unfed\", 0), 0)\r\n                        if consec_feed >= 1:\r\n                            # SURVIVAL: animal escapes at consecutive_unfed >= 2\r\n                            pr = 99\r\n                        else:\r\n                            pr = 96\r\n                        tasks.append({\r\n                            \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"FEED\", \"priority\": pr,\r\n                            \"tokens\": [\"FEED\"], \"req\": \"WHEAT\",\r\n                            \"survival\": consec_feed >= 1,\r\n                        })\r\n                    if not tile.get(\"cared_today\", False):\r\n                        # Care gates the double-yield bonus; nudge it up when\r\n                        # the animal's product is selling at a premium. Capped\r\n                        # at 95 = still below normal FEED 96, so feeding wins.\r\n                        # PRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES and PROFIT_PER_ACTION_PRIORITY\r\n                        # stack via max(), never additively.\r\n                        care_pr = 94\r\n                        care_boost = 0\r\n                        care_prod = {ANIMAL_COW: PRODUCT_MILK, ANIMAL_SHEEP: PRODUCT_WOOL, ANIMAL_GOOSE: PRODUCT_EGG}.get(animal, PRODUCT_EGG)\r\n                        if PRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES:\r\n                            care_boost = max(care_boost, _price_boost_for(care_prod, market_prices))\r\n                        if PROFIT_PER_ACTION_PRIORITY and isinstance(profit_map, dict):\r\n                            care_boost = max(care_boost, _profit_rank_boost(animal, profit_map.get(\"care\", {})))\r\n                        care_pr = min(95, care_pr + care_boost)\r\n                        tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"CARE\", \"priority\": care_pr,\r\n                                      \"tokens\": [\"CARE\"]})\r\n                    if tile.get(\"yield_units\", 0) > 0:\r\n                        tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"HARVEST_ANIMAL\", \"priority\": 95,\r\n                                      \"tokens\": [\"HARVEST\"]})\r\n                    if tile.get(\"fertilizer_available\", False):\r\n                        tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"COLLECT_FERTILIZER\", \"priority\": 82,\r\n                                      \"tokens\": [\"COLLECT_FERTILIZER\"]})\r\n                else:\r\n                    if tile.get(\"kind\") == \"COOP\":\r\n                        empty_coops.append((x, y))\r\n                    else:\r\n                        empty_pastures.append((x, y))\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n            if _is_plant(tile):\r\n                if _plant_ready(tile, day):\r\n                    tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"HARVEST\", \"priority\": 100,\r\n                                  \"tokens\": [\"HARVEST\"]})\r\n                else:\r\n                    watered = bool(_safe_get(tile, \"watered_today\", False))\r\n                    tile_crop = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                    tile_yu = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"yield_units\", 0), 0)\r\n                    # Gap 3: a plant already at its max yield gets nothing\r\n                    # further from another WATER — that action is wasted and\r\n                    # better spent elsewhere. Only skip when NOT in survival\r\n                    # danger (consecutive_unwatered can still kill the plant\r\n                    # even after max yield, so survival watering still fires).\r\n                    maxed_out = (SKIP_WATER_AT_MAX_YIELD and\r\n                                tile_yu >= CROP_MAX_YIELD.get(tile_crop, 4))\r\n                    if not watered and not maxed_out:\r\n                        age = max(0, day - _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", 0), 0))\r\n                        consec = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"consecutive_unwatered\", 0), 0)\r\n                        if consec >= 1:\r\n                            # SURVIVAL: crop dies at consecutive_unwatered >= 2\r\n                            wp = 98\r\n                        elif age == 0: wp = 100\r\n                        else:\r\n                            wp = 97\r\n                            # Premium crop: nudge normal watering up, capped at\r\n                            # 98 so it can never displace a survival water.\r\n                            # PRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES and PROFIT_PER_ACTION_\r\n                            # PRIORITY are two independent boost sources; they\r\n                            # stack via max(), never additively.\r\n                            crop = tile_crop\r\n                            boost = 0\r\n                            if PRICE_GATED_PRIORITIES:\r\n                                boost = max(boost, _price_boost_for(crop, market_prices))\r\n                            if PROFIT_PER_ACTION_PRIORITY and isinstance(profit_map, dict):\r\n                                boost = max(boost, _profit_rank_boost(crop, profit_map.get(\"crop\", {})))\r\n                            wp = min(98, wp + boost)\r\n                        tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"WATER\", \"priority\": wp,\r\n                                      \"tokens\": [\"WATER\"],\r\n                                      \"survival\": consec >= 1})\r\n                    elif not watered and maxed_out:\r\n                        # Still guard against death: if unwatered streak is\r\n                        # already dangerous, water anyway (survival > savings).\r\n                        consec = _int(_safe_get(tile, \"consecutive_unwatered\", 0), 0)\r\n                        if consec >= 1:\r\n                            tasks.append({\"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"WATER\", \"priority\": 98,\r\n                                          \"tokens\": [\"WATER\"], \"survival\": True})\r\n                    if ENABLE_FERTILIZER_CROP_USE:\r\n                        crop = _safe_get(tile, \"crop\", \"WHEAT\")\r\n                        age = max(0, day - _int(_safe_get(tile, \"planted_day\", 0), 0))\r\n                        can_fert = False\r\n                        if crop == \"MELON\" and 5 <= age <= 9: can_fert = True\r\n                        elif crop == \"STRAWBERRY\" and 8 <= age <= 15: can_fert = True\r\n                        elif crop == \"WHEAT\" and 2 <= age <= 3: can_fert = True\r\n                        elif crop == \"CARROT\" and age == 2: can_fert = True\r\n                        if can_fert and watered:\r\n                            tasks.append({\r\n                                \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"FERTILIZE\", \"priority\": 76,\r\n                                \"tokens\": [\"FERTILIZE\"], \"req\": \"FERTILIZER\",\r\n                            })\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n    # Add planting tasks\r\n        # --- Place animals on the closest empty pastures first ---\r\n    empty_pastures.sort(key=lambda p: _manhattan(p, SHED_POS))\r\n    for pos in empty_pastures:\r\n        if cows2place > 0:\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"PLACE\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"PLACE\", ANIMAL_COW], \"req\": ANIMAL_COW,\r\n            })\r\n            cows2place -= 1\r\n        elif sheep2place > 0:\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"PLACE\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"PLACE\", ANIMAL_SHEEP], \"req\": ANIMAL_SHEEP,\r\n            })\r\n            sheep2place -= 1\r\n        else:\r\n            break\r\n    # Geese go to COOP tiles (separate list — don't mix with pasture placement).\r\n    empty_coops.sort(key=lambda p: _manhattan(p, SHED_POS))\r\n    for pos in empty_coops:\r\n        if _geese_on() and geese2place > 0:\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"PLACE\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"PLACE\", ANIMAL_GOOSE], \"req\": ANIMAL_GOOSE,\r\n            })\r\n            geese2place -= 1\r\n        else:\r\n            break\r\n    if plantable and target_crops:\r\n        plantable.sort(key=lambda p: _manhattan(p, SHED_POS))\r\n        for pos in plantable:\r\n            if unwatered >= plant_capacity: break\r\n            for crop in target_crops:\r\n                if planted_this_turn.get(crop, 0) < plant_budget.get(crop, 0):\r\n                    limit = new_plant_limits.get(crop, 999)\r\n                    if planted_this_turn.get(crop, 0) < limit:\r\n                        tasks.append({\r\n                            \"pos\": pos, \"type\": \"PLANT\", \"crop\": crop,\r\n                            \"priority\": PLANT_PRIORITY,\r\n                            \"tokens\": [\"PLANT\", crop],\r\n                        })\r\n                        planted_this_turn[crop] = planted_this_turn.get(crop, 0) + 1\r\n                        unwatered += 1\r\n                        break\r\n\r\n    # Animal pickups\r\n    if ENABLE_ANIMALS and empty_past > 0:\r\n        pickup_slots = empty_past\r\n        for _ in range(min(shed_cows, pickup_slots)):\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"PICKUP\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"PICKUP\", ANIMAL_COW, 2],\r\n            })\r\n            pickup_slots -= 1\r\n        for _ in range(min(shed_sheep, pickup_slots)):\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"PICKUP\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"PICKUP\", ANIMAL_SHEEP, 2],\r\n            })\r\n            pickup_slots -= 1\r\n        if _geese_on():\r\n            for _ in range(min(shed_geese, len(empty_coops))):\r\n                tasks.append({\r\n                    \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"PICKUP\", \"priority\": ANIMAL_PICKUP_PRIORITY,\r\n                    \"tokens\": [\"PICKUP\", ANIMAL_GOOSE, 2],\r\n                })\r\n\r\n    # Wheat / Fertilizer pickups\r\n    need_feed = sum(1 for row in tiles if _is_sequence(row)\r\n                    for t in row if isinstance(t, dict) and t.get(\"kind\") in (\"PASTURE\", \"COOP\")\r\n                    and t.get(\"animal\") and not t.get(\"fed_today\", False))\r\n    if need_feed > 0 and shed_wheat > 0 and c_wheat < need_feed:\r\n        tasks.append({\r\n            \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"PICKUP\", \"priority\": 98,\r\n            \"tokens\": [\"PICKUP\", \"WHEAT\", min(shed_wheat, need_feed)],\r\n        })\r\n    # No fertilizer pickups during liquidation: the farmer must drop-and-sell\r\n    # instead of shuttling fertilizer back and forth.\r\n    if ENABLE_FERTILIZER_CROP_USE and day < LIQUIDATION_DAY and shed_fert > 0 and c_fert < 4:\r\n        tasks.append({\r\n            \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"PICKUP\", \"priority\": 75,\r\n            \"tokens\": [\"PICKUP\", \"FERTILIZER\", min(shed_fert, 4)],\r\n        })\r\n\r\n    # Endgame liquidation: carrying units must DROP sellable produce at the shed\r\n    # so the next turn's market can sell it. Priority below FEED/CARE/HARVEST_ANIMAL\r\n    # so animals are never starved during the shutdown. `hint` binds the task to\r\n    # the unit that actually carries the items.\r\n    if day >= LIQUIDATION_DAY:\r\n        for u_idx, inv in enumerate(unit_inventories):\r\n            if not isinstance(inv, dict): continue\r\n            total = sum(_int(v, 0) for v in inv.values())\r\n            if total <= 0: continue\r\n            tasks.append({\r\n                \"pos\": SHED_POS, \"type\": \"DROP\", \"priority\": 92,\r\n                \"tokens\": [\"DROP\"], \"hint\": u_idx,\r\n            })\r\n\r\n    return tasks\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# TASK ASSIGNMENT\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\nCLAIM_BONUS = 3000\r\nCLAIM_STEAL_PENALTY = 2000\r\n\r\ndef _default_action(unit_pos, tiles):\r\n    x, y = unit_pos\r\n    if not _in_bounds(tiles, x, y): return [\"PASS\"]\r\n    tile = tiles[y][x]\r\n    if tile == \"LOCKED\":\r\n        half = max(1, len(tiles) // 2)\r\n        return _step_towards(x, y, half - 1, half - 1)\r\n    # If nothing else to do, walk toward the shed (never idle)\r\n    return _step_towards(x, y, SHED_POS[0], SHED_POS[1])\r\n\r\ndef _task_key(task):\r\n    pos = task.get(\"pos\", None)\r\n    if not _is_sequence(pos) or len(pos) < 2: return None\r\n    return (int(pos[0]), int(pos[1]), task.get(\"type\", \"\"), str(task.get(\"crop\", \"\")))\r\n\r\ndef _assign_tasks_zoned(tasks, unit_positions, tiles, unlocked_set, plant_budget,\r\n                        unit_inventories, day=-1, owned_animals=0):\r\n    global _TASK_CLAIMS\r\n    active_quadrants = [q for q in (QUAD_NW, QUAD_NE, QUAD_SW, QUAD_SE) if q in unlocked_set]\r\n    if not active_quadrants:\r\n        active_quadrants = [QUAD_NW]\r\n    unlocked_cnt = len(active_quadrants)\r\n\r\n    if _TASK_CLAIMS[\"day\"] != day:\r\n        _TASK_CLAIMS.update({\"day\": day, \"claims\": {}})\r\n    claims = _TASK_CLAIMS[\"claims\"]\r\n    valid_keys = {_task_key(t) for t in tasks if _task_key(t) is not None}\r\n    claims = {k: v for k, v in claims.items() if k in valid_keys}\r\n    new_claims = {}\r\n\r\n    # Safety filter: remove crop tasks on pasture‑only tiles (unless unlocked)\r\n    crop_actions = {\"PLANT\", \"WATER\", \"HARVEST\", \"FERTILIZE\", \"DIG\"}\r\n    reserved_tiles = set(PASTURE_ONLY_TILES)\r\n    if _geese_on():\r\n        reserved_tiles |= set(COOP_ONLY_TILES)\r\n    tasks_sorted = [t for t in tasks\r\n                    if not (t.get(\"type\") in crop_actions and\r\n                            t.get(\"pos\") is not None and\r\n                            tuple(t[\"pos\"]) in reserved_tiles\r\n                            and not PASTURE_UNLOCK)]\r\n    tasks_sorted = sorted(tasks_sorted, key=lambda t: t.get(\"priority\", 0), reverse=True)\r\n\r\n    # ----- Decide if we need an extra animal worker this turn -----\r\n    animal_task_count = 0\r\n    for t in tasks_sorted:\r\n        ttype = t.get(\"type\")\r\n        if ttype in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (ttype == \"PICKUP\" and t.get(\"req\") in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n            animal_task_count += 1\r\n    dedicated_animal_workers = 1   # farmer\r\n    if len(unit_positions) > 1:\r\n        dedicated_animal_workers += 1   # first hand\r\n    need_extra_animal_help = (animal_task_count > dedicated_animal_workers * ANIMAL_TASK_THRESHOLD_PER_WORKER)\r\n\r\n    # ---- Pre‑scan: act on current tile ----\r\n    tile_map = {}\r\n    for t in tasks_sorted:\r\n        p = t.get(\"pos\")\r\n        if p is not None: tile_map.setdefault(p, []).append(t)\r\n\r\n    unit_actions = [None] * len(unit_positions)\r\n    assigned_pos = set()\r\n    assigned_plants = {}\r\n    unit_types = [\"PASS\"] * len(unit_positions)\r\n    unit_prios = [0] * len(unit_positions)\r\n    unit_cnt = max(1, len(unit_positions))\r\n\r\n    # Pasture override: any worker on empty reserved tile builds immediately\r\n    for idx, upos in enumerate(unit_positions):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is None:\r\n            x, y = upos\r\n            if _in_bounds(tiles, x, y) and tiles[y][x] is None:\r\n                if (x, y) in PASTURE_ONLY_TILES and not PASTURE_UNLOCK:\r\n                    unit_actions[idx] = [\"BUILD_PASTURE\"]\r\n                    assigned_pos.add((x, y))\r\n                    unit_types[idx] = \"BUILD_PASTURE\"\r\n                    unit_prios[idx] = BUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY\r\n                    continue\r\n                if _geese_on() and (x, y) in COOP_ONLY_TILES:\r\n                    unit_actions[idx] = [\"BUILD_COOP\"]\r\n                    assigned_pos.add((x, y))\r\n                    unit_types[idx] = \"BUILD_COOP\"\r\n                    unit_prios[idx] = BUILD_PASTURE_PRIORITY\r\n                    continue\r\n\r\n    # Regular pre‑scan\r\n    for idx, upos in enumerate(unit_positions):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is not None: continue\r\n        if upos in tile_map:\r\n            for task in tile_map[upos]:\r\n                if task[\"pos\"] in assigned_pos: continue\r\n                # Farmer ignores crops\r\n                if idx == 0 and task.get(\"type\") in CROP_TASK_TYPES: continue\r\n                req = task.get(\"req\")\r\n                if req is not None:\r\n                    inv = unit_inventories[idx] if idx < len(unit_inventories) else {}\r\n                    if _int(inv.get(req, 0), 0) <= 0: continue\r\n                unit_actions[idx] = task[\"tokens\"]\r\n                assigned_pos.add(task[\"pos\"])\r\n                if task.get(\"type\") == \"PLANT\":\r\n                    crop = task.get(\"crop\")\r\n                    assigned_plants[crop] = assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) + 1\r\n                unit_types[idx] = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n                unit_prios[idx] = task.get(\"priority\", 0)\r\n                break\r\n\r\n    # ---- Fastest-route assignment (worker-first min-cost) ----\r\n    # Movement is unblocked on the board (LOCKED tiles only block actions, not\r\n    # walking), so the fastest route between two tiles is EXACTLY Manhattan\r\n    # distance and _step_towards is the optimal first step. Every worker scans\r\n    # every task and picks the one with the lowest route cost (distance plus\r\n    # role/zone/claim weights). Worker-first iteration is empirically better\r\n    # than task-first matching in this game: it preserves zone locality because\r\n    # each worker stays near its home quadrant while high-priority tasks still\r\n    # win via the priority term.\r\n    def _assign_cost(idx, upos, task):\r\n        tpos = task[\"pos\"]\r\n        q = _quadrant(tpos[0], tpos[1], tiles)\r\n        home = active_quadrants[idx % len(active_quadrants)]\r\n        second = active_quadrants[(idx + 1) % len(active_quadrants)] if len(active_quadrants) > 1 else home\r\n        task_type = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n        req = task.get(\"req\")\r\n\r\n        # Primary cost: exact fastest-route length (open grid), same scale as\r\n        # the old `dist * 50` term so role/zone weights keep their dominance.\r\n        # Priority is the dominant term (old `priority*1000`): urgent tasks win.\r\n        cost = _manhattan(upos, tpos) * 50.0 - task.get(\"priority\", 0) * 1000.0\r\n\r\n        # Role costs: farmer wants animal tasks, hands want crops. Matches the\r\n        # old biases (positive = expensive = avoid).\r\n        if idx == 0:\r\n            if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n                cost -= FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            elif task_type in CROP_TASK_TYPES:\r\n                cost -= FARMER_CROP_PENALTY\r\n        elif idx == 1:\r\n            if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n                cost -= FIRST_HAND_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            elif task_type in CROP_TASK_TYPES:\r\n                cost -= FIRST_HAND_CROP_PENALTY\r\n        else:\r\n            if need_extra_animal_help and idx == 2:\r\n                if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n                    cost -= EXTRA_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n            else:\r\n                if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n                    cost -= NONFARMER_ANIMAL_PENALTY\r\n                # Big herd (>10) with a hired worker tail (idx>=10): make the\r\n                # late-hired hands prefer animal tasks. Those workers are bought\r\n                # late in the season, often near the end of the animal ramp,\r\n                # when pastures/coops still need building and feeding/care load\r\n                # is at its peak. They get the same pull as the farmer so the\r\n                # extra animals (MAX_ANIMALS_DEMAND_CAP 17) actually get placed\r\n                # and serviced instead of drifting to crops.\r\n                if owned_animals > 10 and idx >= 10:\r\n                    if task_type in ANIMAL_TASK_TYPES or (task_type == \"PICKUP\" and req in (ANIMAL_COW, ANIMAL_SHEEP, ANIMAL_GOOSE)):\r\n                        cost -= FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS\r\n\r\n        # Corner priority (early game) — free route for the corner plant.\r\n        if (unlocked_cnt == 1 and day < CORNER_PRIORITY_DAY and\r\n                task_type == \"PLANT\" and tuple(tpos) == CORNER_TARGET):\r\n            cost -= CORNER_BONUS\r\n\r\n        # Claim stickiness: keep your previous task, avoid stealing.\r\n        k = _task_key(task)\r\n        if k is not None:\r\n            claimer = claims.get(k)\r\n            if claimer == idx: cost -= CLAIM_BONUS\r\n            elif claimer is not None: cost += CLAIM_STEAL_PENALTY\r\n\r\n        # Endgame DROP tasks are bound to the carrying unit. Bonus kept below\r\n        # FEED/CARE/HARVEST_ANIMAL scores so animal survival always wins.\r\n        hint = task.get(\"hint\")\r\n        if hint is not None:\r\n            if hint == idx: cost -= 15000\r\n            else: cost += 100000\r\n\r\n        # Zone locality (TRAVEL_TRIM): home is cheaper, second cheaper-ish.\r\n        if q == home: cost -= 900\r\n        elif q == second: cost -= 500\r\n        elif q in unlocked_set: pass\r\n        else: cost += 10000\r\n        if q == home:\r\n            tile_owner = (tpos[0] * 7 + tpos[1] * 13) % unit_cnt\r\n            if idx == tile_owner: cost -= 300\r\n            elif idx == (tile_owner + 1) % unit_cnt: cost -= 100\r\n\r\n        return cost\r\n\r\n    for idx, upos in enumerate(unit_positions):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is not None: continue\r\n\r\n        best, best_cost = None, None\r\n        for task in tasks_sorted:\r\n            tpos = task.get(\"pos\")\r\n            if not _is_sequence(tpos) or len(tpos) < 2: continue\r\n            if tpos in assigned_pos: continue\r\n\r\n            # Farmer locked to pasture/coop tiles (unless PASTURE_UNLOCK — then\r\n            # it may roam to crops, but keeps the big FARMER_ANIMAL_BIAS above\r\n            # so animals are always preferred when any animal task exists).\r\n            reserved_tiles = set(PASTURE_ONLY_TILES)\r\n            if _geese_on():\r\n                reserved_tiles |= set(COOP_ONLY_TILES)\r\n            if idx == 0 and tuple(tpos) not in reserved_tiles and not PASTURE_UNLOCK:\r\n                continue\r\n\r\n            task_type = task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n            if task_type == \"PLANT\":\r\n                crop = task.get(\"crop\")\r\n                if assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) >= plant_budget.get(crop, 0): continue\r\n\r\n            req = task.get(\"req\")\r\n            if req is not None:\r\n                inv = unit_inventories[idx] if idx < len(unit_inventories) else {}\r\n                if _int(inv.get(req, 0), 0) <= 0: continue\r\n\r\n            c = _assign_cost(idx, upos, task)\r\n            if best_cost is None or c < best_cost:\r\n                best_cost, best = c, task\r\n\r\n        if best is not None:\r\n            assigned_pos.add(best[\"pos\"])\r\n            if best.get(\"type\") == \"PLANT\":\r\n                crop = best.get(\"crop\")\r\n                assigned_plants[crop] = assigned_plants.get(crop, 0) + 1\r\n            k = _task_key(best)\r\n            if k is not None: new_claims[k] = idx\r\n            unit_types[idx] = best.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n            unit_prios[idx] = best.get(\"priority\", 0)\r\n            if upos == best[\"pos\"]:\r\n                unit_actions[idx] = best[\"tokens\"]\r\n            else:\r\n                unit_actions[idx] = _step_towards(upos[0], upos[1], best[\"pos\"][0], best[\"pos\"][1])\r\n\r\n    # ---- Farmer pasture patrol (if idle) ----\r\n    # Farmer fallback: if still idle, pick the nearest unassigned CROP task\r\n    if unit_actions[0] is None:\r\n        fx, fy = unit_positions[0]\r\n        crop_tasks = [\r\n            t for t in tasks_sorted\r\n            if t.get(\"type\") in CROP_TASK_TYPES and t[\"pos\"] not in assigned_pos\r\n        ]\r\n        if crop_tasks:\r\n            best_task = min(crop_tasks, key=lambda t: _manhattan((fx, fy), t[\"pos\"]))\r\n            if (fx, fy) == best_task[\"pos\"]:\r\n                unit_actions[0] = best_task[\"tokens\"]\r\n            else:\r\n                unit_actions[0] = _safe_step_towards(fx, fy, best_task[\"pos\"][0], best_task[\"pos\"][1], tiles)\r\n            assigned_pos.add(best_task[\"pos\"])\r\n            unit_types[0] = best_task.get(\"type\", \"\")\r\n            unit_prios[0] = best_task.get(\"priority\", 0)\r\n\r\n    # Final fallback\r\n    for idx in range(len(unit_positions)):\r\n        if unit_actions[idx] is None:\r\n            unit_actions[idx] = _default_action(unit_positions[idx], tiles)\r\n\r\n    _TASK_CLAIMS[\"claims\"] = new_claims\r\n    return unit_actions, unit_types, unit_prios\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# MARKET ORDERS (per-turn helpers extracted from agent() for readability)\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\ndef _day0_orders_for_strategy(strategy, money):\r\n    \"\"\"Compute the day-0 order list + money spent for a DAY0_STRATEGY.\r\n    Affordability-gated exactly like the verified opening: each order is\r\n    skipped (not fatal) if money runs out. Returns (orders, spent, leftover).\r\n    Prices mirror _game_src.ANIMALS / CROPS / fib-hire exactly.\"\"\"\r\n    hires, items = DAY0_CANDIDATES.get(strategy, DAY0_CANDIDATES[\"VERIFIED\"])\r\n    orders = []\r\n    start = money\r\n    for i in range(hires):\r\n        cost = _fib_cost(i)\r\n        if money >= cost:\r\n            orders.append([\"HIRE\"]); money -= cost\r\n        else:\r\n            break\r\n    animal_cost = {ANIMAL_SHEEP: 500, ANIMAL_COW: 400, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 300}\r\n    # TOMATO is not in main.py SEED_COST (the phase planner never buys it), but\r\n    # the day-0 scanner prices it at its true cost 50 so TOMATO_SCALING is\r\n    # reported honestly even though the planner can't use the seeds yet.\r\n    seed_cost_full = dict(SEED_COST)\r\n    seed_cost_full[\"TOMATO\"] = 50\r\n    for kind, item, qty in items:\r\n        if kind == \"ANIMAL\":\r\n            unit = animal_cost.get(item, 400)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_ANIMAL\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n        elif kind == \"SEED\":\r\n            unit = seed_cost_full.get(item, 10)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_SEED\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n        elif kind == \"PRODUCT\":\r\n            unit = BASE_PRICE.get(item, 25)   # ~price at I0 (inventory ~10000)\r\n            cost = unit * qty\r\n            if money >= cost:\r\n                orders.append([\"BUY_PRODUCT\", item, qty]); money -= cost\r\n    return orders, start - money, money\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _day0_scanner: Prices every candidate Day-0 opening against the true game constants.\r\ndef _day0_scanner(money=3000):\r\n    \"\"\"Global initial scanner (reporting-only). Prices every DAY0_STRATEGY\r\n    candidate and reports, per opening:\r\n      - budget: spend / leftover after the exact order sequence\r\n      - crew: hands hired day-0 (farmer + hands)\r\n      - first income: earliest day the first sale lands (crop OR animal)\r\n      - labor demand: estimated hands needed once the plan ramps\r\n        (active crops to water + animals to feed/collect), using\r\n        DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION actions per hand per day\r\n      - gross season production proxy: crop units (seeds bought day-0) +\r\n        animal units (max_held per interval over remaining days), unweighted\r\n        by price so it is a *capacity* number, not a profit forecast.\r\n    Prints a table (DEBUG_DAY_LOG / _DAY_LOG[\"day0\"]) but never changes the\r\n    opening itself — that is locked to DAY0_STRATEGY.\"\"\"\r\n    crop_first = {\"WHEAT\": 2, \"CARROT\": 2, \"TOMATO\": 8, \"STRAWBERRY\": 10, \"MELON\": 10}\r\n    crop_max_yield = {\"WHEAT\": 6, \"CARROT\": 4, \"TOMATO\": 4, \"STRAWBERRY\": 4, \"MELON\": 6}\r\n    animal_cost = {ANIMAL_SHEEP: 500, ANIMAL_COW: 400, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 300}\r\n    animal_first = {ANIMAL_SHEEP: 6, ANIMAL_COW: 8, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 4}\r\n    animal_interval = {ANIMAL_SHEEP: 3, ANIMAL_COW: 2, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 1}\r\n    animal_max_held = {ANIMAL_SHEEP: 6, ANIMAL_COW: 6, ANIMAL_GOOSE: 4}\r\n\r\n    out = {}\r\n    for strat, (hires, items) in DAY0_CANDIDATES.items():\r\n        orders, spent, leftover = _day0_orders_for_strategy(strat, money)\r\n        animals = {}\r\n        seeds = {}\r\n        products = {}\r\n        for kind, item, qty in items:\r\n            if kind == \"ANIMAL\": animals[item] = animals.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n            elif kind == \"SEED\": seeds[item] = seeds.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n            elif kind == \"PRODUCT\": products[item] = products.get(item, 0) + qty\r\n\r\n        # ---- structural blockers (can this opening actually run?) ----\r\n        blocked = []\r\n        if any(a == ANIMAL_GOOSE for a in animals):\r\n            blocked.append(\"NO_COOP_BUILD: geese can never be placed (no BUILD_COOP task gen)\")\r\n        if any(c == \"TOMATO\" for c in seeds):\r\n            blocked.append(\"TOMATO_NOT_IN_PLANNER: seeds never planted (not in SEED_COST/phase plan)\")\r\n        if sum(animals.values()) > _strategy_effects()[\"max_animals\"]:\r\n            blocked.append(\"ANIMALS>%d\" % _strategy_effects()[\"max_animals\"])\r\n        # ---- cash runway warning (LEARNED 2026-08-09) ----\r\n        # VERIFIED leaves 668 coins; WOOL_BARON/DAIRY_KING leave 68/88 and\r\n        # BOTH crashed to 53k/63k vs 101k baseline. Days 1-11 the agent lives\r\n        # on leftover + tiny wheat sales: with <~300 leftover it can only\r\n        # re-hire hands and buy feed wheat — wave-2 melons, land, strawberries\r\n        # and mid-game animals never happen. Capacity (gross_units) does NOT\r\n        # predict reward; leftover working capital does.\r\n        if leftover < 300 and animals:\r\n            blocked.append(\"LOW_CASH_RUNWAY: %d leftover funds days 1-11 ops (VERIFIED keeps 668)\" % leftover)\r\n\r\n        # ---- first income day ----\r\n        first_income = 99\r\n        for item, qty in animals.items():\r\n            first_income = min(first_income, animal_first[item])\r\n        for item, qty in seeds.items():\r\n            if item in crop_first:\r\n                first_income = min(first_income, crop_first[item])\r\n\r\n        # ---- labor demand proxy ----\r\n        # Crops: each active crop needs ~1 WATER/day (watering capacity is the\r\n        # binding constraint, ~40 actions/day max). Animals: feed/collect per\r\n        # interval — each animal needs FEED every ~2 days + pickup on yield.\r\n        crop_water_actions = sum(seeds.values())\r\n        animal_actions = sum(qty for qty in animals.values())  # feed+care daily proxy\r\n        labor_actions = crop_water_actions + animal_actions\r\n        hands_needed = max(hires, 1 + int((labor_actions + DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION - 1)\r\n                                          // DAY0_FETCH_PER_ACTION))\r\n\r\n        # ---- gross season production proxy (capacity, unweighted) ----\r\n        crop_units = sum(qty * crop_max_yield.get(item, 4)\r\n                         for item, qty in seeds.items() if item in crop_max_yield)\r\n        animal_units = 0\r\n        for item, qty in animals.items():\r\n            prod_days = max(0, 30 - animal_first[item]) // animal_interval[item]\r\n            animal_units += qty * animal_max_held[item] * max(1, prod_days)\r\n\r\n        out[strat] = {\r\n            \"orders\": len(orders), \"spend\": spent, \"leftover\": leftover,\r\n            \"hires\": len([o for o in orders if o[0] == \"HIRE\"]),\r\n            \"animals\": dict(animals), \"seeds\": dict(seeds),\r\n            \"first_income_day\": first_income,\r\n            \"hands_needed\": hands_needed,\r\n            \"crop_units\": crop_units, \"animal_units\": animal_units,\r\n            \"gross_units\": crop_units + animal_units,\r\n            \"blocked\": blocked,\r\n        }\r\n    return out\r\n\r\n\r\n\r\n# [SCANNER] _day0_animal_strategy: Scans which Day-0 animal mix best fits projected first-yield prices.\r\ndef _day0_animal_strategy(market_inv, market_prices, day=0, hour=0,\r\n                          unlocked_shops=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Forecast-driven day-0 animal decision. Projects MILK and WOOL prices at\r\n    the sheep first-yield day (earliest animal income) using the deterministic\r\n    town-drain projection. When BOTH are projected below\r\n    DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO (i.e. the herd won't pay back), returns a LIGHTER\r\n    opening that shrinks animals (cash stays in melons/wheat). Otherwise\r\n    returns the verified full opening. Reporting-only when the knob is OFF.\r\n    The decision uses the SAME numbers the sell side sees (projected price\r\n    ratios), so the agent decides the \"max animals\" constraint from the\r\n    forecast instead of hard-coding it.\"\"\"\r\n    if not DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS:\r\n        return CONFIG.get(\"DAY0_STRATEGY\", DAY0_STRATEGY), {}\r\n    try:\r\n        steps = DAY0_ANIMAL_FIRST_YIELD * 24\r\n        proj = _project_prices(market_inv, day, hour, steps,\r\n                               unlocked_shops or [])\r\n        milk_r = _price_ratio(PRODUCT_MILK, proj)\r\n        wool_r = _price_ratio(PRODUCT_WOOL, proj)\r\n        weak = (milk_r < DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO\r\n                and wool_r < DAY0_ANIMAL_WEAK_RATIO)\r\n        if weak:\r\n            # Lighter herd: keep melons/wheat, drop animals to a minimum.\r\n            # Only shrink — never grow past the verified composition.\r\n            return \"CROP_FIRST\", {\r\n                \"milk_proj\": round(milk_r, 2), \"wool_proj\": round(wool_r, 2),\r\n                \"weak\": True, \"why\": \"milk/wool premium projected weak at d%d\" % (\r\n                    DAY0_ANIMAL_FIRST_YIELD),\r\n            }\r\n        return CONFIG.get(\"DAY0_STRATEGY\", DAY0_STRATEGY), {\r\n            \"milk_proj\": round(milk_r, 2), \"wool_proj\": round(wool_r, 2),\r\n            \"weak\": False, \"why\": \"premium projected alive\",\r\n        }\r\n    except Exception:\r\n        return CONFIG.get(\"DAY0_STRATEGY\", DAY0_STRATEGY), {}\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _day0_opening(money, strategy=None, market_inv=None, market_prices=None,\r\n                  unlocked_shops=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Verified Day-0 opening script (budget 3000). Executes the strategy\r\n    selected by DAY0_STRATEGY (default VERIFIED = the proven 116k baseline),\r\n    or the forecast-driven animal decision when DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS is ON.\r\n    Each order is affordability-gated so a cheaper start never overspends.\r\n    Run _day0_scanner(money) first to see the full candidate table.\"\"\"\r\n    strat = strategy or CONFIG.get(\"DAY0_STRATEGY\", DAY0_STRATEGY)\r\n    decision = {}\r\n    if DYNAMIC_DAY0_ANIMALS:\r\n        strat, decision = _day0_animal_strategy(\r\n            market_inv, market_prices, 0, 0, unlocked_shops)\r\n    orders, spent, leftover = _day0_orders_for_strategy(strat, money)\r\n    return orders, leftover, strat, decision\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _record_day_log(day, money, forecast_free, market_prices, market_inv,\r\n                    buy_orders, trend=None, expenses=None, opponent=None,\r\n                    animal_phase=None, next_actions=None, outcome=None,\r\n                    demand=None, recovery=None, opp_buys=None,\r\n                    tile_map=None, late_game=None, goose=None,\r\n                    directive=None, day0_strategy=None):\r\n    \"\"\"One-line-per-day tracker: money, price ratios, tomorrow's price trend,\r\n    projected expenses, buys, last buy days, and a compact REASON string that\r\n    shows the agent's decision chain (why this route, why these buys/sells) so\r\n    the QA harness / stdout exposes the thought patterns. Stored in _DAY_LOG;\r\n    printed / appended when DEBUG_DAY_LOG is on. `animal_phase` is the\r\n    price-gated animal-phase snapshot (see _animal_phase_report);\r\n    `next_actions` is the next-day workload forecast (_forecast_next_day_actions)\r\n    and `outcome` is the season-end projection (_project_outcome).\r\n    `demand`/`recovery`/`opp_buys` are the market-awareness features\r\n    (_market_demand_rate / _price_recovery_time / _infer_opponent_activity).\"\"\"\r\n    global _DAY_LOG\r\n    if _DAY_LOG is not None and _DAY_LOG.get(\"day\") == day:\r\n        return\r\n\r\n    # ---- Compact reasoning summary (thought patterns for QA) ----\r\n    reason_parts = []\r\n    # Overseer directive (deterministic override) is the FIRST thing the\r\n    # reason chain shows: \"override=species_order:SHEEP\" means a\r\n    # SHOP_STRATEGY rule fired and the planner obeyed it, not automation.\r\n    if isinstance(directive, dict) and directive:\r\n        d_parts = [\"%s:%s\" % (k, v) for k, v in sorted(directive.items())]\r\n        reason_parts.append(\"override=%s\" % \",\".join(d_parts))\r\n    if isinstance(opponent, dict):\r\n        ctr = opponent.get(\"counter\")\r\n        if isinstance(ctr, dict) and ctr.get(\"route\"):\r\n            reason_parts.append(\"route=%s@%.2fx\" % (ctr[\"route\"], ctr.get(\"route_ratio\", 0)))\r\n            if ctr.get(\"dump_before\"):\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"dump_before=%s\" % \",\".join(ctr[\"dump_before\"]))\r\n            if ctr.get(\"avoid\"):\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"avoid=%s\" % \",\".join(ctr[\"avoid\"]))\r\n        dt = opponent.get(\"dump_timing\")\r\n        if isinstance(dt, dict) and dt:\r\n            crash = [p for p, r in dt.items()\r\n                     if _float(r.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        < _float(r.get(\"best_before_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)]\r\n            if crash:\r\n                reason_parts.append(\"crash_soon=%s\" % \",\".join(crash))\r\n    buys = [\"%s:%s\" % (o[0], o[1] if len(o) > 1 else \"\") for o in buy_orders]\r\n    if buys:\r\n        reason_parts.append(\"buy=%s\" % \",\".join(buys))\r\n    reason = \" | \".join(reason_parts) if reason_parts else \"\"\r\n\r\n    _DAY_LOG = {\r\n        \"day\": day,\r\n        \"money\": money,\r\n        \"forecast\": dict(forecast_free) if forecast_free else {},\r\n        \"prices\": _price_info(market_prices, market_inv),\r\n        \"trend\": trend or {},\r\n        \"expenses\": expenses or {},\r\n        \"buys\": buys,\r\n        \"reason\": reason,\r\n        \"last_buy_day\": {\r\n            \"COW\": _last_profitable_buy_day(ANIMAL_COW, market_prices),\r\n            \"SHEEP\": _last_profitable_buy_day(ANIMAL_SHEEP, market_prices),\r\n            # Derived from _plan_land's payoff-window gate\r\n            # (days_left >= LAND_PAYOFF_WINDOW_DAYS -> last buy at\r\n            # 30 - LAND_PAYOFF_WINDOW_DAYS; Q4 gate shifts only the START).\r\n            \"LAND\": (30 - LAND_PAYOFF_WINDOW_DAYS) if day < 30 else 0,\r\n        },\r\n        \"day0\": _day0_scanner(3000) if day == 0 else _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0\"),\r\n        \"day0_strategy\": (day0_strategy if day0_strategy\r\n                          else CONFIG.get(\"DAY0_STRATEGY\", DAY0_STRATEGY)) if day == 0\r\n                         else _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0_strategy\"),\r\n        \"opponent\": opponent or {},\r\n        \"animal_phase\": animal_phase or {},\r\n        \"next_actions\": next_actions or {},\r\n        \"outcome\": outcome or {},\r\n        \"demand\": demand or {},\r\n        \"recovery\": recovery or {},\r\n        \"opp_buys\": opp_buys or {},\r\n        \"tile_map\": tile_map or {},\r\n        \"late_game\": late_game or {},\r\n        \"goose\": goose or {},\r\n    }\r\n    if DEBUG_DAY_LOG:\r\n        opp_line = _DAY_LOG[\"opponent\"]\r\n        pr_line = _DAY_LOG[\"prices\"]\r\n        ap_line = _DAY_LOG[\"animal_phase\"]\r\n        na_line = _DAY_LOG[\"next_actions\"]\r\n        oc_line = _DAY_LOG[\"outcome\"]\r\n        dm_line = _DAY_LOG[\"demand\"]\r\n        rc_line = _DAY_LOG[\"recovery\"]\r\n        ob_line = _DAY_LOG[\"opp_buys\"]\r\n        tm_line = _DAY_LOG[\"tile_map\"]\r\n        lg_line = _DAY_LOG[\"late_game\"]\r\n        line = (\"[DAY %02d] money=%6d prices=%s reason=%s opp=%s\" % (\r\n            day, money, pr_line, reason if reason else \"-\",\r\n            opp_line if opp_line else \"-\"))\r\n        if tm_line:\r\n            line += (\" | tiles={unlocked:%d empty:%d avg_dist:%s max_dist:%d far:%d}\" % (\r\n                tm_line.get(\"unlocked\", 0), tm_line.get(\"empty\", 0),\r\n                tm_line.get(\"avg_dist\", 0), tm_line.get(\"max_dist\", 0),\r\n                len(tm_line.get(\"far_tiles\", []))))\r\n        if lg_line:\r\n            line += (\" | late={empty:%d util:%.2f free:%d plantable:%s}\" % (\r\n                lg_line.get(\"empty_now\", 0), lg_line.get(\"utilization\", 0),\r\n                lg_line.get(\"will_free\", 0), lg_line.get(\"plantable_late\", {})))\r\n        if dm_line:\r\n            line += (\" | demand=%s\" % (dm_line,))\r\n        if rc_line:\r\n            line += (\" | recovery=%s\" % (rc_line,))\r\n        if ob_line:\r\n            line += (\" | opp_buys=%s\" % (ob_line,))\r\n        if ap_line:\r\n            line += (\" | animal_phase=active:%s placed:%d milk:%.2f->%.2f \"\r\n                     \"wool:%.2f->%.2f own:%s\" % (\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"active\"), ap_line.get(\"placed\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"milk_now\", 0), ap_line.get(\"milk_self\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"wool_now\", 0), ap_line.get(\"wool_self\", 0),\r\n                         ap_line.get(\"own_units\", {})))\r\n        if na_line:\r\n            line += (\" | next_actions={%s} total=%d\" % (\r\n                \",\".join(\"%s:%d\" % (k, v) for k, v in na_line.items()\r\n                         if k != \"total\"),\r\n                na_line.get(\"total\", 0)))\r\n        if oc_line:\r\n            line += (\" | outcome=proj:%d today:%d rate:%d days:%d note:%s\" % (\r\n                oc_line.get(\"projected_final\", 0), oc_line.get(\"today\", 0),\r\n                oc_line.get(\"daily_rate\", 0), oc_line.get(\"days_left\", 0),\r\n                oc_line.get(\"note\", \"\")))\r\n        print(line)\r\n        if day == 0 and _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0\"):\r\n            try:\r\n                with open(DAY_LOG_FILE, \"a\") as _f:\r\n                    _f.write(\"[DAY 00] day0_strategy=%s day0=%s\\n\" % (\r\n                        _DAY_LOG.get(\"day0_strategy\"),\r\n                        {k: {kk: vv for kk, vv in v.items() if kk != \"orders\"}\r\n                         for k, v in _DAY_LOG[\"day0\"].items()}))\r\n            except Exception:\r\n                pass\r\n        try:\r\n            with open(DAY_LOG_FILE, \"a\") as _f:\r\n                _f.write(line + \"\\n\")\r\n        except Exception:\r\n            pass\r\n\r\n\r\ndef _build_sell_orders(day, hour, shed, global_inv, placed_animals,\r\n                       market_inv, market_prices, sell_slots, endgame,\r\n                       daily_sold, shed_pressure, counter_timing=None,\r\n                       counter_log=None, recovery=None, demand=None,\r\n                       owned_animals=None):\r\n    \"\"\"Timing-aware sell order builder. Price-aware: premium items are sold\r\n    one unit at a time while the MARGINAL price stays >= SELL_MIN_RATIO*base,\r\n    and the daily budget doubles when the market pays >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO*base.\r\n    `daily_sold` is mutated in place (per-day sold counters).\r\n\r\n    Opponent counter (OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER, OFF default): `counter_timing` is\r\n    the `_opponent_dump_timing` report. When the opponent's next wave will\r\n    LOWER a premium item's price below the best window we can catch today\r\n    (price_after_dump < best_before_dump), we ACCELERATE selling that item\r\n    NOW — before their supply hits the shared market. The marginal floor still\r\n    guards every unit, so we never oversell into our own crash. `counter_log`\r\n    (optional mutable dict) records which items the counter actually boosted,\r\n    for the day tracker / reasoning trace.\r\n\r\n    Recovery/demand awareness (RECOVERY_AWARE_SELL, ON): `recovery` =\r\n    {item: steps-to-recover} and `demand` = {item: units/turn} from the market\r\n    scanners. Short recovery / high demand -> HOLD (the climb continues);\r\n    long recovery / low demand -> ACCELERATE (the premium is fleeting). This\r\n    is the shops-demand-driven milk/wool sell timing from the briefing.\"\"\"\r\n    turn_index = day * 24 + hour\r\n    near_tick = (turn_index % 12) in (10, 11)\r\n\r\n    sell_candidates = []\r\n    herd = owned_animals if owned_animals is not None else placed_animals\r\n    for item in SELLABLE_ITEMS:\r\n        qty = _sellable_inventory(item, shed, global_inv, day, herd)\r\n        if qty <= 0: continue\r\n        mkt_inv = _int(_safe_get(market_inv, item, 10000), 10000)\r\n        safe = SELL_SAFE_INVENTORY.get(item, 10100)\r\n        sell_qty = 0\r\n        # EARLY-DUMP candidate computed ONCE; later branches may raise/keep\r\n        # sell_qty but never silently drop it (FIX: the old code let the\r\n        # premium/PRICE_AWARE branches overwrite the early-dump value, making\r\n        # EARLY_DUMP_TIMING dead — we merge via max() at the end).\r\n        early_qty = 0\r\n\r\n        # ---- EARLY-DUMP TIMING (user strategy, early cash trough) ----\r\n        # Days 1..EARLY_DUMP_END_DAY are the cash trough (money ~44-305). If\r\n        # the opponent's first harvest/dump of THIS item is imminent AND will\r\n        # crash the price (price_after_dump < price_now), sell our stock NOW\r\n        # into the pre-dump price — the early cash arrives before the market\r\n        # collapses. Marginal floor still guards every unit.\r\n        if (EARLY_DUMP_TIMING and 1 <= day <= EARLY_DUMP_END_DAY\r\n                and counter_timing and item in counter_timing):\r\n            dt = counter_timing[item]\r\n            after = _float(dt.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n            now = _float(dt.get(\"price_now\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n            next_dump = _int(dt.get(\"next_dump_day\", 99), 99)\r\n            units = _int(dt.get(\"units\", 0), 0)\r\n            if (next_dump - day) <= EARLY_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS \\\r\n                    and units >= EARLY_DUMP_MIN_UNITS \\\r\n                    and after < now:\r\n                # Sell as much as the marginal floor allows (never below floor).\r\n                early_max_q = 0\r\n                for _ in range(min(qty, 12)):\r\n                    if _market_price(item, mkt_inv + early_max_q) < \\\r\n                            SELL_MIN_RATIO * BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1):\r\n                        break\r\n                    early_max_q += 1\r\n                early_qty = early_max_q\r\n\r\n        if item in PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET:\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif (EARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL and item in (PRODUCT_MILK, PRODUCT_WOOL)\r\n                    and 1 <= day <= EARLY_LIVESTOCK_SELL_DAYS):\r\n                # Strategy #3 early-aggression window: sell ALL fetched milk/\r\n                # wool as soon as it reaches the shed to fund faster scaling.\r\n                # Only the marginal floor caps it — the old `sell_qty = qty`\r\n                # ignored the floor and dumped into a glut (FIX: same\r\n                # marginal-price loop as PRICE_AWARE_SELL).\r\n                base = BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1)\r\n                min_price = SELL_MIN_RATIO * base\r\n                sell_qty = 0\r\n                for _ in range(qty):\r\n                    if _market_price(item, mkt_inv + sell_qty) < min_price:\r\n                        break\r\n                    sell_qty += 1\r\n            elif PRICE_AWARE_SELL:\r\n                # True price control: market orders execute one unit at a\r\n                # time and re-quote the price after each unit, so we only\r\n                # sell units whose MARGINAL price stays at/above the\r\n                # reservation floor (SELL_MIN_RATIO * base). In a glut we\r\n                # hold and let the town drain the market back up; at a\r\n                # scarcity premium we sell up to the (scaled) budget.\r\n                base = BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1)\r\n                min_price = SELL_MIN_RATIO * base\r\n                budget = PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET[item]\r\n                if _price_ratio(item, market_prices) >= SELL_HIGH_RATIO:\r\n                    budget = budget * SELL_HIGH_BUDGET_MULT\r\n                # RECOVERY/DEMAND AWARE (briefing Pillar 1/3/4): the town\r\n                # drain either rescues a premium (fast recovery -> hold) or\r\n                # abandons it (slow recovery -> our own supply crashes it,\r\n                # sell more now). Demand rate tells us whether the climb is\r\n                # shop-driven (real, hold) or center-only (fleeting, sell).\r\n                if RECOVERY_AWARE_SELL:\r\n                    # Only MILK/WOOL/STRAWBERRY are steady streams where\r\n                    # \"sell before the fleeting premium dies\" makes sense.\r\n                    # MELON is a BULK one-time wave: dumping it all at once\r\n                    # (budget x2 + shed-pressure) crashes the price and\r\n                    # forfeits the slow recovery (measured: day-19 MELON 57\r\n                    # dump -> 0.85x; spread sales recover). Never accelerate\r\n                    # melon dumps.\r\n                    if item != \"MELON\":\r\n                        rt = _int(_safe_get(recovery, item, -1), -1)\r\n                        dr = _float(_safe_get(demand, item, 0.0), 0.0)\r\n                        if rt >= 0:\r\n                            if rt <= RECOVERY_HOLD_STEPS:\r\n                                # Fast drain: the price recovers soon, the climb\r\n                                # continues -> keep the normal budget (hold).\r\n                                pass\r\n                            elif rt >= RECOVERY_DUMP_STEPS and dr < RECOVERY_DEMAND_HOLD:\r\n                                # Slow recovery + weak demand: this premium is\r\n                                # fleeting. Accelerate before our own supply (and\r\n                                # any opponent dump) pushes it to the floor.\r\n                                budget = budget * RECOVERY_DUMP_MULT\r\n                        elif dr < RECOVERY_DEMAND_HOLD:\r\n                            # Already scarce but shop demand is weak: the scarcity\r\n                            # is center-only and will fade; don't overshoot.\r\n                            budget = budget  # normal\r\n                rem = budget - daily_sold[item]\r\n                if rem > 0:\r\n                    inv = mkt_inv\r\n                    max_q = 0\r\n                    cap = min(rem, qty)\r\n                    for _ in range(cap):\r\n                        if _market_price(item, inv + max_q) < min_price:\r\n                            break\r\n                        max_q += 1\r\n                    if shed_pressure >= 0.9:\r\n                        max_q = max(max_q, min(qty, max(1, budget // 2)))\r\n                    sell_qty = max_q\r\n                    # OPPONENT COUNTER (Phase 2): their next wave will crash\r\n                    # this item -> sell everything profitable BEFORE it lands.\r\n                    # Only fire when the dump is IMMINENT (within the lead\r\n                    # window): if it is still days out, the best_before_dump\r\n                    # window (projected) is HIGHER than today, so dumping now\r\n                    # forfeits the climb (measured: day-11 dump-before at 1.07\r\n                    # lost the day-14 window at 1.11). `best_day` is where the\r\n                    # price peaks before their wave — we wait until we are\r\n                    # inside the lead window so we sell at/near that peak.\r\n                    if (OPPONENT_CROP_COUNTER and counter_timing\r\n                            and item in counter_timing):\r\n                        dt = counter_timing[item]\r\n                        after = _float(dt.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        best = _float(dt.get(\"best_before_dump\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        now = _float(dt.get(\"price_now\", 1.0), 1.0)\r\n                        next_dump = _int(dt.get(\"next_dump_day\", 99), 99)\r\n                        imminent = (next_dump - day) <= CROP_COUNTER_DUMP_LEAD_DAYS\r\n                        if imminent and after < best and after < now:\r\n                            counter_max_q = 0\r\n                            counter_cap = qty\r\n                            for _ in range(counter_cap):\r\n                                if _market_price(item, inv + counter_max_q) < min_price:\r\n                                    break\r\n                                counter_max_q += 1\r\n                            if counter_max_q > sell_qty:\r\n                                sell_qty = counter_max_q\r\n                                if counter_log is not None:\r\n                                    counter_log[item] = \"boost near dump d%d (now %.2f, after %.2f)\" % (next_dump, now, after)\r\n            else:\r\n                rem = PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET[item] - daily_sold[item]\r\n                if rem > 0 and mkt_inv < safe: sell_qty = min(qty, rem)\r\n        elif item == PRODUCT_EGG and _geese_on():\r\n            # Goose Pillar 5: town center drains eggs x1/x2/x4 at days 0/10/20.\r\n            # Before day 20 demand is weak (and eggs are glut-resilient, so\r\n            # they hold value) -> HOLD eggs in the shed. After day 20 the town\r\n            # center quadruples consumption, draining the market and raising\r\n            # price -> liquidate stored eggs then. Bakery/Brunch add shop\r\n            # drain on top (scanner reports the demand rate).\r\n            if endgame:\r\n                sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif day >= 20:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 12)   # peak demand window, sell stored stock\r\n            else:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 2)    # hold early; only trim shed pressure\r\n        elif item == \"FERTILIZER\":\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 6) if mkt_inv < safe else min(2, qty)\r\n            else:\r\n                if mkt_inv < safe: sell_qty = min(3, qty)\r\n        elif item == \"WHEAT\":\r\n            if endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n            elif near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, 10) if mkt_inv < 10000 else min(4, qty)\r\n            else:\r\n                if mkt_inv < 10000: sell_qty = min(6, qty)\r\n        elif endgame: sell_qty = qty\r\n        else:\r\n            if mkt_inv < safe:\r\n                room = safe - mkt_inv\r\n                max_tr = 2 if item in PREMIUM_ITEMS else 6\r\n                sell_qty = min(qty, max(1, room), max_tr)\r\n            else:\r\n                sell_qty = min(2, qty) if item in PREMIUM_ITEMS else min(3, qty)\r\n            if near_tick:\r\n                sell_qty = max(sell_qty, min(qty, 4))\r\n            if shed_pressure >= 0.85:\r\n                sell_qty = max(sell_qty, min(qty, 2))\r\n\r\n        # EARLY-DUMP BOOST: merge the early-dump candidate with whatever the\r\n        # branch chain computed (max, so a later branch can trim below it but\r\n        # never silently drop it). Only log the counter when it actually wins.\r\n        if early_qty > sell_qty:\r\n            if counter_log is not None and EARLY_DUMP_TIMING and counter_timing \\\r\n                    and item in counter_timing:\r\n                dt = counter_timing[item]\r\n                counter_log[item] = \"early dump d%d (now %.2f, after %.2f)\" % (\r\n                    _int(dt.get(\"next_dump_day\", 99), 99),\r\n                    _float(dt.get(\"price_now\", 1.0), 1.0),\r\n                    _float(dt.get(\"price_after_dump\", 1.0), 1.0))\r\n            sell_qty = early_qty\r\n\r\n        sell_qty = min(sell_qty, qty)\r\n        # Premium daily budget is counted ONCE per item AFTER the final\r\n        # sell_qty is settled (including any early-dump boost), so later\r\n        # hourly calls can't oversell the daily premium budget (FIX: the old\r\n        # pre-merge increment missed the early-dump raise).\r\n        if item in PREMIUM_DAILY_BUDGET:\r\n            daily_sold[item] += sell_qty\r\n        if sell_qty > 0:\r\n            sell_candidates.append((item, sell_qty, BASE_PRICE.get(item, 1) * sell_qty))\r\n\r\n    sell_candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[2], reverse=True)\r\n    return [[\"SELL\", item, qty] for item, qty, _ in sell_candidates[:sell_slots]]\r\n\r\n\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n# MAIN AGENT\r\n# ==========================================================================\r\n\r\ndef agent(obs):\r\n    global _DAILY_SOLD, _TASK_CLAIMS, _DAY_LOG, _GEESE_ACTIVE\r\n\r\n    # Initialize persistent state on the true first call OR any time it's\r\n    # still uninitialized (e.g. the harness's first obs doesn't have\r\n    # step==0 — a resumed run, a different step-numbering convention, a\r\n    # reloaded module, etc.). Without this self-heal, every downstream use\r\n    # of _TASK_CLAIMS/_DAILY_SOLD crashes (TypeError: 'NoneType' object is\r\n    # not subscriptable) EVERY turn, and the outer try/except below quietly\r\n    # turns that into a permanent no-op PASS with no visible error — i.e.\r\n    # exactly \"the agent isn't responding.\"\r\n    if obs.get(\"step\", 0) == 0 or _TASK_CLAIMS is None:\r\n        _reset_state()\r\n\r\n    try:\r\n        if not isinstance(obs, dict):\r\n            return _pass()\r\n\r\n        player = _int(obs.get(\"player\", 0), 0)\r\n        day = _int(obs.get(\"day\", 0), 0)\r\n        hour = _int(obs.get(\"hour\", 0), 0)\r\n\r\n        # unlocked_shops must exist BEFORE any branch: the Day-0 opening reads\r\n        # it, and ENABLE_OPPONENT_ANALYSIS=False would otherwise leave it\r\n        # undefined -> NameError -> the outer except turns the first turn into\r\n        # a no-op PASS. Read it here once; every later path reuses this value.\r\n        unlocked_shops = _safe_get(_safe_get(obs, \"town\", {}), \"unlocked_shops\", [])\r\n\r\n        # ---- DAILY_OVERRIDES: PAUSE_ALL short-circuits the whole day ----\r\n        day_overrides = _daily_overrides(day)\r\n        if day_overrides.get(\"PAUSE_ALL\"):\r\n            return _pass()\r\n\r\n        farms = obs.get(\"farms\", [])\r\n        private = obs.get(\"private\", {})\r\n        if not farms or player >= len(farms):\r\n            return _pass()\r\n\r\n        me = farms[player]\r\n        if not isinstance(me, dict):\r\n            return _pass()\r\n\r\n        money = _float(me.get(\"money\", 0.0), 0.0)\r\n        tiles = me.get(\"tiles\", [])\r\n        farmer = me.get(\"farmer\", [0, 0])\r\n        hands = me.get(\"hands\", [])\r\n        unlocked_quads = me.get(\"unlocked_quadrants\", [\"NW\"])\r\n        hires_today = _int(me.get(\"hires_today\", 0), 0)\r\n\r\n        unlocked_cnt = max(1, len(unlocked_quads))\r\n        unlocked_set = set(unlocked_quads)\r\n\r\n        # Goose enable decision (once): geese activate ONLY if the static\r\n        # ENABLE_GEESE knob is on AND (if GEESE_DEMAND_ENABLE) an egg shop\r\n        # unlocked early. Default: both off (A/B showed geese regress even\r\n        # with Bakery+Brunch, so this stays OFF unless the user flips both).\r\n        if not _GEESE_ACTIVE and ENABLE_GEESE:\r\n            if not GEESE_DEMAND_ENABLE:\r\n                _GEESE_ACTIVE = True\r\n            else:\r\n                shops = _safe_get(_safe_get(obs, \"town\", {}), \"unlocked_shops\", [])\r\n                if day <= 8 and (SHOP_BAKERY in shops or SHOP_BRUNCH_SPOT in shops):\r\n                    _GEESE_ACTIVE = True\r\n\r\n        if not _is_sequence(tiles) or len(farmer) < 2:\r\n            return _pass()\r\n        if not _is_sequence(hands):\r\n            hands = []\r\n\r\n        farmer_pos = (farmer[0], farmer[1])\r\n        if not _in_bounds(tiles, farmer_pos[0], farmer_pos[1]):\r\n            return _pass()\r\n\r\n        unit_positions = [farmer_pos]\r\n        for h in hands:\r\n            if _is_sequence(h) and len(h) >= 2:\r\n                unit_positions.append((h[0], h[1]))\r\n            else:\r\n                unit_positions.append((0, 0))\r\n\r\n        shed = _safe_get(private, \"shed\", {})\r\n        seeds = _safe_get(private, \"seeds\", {})\r\n        inventories = _safe_get(private, \"inventories\", [])\r\n        if not isinstance(inventories, list):\r\n            inventories = []\r\n\r\n        market_info = _safe_get(obs, \"market\", {})\r\n        market_inv = _safe_get(market_info, \"inventory\", {})\r\n        market_prices = market_info.get(\"prices\", {})\r\n\r\n        global_inv = {}\r\n        for k, v in shed.items(): global_inv[k]
